1000.doc: Base class of all game objects that live in a sector (dobj: GBODY). It holds position, current environment, the 3D object handle and an event-listener table, and defines default (empty) behaviour for ships, stations, sectors and so on. Its child C702 adds the script engine.

Activate.doc: Notifies listeners (event 1).

AddEventListener.doc: Registers a listener with an event mask, or removes it when the mask is 0.

AddTo.doc: Base no-op for adding the object to a container (sector or station). Subclasses override it.

CollisionWarn.doc: Base no-op hook called to warn the object of an imminent collision.

Create.doc: Initialises the position and returns the object.

CreateCommMenu.doc: Creates a communication menu (class 2225) for this object, optionally chained after an existing menu.

CreateDetailsMenu.doc: Creates the details menu of the class returned by GetDetailsMenu, chained when a previous menu is given.

CreateObjectMenu.doc: Creates the object's menu of the class returned by GetObjectMenu, chained after a previous menu when given.

comments.text: event bits: 1 activate, 2 deactivate, 4 environment change, 8 destruct, 16 attacked, 32 killed, 64 self-destruct, 128 targeted, 2048 killed in galaxy, 32768 scanned, 131072 other-object destroyed

Destruct.doc: Notifies listeners of destruction (event 8) and drops the listener table and position.

comments.text: classes: 2004 ship, 2016 station, 2012, 2014; stations only without complex hangar
button 654 = show in sector map
button 646 = 'Select as target' (35:1100011)
button 609 = monitor parent entry, with submenu entries 648/649 for monitor 1 and 2

FillContextMenu.doc: Builds the generic right-click context menu: show in sector map (ships, stations, gates etc.), select as target (monitor tracking), and a 'monitor' submenu with two external-view monitors.

GetBestMissileToFireOnThis.doc: Looks up the preferred missile type for this object by walking up its class hierarchy through the global missile-by-class table.

GetDetailsMenu.doc: Base default 0: the details menu class for this object (0 = none).

GetDistance.doc: Distance to another object, using the 3D engine when both have handles, otherwise from the cached positions.

GetEditorFlags.doc: Returns the editor flag word. Bit 1 (value 1) marks an object that is in the galaxy (probably set by Sector.AddToGalaxy).

GetEnvironment.doc: Returns the object this one is in: a sector, a station or a ship.

GetGSize.doc: Base default 0 (game size, overridden by objects that have one).

GetGSubType.doc: Base default 0. Overridden by each object kind (game subtype).

GetGType.doc: Base default 0. Overridden by each object kind (game type, see GetType).

GetName.doc: Returns the placeholder name (unknown) for objects without a name. Subclasses override it.

GetNameID.doc: Base default 0: text id of the object name, overridden by objects that have a name.

GetNoFind.doc: Base default 0. Ship flag 262144 (see Ship.GetNoFind) is the only known source of a nonzero value.

GetObjectID.doc: Returns the 3D scene object handle of this object (0 when it has no 3D instance).

GetObjectInSector.doc: Returns the outermost object directly inside a sector (this object if it is in the sector itself).

GetObjectMenu.doc: Base default 0: the menu class to open for this object (0 = none).

GetOwner.doc: Owner race object. The base class has no owner and returns 0.

GetPos.doc: Returns the position/rotation array, refreshed from the 3D object if one exists.

GetPosInSector.doc: Returns the position relative to the sector, recursing through the environment chain.

GetSector.doc: Returns the sector containing this object (walks up the environment chain).

GetSize.doc: Base default 0 (object size, overridden by objects that have one).

GetSubType.doc: Base default 0. Overridden by each object kind.

GetType.doc: Base default 0. Each object kind overrides it with its type code (see the GType/SubType pairs).

GetTypeCode.doc: Type and subtype packed as (type << 16) | subtype.

GetUnknown.doc: Base default 0. Ship flag 131072 (see Ship.GetUnknown) is the only known source of a nonzero value.

GetWarObjectID.doc: Returns the id of this object's record in the war map (see Galaxy), 0 when none.

GetWareTypeCode.doc: Base default 0: type code (type << 16 | subtype) under which the object is handled as a ware, 0 = none.

comments.text: base GetNameID() + 4 (probably the 'your' name variant)

GetYourNameID.doc: Returns the name id of the object's own name variant, which is the base name id plus 4 (probably a second name string per object).

Hit.doc: Base no-op hook called when the object is hit (weapon damage, probably with the attacker, the damage and the hit position).

InitPos.doc: Sets the cached position to (x, y, z) with zero rotation.

IsCurrentGuidanceTarget.doc: True if this is the object the player's guidance system currently points at.

IsHidden.doc: Base answer for an object that is not hidden from the sector map (returns 0).

IsHiddenInSectorMap.doc: True if hidden or inside a nebula range of its sector.

KilledBy.doc: Notifies listeners (event 32) that the object was killed.

KilledInGalaxy.doc: Notifies listeners (event 2048) and self-destructs silently (cause 11); used for objects dying outside the player's sector.

MissileAlert.doc: Base no-op hook called when a missile is launched at the object.

NotifyListeners.doc: Calls NotifyObjectEvent on every listener whose mask contains the event. Skips the player ship's listeners that the player object handles itself (IsEventListener).

OnContextMenuReturn.doc: Handles a chosen button: track as target, show in sector map (generic menu 2216) or open an external-view monitor (1 or 2).

OnContextMenuUpdate.doc: Disables context menu buttons that cannot be used now (tracking, sector map, monitors in auto mode).

OnContextMenuUpdateInfo.doc: Adds the object name as the default info line of the context menu.

Remove.doc: Base no-op for removing the object from its container. Subclasses override it.

RemoveEventListener.doc: Removes a listener; drops the table when empty.

ScannedBy.doc: Notifies listeners (event 32768) that the object was scanned.

comments.text: cause 17 = destroyed by another object; cause 11 = silent removal (KilledInGalaxy)

SelfDestruct.doc: Death handler. For cause 17 tells the killer (arg2) via event 131072; notifies listeners (event 64) unless cause is 11 (removed from galaxy).

SetEnvironment.doc: Sets the containing object, remembering the old one, and notifies listeners (event 4) with new and previous environment.

SetKnown.doc: Base no-op that sets whether the object is known to the player. Subclasses override it.

SetOwner.doc: Base no-op. Subclasses that have an owner store it here.

SetPos.doc: Moves the 3D object (if any) and re-reads the position; otherwise only updates the cached position.

SetRot.doc: Sets the rotation on the 3D object (if any) or in the cached array.

SetTargeted.doc: Notifies listeners (event 128) when the object becomes targeted.

SetWarObjectID.doc: Stores the object id used in war-map data (the war object id of the object).

UpdatePosition.doc: Refreshes the cached position/rotation from the 3D object.

1000.name: GBody

1001.doc: A custom galaxy object (GType 20) such as static scenery, beacons or space objects defined by the data files. Has a subtype, optional name text, a video channel and movable / collision flags. Owner is always a fixed race.

0.doc: custom object subtype
0.name: subType

1.doc: override name text id, -1 for default
1.name: overrideNameId

2.doc: 1 moveable, 2 no collision with special objects
2.name: flags

3.doc: video channel shown on the object's screen
3.name: videoChannel

Activate.doc: Creates the engine object, sets the video channel and flags; subtype 88 gets a render flag.

AddTo.doc: Adds the object to the sector's custom object list; activates it if the sector is active.

comments.text: falls through from the 124/125 case into SetMoveable(0), so these two are always unmovable

Create.doc: Creates a custom object; subtypes in the first list are moveable, 124 and 125 do not collide with special objects, others are immovable.

Deactivate.doc: Saves position and rotation, then frees the engine object.

Destruct.doc: Unregisters from the sector's custom object list, then runs the base destructor.

comments.text: the description text follows the name text (id + 1)

GetDescriptionID.doc: Returns the description text id, which is the name text id + 1.

GetName.doc: Name from page 17 with format strings converted; empty if no name.

comments.text: override name id (field 8) is used when it is 0 or more, otherwise the default ware name of type 20 is used

GetNameID.doc: Returns the name text id: the override (field 8) when it is set, otherwise the name of the ware type 20 with this subtype.

GetOverrideNameID.doc: Returns the name text id override (field 8). A negative value means the default name is used.

GetSize.doc: Size of the engine object, or 1000 when inactive.

GetType.doc: Returns the type code 20 (custom galaxy object).

GetTypeCode.doc: Type code: type 20 in the high 16 bits, subtype m6 in the low bits.

GetVideoChannel.doc: Returns the video channel of the object (field 10), used by the video playback of the object (probably).

IsHidden.doc: Hidden when the name id is 0 or 9999.

IsHiddenInSectorMap.doc: Hidden on the sector map exactly when IsHidden() is true.

IsMoveable.doc: Flag bit 1 of m8: the object can move.

NoCollWithSpecial.doc: Flag bit 2 of m8: no collision with special objects.

Remove.doc: Deactivates the object and removes it from the sector's custom object list.

SelfDestruct.doc: Removes the object from its sector and destroys the script object.

SetGlide.doc: Sets a gliding motion on the engine object.

SetMoveable.doc: Sets the moveable flag and the engine's static bit (128).

SetNoCollWithSpecial.doc: Sets the flag for no collision with special objects (engine bit 65536).

SetOverrideNameID.doc: Sets the name text id override (field 8). A negative value means the default name is used.

SetVideoChannel.doc: Sets the video channel and applies it to the engine object when active.

1001.name: CustomGalObject

150.doc: The singleton game client (dobj: CLIENT; called as C150.X() everywhere). Owns the cut/composite scenes and cameras, player life cycle (kill, leave, save), fast forward (SETA-like time acceleration), incoming message queues, gate and sector warping, autopilot and docking commands, spoken status notifications, Xbox pad bindings, the modified-game flag and the player statistics export. Per-frame work runs from Input -> Vbi.

0.doc: player name from the game start; default text 35:809 'Player'
0.name: webUserName

1.doc: web user id, set to 1 in InitClient, never changed here
1.name: webUserId

10.doc: 1 = spoken confirmations enabled
10.name: verbose

11.doc: 1 if the start has no plot (custom/tutorial start)
11.name: plotDisabled

12.doc: start time in seconds, 276600 set in InitClient
12.name: startDay

13.doc: id of the chosen game start, -1 for tutorial, -2 custom
13.name: gameStartId

14.doc: 0 clean, 1 modified, 2 custom game (dobj cl_Modified)
14.name: cl_Modified

15.doc: state bit flags that block monitor/tracking/eject/save actions
15.name: clientState

16.doc: nesting count of player freeze requests (sector frozen while > 0)
16.name: freezeLevel

17.doc: direction (+1/-1) of the last next-target key press
17.name: trackDirection

18.doc: 1 while fast forward is active (dobj cl_FastForward)
18.name: cl_FastForward

19.doc: current fast forward ramp step 0..10 (dobj cl_FastForwardStep)
19.name: cl_FastForwardStep

2.doc: real time of the last Vbi call, used to run Vbi once per tick
2.name: lastVbiTime

20.doc: real time of last ramp step (dobj cl_FastForwardTime)
20.name: cl_FastForwardTime

22.doc: camera field of view in degrees, default 90
22.name: focus

23.doc: array of unread messages {text, sender, age, flags}
23.name: incomingMessages

24.doc: stored plot message log entries {text, 0, age}
24.name: plotMessages

25.doc: stored normal message log entries {text, 0, age}

26.doc: temporary log entries, max 10 and dropped after 1 hour
26.name: tempMessages

27.doc: array indexed by ship subtype: seconds the player flew it
27.name: shipUseTimes

28.doc: game age at last favourite-ship update
28.name: shipUseLastAge

29.doc: how often Restart was called (loads); used by a random exit check
29.name: restartCount

3.doc: 0 idle, 1 sector/gate warp running, 2 inside the warp cutscene
3.name: warpState

30.doc: x of the sector the player is warping to / is in
30.name: warpSectorX

31.doc: y of the sector the player is warping to / is in
31.name: warpSectorY

32.doc: station the player is docking at, 0 if none
32.name: dockingHangar

35.doc: 3D camera of the composite scene (priority 80, partial viewport)
35.name: compCamera

36.doc: 3D camera of the second composite scene (priority 85)
36.name: comp2Camera

37.doc: value received by MovieNotify; checked against a constant in FXNotify
37.name: movieNotifyValue

38.doc: 'Cut Scene' scene object used by cutscenes
38.name: cutScene

39.doc: 'Cut2 Scene', galaxy backdrop scene of cutscenes
39.name: cut2Scene

4.doc: 1 while the pause message box of PauseGame is up
4.name: pauseMessageShown

44.doc: 'Cut Dust Scene' used for space dust in cutscenes
44.name: cutDustScene

46.doc: absolute time the screen fade started, 0 if no fade running
46.name: fadeStartTime

48.doc: target ARGB fade colour (alpha 0xFF = fade to colour)
48.name: fadeColor

49.doc: real time of last 'ship under attack' announcement
49.name: shipAttackNotifyTime

5.doc: 1 once the game is being left (fade to black started)
5.name: leaving

53.name: patrolWarnRace

56.name: planetCollisionNotifyTime

6.doc: 1 once the player has been killed (dobj cl_Killed)
6.name: cl_Killed

60.name: stationAnnouncementAge

61.doc: 1 once a pad button press enabled Xbox pad mode
61.name: xboxPadEnabled

62.doc: 1 after the default Xbox pad profile was applied
62.name: xboxDefaultsLoaded

7.doc: 1 while combat alert music is active (dobj cl_Alert)
7.name: cl_Alert

ActiveControlShipIsPlayerShip.doc: True if the main cockpit controls the player ship.

BeforeLeave.doc: Last steps before the process stops: silences speech, stops music and ends the DID transition when killed.

BeforeSave.doc: Frees the loaded text pages before saving.

BrakeReverse.doc: Brake key: stops the ship, or reverses at -5000 when already stopped.

CallInfiniteLoop.doc: Forwards to the global CallInfiniteLoop (debug hook).

CanAcceptCommand.doc: False if the player is outside a station but within 200 km of its surface (stations in range refuse commands).

CanCommunicateWith.doc: Whether the player can open a comm link to a ship/station/class 9001 object: it must be visible and (own/hired ship, docked-at station) or in the same sector within 500*param96 (25000 default) of the controlled ship.

CanSeeObject.doc: True if the object's sector is visible.

ChangeShip.doc: Moves the player into another ship. Docked in the same station: direct change, an abandoned pilot dies. Otherwise a beam transfer (C5005).

CheckEquipment.doc: Does the active monitor's ship have the equipment?

CheckSignatures.doc: If not yet modified, verifies the signed game files and marks the game modified when verification fails.

CheckXBoxController.doc: On the first pad key code received (296-311, 490, 492) enables pad mode and loads the default profile.

ClearAllMessages.doc: Clears the temporary, plot and standard message logs.

ClearXBoxEnable.doc: Clears the Xbox pad enabled flag.

ConfirmClearAllMessages.doc: Opens the delete confirmation (box id 33): 35:4219 'Delete all entries?'.

ConfirmEject.doc: Opens the eject confirmation (box id 31): 35:4003 'Eject Pilot from Ship' / 35:4252 'Are you sure you want to eject?'.

ConfirmLeave.doc: Opens the quit confirmation box (id 30). Text depends on DID state: 35:4901/4902/4903 in DID mode else 35:4212 'Quit Game' / 35:4251 'Are you sure you want to quit?'.

comments.text: race mask 0x0E01BE: only these races have station announcements
after 360 s since the last one the timer is reset to about 130 s ago
130:2000 holds the number of generated announcements
announcement 1 (spaceweed notice) is skipped for race 5
feature bit 262144 disables announcements
plays the PA chime 1006 first

DoStationAnnouncements.doc: While docked at a station of a speaking race, occasionally plays a random station PA announcement (page 130, 27 fixed texts plus generated number-sequence announcements). Rate limited via the last announcement age.

DockPlayerShipTo.doc: Docks the player ship at a station if docking is possible and a dock port is granted.

DockingAllowed.doc: Station granted docking: starts the landing of the controlled ship and, after 2 s, changes music to track 14 and says 13:1283 'Docking granted'; shows game tip 2 once.

comments.text: subtype 267 = the pilot/space suit
offset beside the ship

EjectFromShip.doc: From a pilot: switches into the tracked/target ship if possible. From a ship in space: creates a pilot (class 2064, subtype 10) near the ship, makes it the player and places it beside the ship. Returns 1 on success.

comments.text: lift the operation count limit while building the export
statistics are triples {id, value, ?}; ids mapped to xml names below
complexes (class 2044): price multiplied by factory count
income per hour = units*price*3600/production time
stationclass only for main types 5 and 6 (factories/stations)
wares without flag 8 are valued by average price; flagged ones are upgrades
subtypes 267, 287, 288 (pilot suits/escape) have no sale price
ship subtype -> its blueprint ware gives the hull value
notoriety for races 1..19 in mask 393790
empty signature: story file invalid, ship is destroyed with a joke message
invalid signature falls back to an unsigned file
restore the operation limit

ExportStatistics.doc: Writes the player statistics file for the community site. Builds an XML text of game info, player stats, owned stations with price/profit/inventory, headquarters blueprints, owned ships with ware values, favourite ships, destroyed objects and notoriety, signs it with SE_SignGameStats and writes PlayerStats.pck (or PlayerStats_invalid.xml). If the story file is not valid signing returns an empty string and the player ship self-destructs.

FXNotify.doc: Integrity check callback. If the stored movie notification value differs from 1907052836 (953526418*2), speaks 13:1100027 'X2 executable file has been manipulated' and 13:1100026 'Self destruct sequence initiated' and leaves.

GetClientState.doc: Returns the client state flags (m15); bit 256 blocks music changes.

GetComp2Camera.doc: Returns the camera handle of the second computer cutscene.

GetComp2Scene.doc: Returns the scene handle of the second computer cutscene.

GetCompCamera.doc: Returns the camera handle of the first computer cutscene.

GetCompScene.doc: Returns the scene handle of the first computer cutscene.

GetCut2Camera.doc: Returns the camera handle of the second cut scene.

GetCut2Scene.doc: Returns the scene handle of the second cut scene.

GetCut3Camera.doc: Returns the camera handle of the third cut scene.

GetCut3Scene.doc: Returns the scene handle of the third cut scene.

GetCutCamera.doc: Returns the camera handle of the first cut scene.

GetCutDustCamera.doc: Returns the camera handle of the dust scene.

GetCutDustScene.doc: Returns the dust scene handle of the cut.

GetCutScene.doc: Returns the scene handle of the first cut scene.

GetFavouriteShip.doc: Returns the ship subtype flown the longest.

GetGameFeatures.doc: Returns the game features bit mask; bit 131072 turns subtitles off.

GetGameStart.doc: Returns the game start object for the current start id.

GetGameStartID.doc: Returns the id of the gamestart this game was started from.

GetHUDInfo.doc: HUD flags for a ship: 1/2 = laser target mode levels, 8 = unread messages.

GetKilled.doc: Returns the killed flag of the client (m6).

GetMapGateState.doc: Asks the active galaxy map menu for the state of a gate between sectors.

GetMapSectorState.doc: Asks the active galaxy map menu (class 2228) for the state of sector x,y; 0 otherwise.

GetMapSectorVisibility.doc: Asks the active galaxy map menu whether a sector is visible.

GetModified.doc: Returns the modified flag of the game, used for unlocks.

comments.text: bug: bestAge stays -1, so each non-empty list overrides the previous

GetNewestMessage.doc: Meant to return the newest entry among unread, temporary and standard logs. The age comparison uses a constant -1 and the wrong variable, so the last non-empty list wins (standard log first priority).

GetShipUseTime.doc: Time flown with a ship subtype.

GetStartDay.doc: Returns the start day of the game.

GetWarpFactor.doc: Returns the current warp (time acceleration) factor.

GetWarpSector.doc: Destination sector packed as x<<16 | y.

GetWebUserID.doc: Returns the web user id of the client.

GetWebUserName.doc: Returns the web user name of the client.

GetXboxDefaultAssignment.doc: Maps a pad control index (0-17) to its default assignment id; stick/trigger indices 0,1,8,9 map to 2,1,4,5.

HasIncomingMessages.doc: True if there are unread messages.

comments.text: while frozen (cutscene) delay non-silent messages by 3 s
message record: {text, sender, game age, flags}
no popup/silent bits: play sample 1008 then voice 13:1333 'Incoming message'

IncomingMessage.doc: Receives a message. Flags: 1 = show popup, 2 = reduced popup, 4 = silent (log only), 8 and 12 = store in log, 16 = temporary log, 32 = plot log. Defers 3 s while the player is frozen. Otherwise queues it, pops it up and plays the new message jingle.

Init.doc: Game start entry: builds the universe via C300.Build, sends the modified flag to the engine and loads the Xbox profile if a pad is connected.

comments.text: feature bits 0x80204 set by default (bit 2 = 4, bit 9 = 512, bit 19 = 524288)
bit 17 (131072) tracks whether the game language equals the audio language

InitClient.doc: Resets client defaults (name, verbose, start day, warp factor 6, feature flags, message tables), checks file signatures and initialises the input, script, and music classes.

InitFavouriteShips.doc: Creates the per-subtype flight time array and marks the current ship as used.

comments.text: fade progress against absolute time
alpha ramps 0..255 or 255..0 depending on target alpha

Input.doc: Per-frame input hook. Detects pad use, drives the screen fade, handles leave state (returns -1/2) and runs Vbi once per real-time tick before delegating to C501.PerFrameInput.

InputAction.doc: Forwards a key action to the key handler C501.

InputHeadTracked.doc: Head tracker 3DOF input: sets the absolute POV on the monitors.

InputHeadTracked6DOF.doc: Head tracker 6DOF input forwarded to the monitors.

InputMouseDelta.doc: Raw mouse movement forwarded to the cursor class.

IsAutopilotON.doc: True if the player ship has the autopilot flag (524288).

IsFastForward.doc: Returns 1 while fast forward is active.

IsMissileApproaching.doc: True while the missile warning loop runs.

IsPlotDisabled.doc: True if the current start runs without the plot.

IsSavingPossible.doc: Saving is allowed when a cheat is active, or when not blocked (state bit 8192) and the player owns a ware (16/11, probably a save game item) or sits in a station.

IsScriptEditorActive.doc: True if game feature bit 1024 (script editor) is set.

IsWarping.doc: True while a warp is in progress.

IssueDroneOrder.doc: Gives a command to all player combat drones (class 2067) in the sector; speaks 13:131 or 13:1100045 'No fighting droids available'.

comments.text: state bits 64 and 512 block orders

IssueWingmenOrder.doc: Gives a command to all player wingmen (not the controlled ship), speaking 13:131 'Command accepted' or 13:1100042 'No wingman available'.

comments.text: view mode 258 = external view
silence the speech queue (priority 99)

Killed.doc: Player death sequence: stops fast forward, closes menus and HUD, switches to an external view, kills the player ship, then after a delay shows game over (C622).

LandPlayerShipAt.doc: Remembers the station and asks the player ship to land there.

LockThrottle.doc: Locks the throttle at the current desired speed.

LogMessage.doc: Adds a log-only message with an author tag 'LOG' (flags | 12).

MapMonitor.doc: Opens monitor N with an external view of the tracked object; samples 955 ok / 956 fail.

MovieNotify.doc: Stores a value delivered by the movie/FX layer (compared in FXNotify).

NotifyAlert.doc: Combat alert state changed: switches to combat music or back to sector music and may show game tip 7 for capturable targets.

comments.text: state bit 2048 silences attack messages
new ship after 15 s, same ship again after 45 s
task waits until speech < 50, aborts if a newer announcement replaced it
interval adaptation: if attacked again within 2x interval double it, else halve it

NotifyAttacked.doc: Announces attacks on the player's ships (13:1100019) and stations/factories (13:1100018) with the sector name, when shield <= 90% or hull <= 80%. Throttled per object (15 s other ship, 45 s same ship); station announcements use an adaptive interval doubling up to 480 s and halving down to 30 s. Waits for higher-priority speech and cutscenes.

comments.text: type 28 sub -1: fixed text id 5551

NotifyCatchWare.doc: Player picked up a ware: sample 969 and 'Cargo bay now contains <ware>' (13:1257).

NotifyCollisionWarn.doc: Collision warning: stops fast forward unless a warning came within the last 3 s (then only refreshes the timestamp).

NotifyDockingAbort.doc: Docking aborted: releases the slot, says 13:1285 'Docking aborted' and restores music.

NotifyEjectWare.doc: Player ejected a ware: sample 964 and '<ware> ejected' (13:5).

NotifyIntoLaserRange.doc: Voice 13:1258 'Target is now in firing range!'.

NotifyJumpFailed.doc: Speaks 13:1373, or 13:1374 + 13:1372 when the argument is set.

comments.text: anti-tamper/anti-piracy style check: restartCount >= 3 and 20% chance

NotifyLaserLow.doc: Voice 13:1265 'Attention. Energy low!'. After 3 restarts, 20% of calls instead run a hidden quit sequence (speech 1100023, 1100024 equivalents) unless timer 0 is 12.

comments.text: g11 = save in progress

NotifyLeave.doc: Called by the engine when the window is closed. Returns 1 when a save is running (g11) to veto; otherwise starts the leave sequence.

comments.text: closer than 125 km: continuous alarm sound, loops without delay

NotifyMissileAlert.doc: Missile warning: stops fast forward, says 13:10 'Alert: Missile closing' and, while a missile aims at the player, beeps with a period proportional to its distance (sound 1203; 1204 when closer than 125 km).

NotifyMsgBoxReturn.doc: Message box result: 30 = quit, 31 = eject, 33 = clear message logs.

NotifyNoEquipment.doc: Speaks '<equipment> not installed' (13:24), not repeated for the same item within 10 s.

NotifyNoMissileTarget.doc: Voice 13:4 'No Aim!', throttled 5 s with the same timer as NotifyNoMissiles.

NotifyNoMissiles.doc: Voice 13:13 'No missiles', throttled to once per 5 s.

NotifyPlanetCollision.doc: Stops fast forward and says 13:1266 'Danger! Entering atmosphere', throttled 5 s.

NotifyTargetLock.doc: Forwards a target lock to monitors and the HUD.

NotifyTurboOn.doc: Voice 13:1269 'Turbo engaged' in verbose mode, at most once per 5 s.

OnGamepadTextInputDismissed.doc: Steam gamepad on-screen keyboard closed: if confirmed and a text input menu (class 2252) is active, passes the typed text to it.

PauseGame.doc: Shows the pause message box, then in a fork waits one tick, pauses the game and closes the box.

PlayMessageWithPrioAndFace.doc: Same as above without noise; the computed flag value is unused and duration is 0.

PlayMessageWithPrioAndFaceAndNoise.doc: Speaks a pilot message text with priority, face and noise flags. Face mode: 0 pilot face, 1 no face, -1 pilot face with flag 8192, <0 existing object takes its face, else a face id. Not played when killed.

PlayerWantsToEject.doc: Eject key: refuses while a menu is open or state bit 16 is set; asks for confirmation if feature bit 524288 is set and the controlled ship is not a pilot (class 2064).

QuickWarp.doc: Instantly moves the player to the stored warp sector without effects (used by loading/cheats). Switches sectors only if different.

ReadMessage.doc: Removes the first unread message (the value is not returned).

ReceiveMessage.doc: Plays a question/dialog text from an object at priority 0.

ReceiveMessageWithPriority.doc: Speaks the question array textId of speaker. If no dialog menu is open it shows a comm window with the pilot's face when the pilot has a name and nothing more important is spoken.

RemoveObjFromMessages.doc: Detaches a destroyed object from queued messages (sender -> 0).

RemoveObjMessages.doc: Deletes unread messages from the object, except the one currently shown in the message menu (class 2288).

Restart.doc: Called on game (re)load: counts restarts and forwards the modified flag to the engine.

comments.text: cut camera: priority 5, flags 0x402C
scenes start in state 1 with alpha -255 (hidden)
composite scenes: camera uses a letterboxed viewport inside the screen border
game start id is passed through the string parameter of the executable
plot is disabled for custom games or when the start has no plot
if the start sector has no owner, search the first owned sector on the 24x20 map
no ship yet: create one of the start's ship type for the player
reveal all stations, gates, asteroids, debris and wrecks of the start sector

Run.doc: Starts a session. Unless arg is -100 it creates the cut, cut2, cut3, dust and composite scenes with their cameras, then forks: reads the game start (tutorial if arg > 0), places the player ship in the start sector (or the first owned sector), marks that sector's objects as known and enters it.

comments.text: voice 13:39 'Saving failed' plays when arg == 0 (in the game it means failure)

SaveFinished.doc: After a save: clears the saving flag, reloads texts, resets the savegame cache, leaves if in DID mode, else says 13:39 'Saving failed' when the argument is 0.

SelectNextMonitor.doc: Cycles the active monitor; sample 957 on success else 956 (unless state bit 4).

comments.text: state bit 64 disables autopilot
toggles which ship is controlled: >0 'Autopilot off', <0 'Autopilot activated'
13:4 'No Aim!' when nothing is tracked
equipment 19 = docking computer
cannot give commands next to a station: message 35:4602
command 12 = fly through gate
must be farther than 150 km + size from the station surface
command 7 = dock at station
13:1283 'Docking granted', 13:1264 'Autopilot activated'
13:1284 'Docking denied'
command 5 = fly to object

SetAutopilot.doc: Autopilot command handler. With arg2=0 it concerns the player ship and its tracked target; with arg2=1 the ship of the active monitor. If already on it stops; otherwise issues a gate-fly (12), dock (7) or fly-to (5) command, or starts docking via C5003 when equipment 19 is present. Speaks 13:1263 'Autopilot off' / 13:1264 'Autopilot activated'.

comments.text: mode bits 8 and 16 = views that cannot switch

SetExternalView.doc: Switches the active monitor to the default external view; re-centres POV when toggling from the same view. Shows game tip 24.

SetFocus.doc: Sets field of view in degrees and passes it to the engine as a 16.16 fraction of 360.

SetKilled.doc: Marks the player as killed (without the death sequence) and starts leaving.

comments.text: DID state 5 = save-on-exit mode, saves instead of leaving
fade to black over 500 ms unless the screen is already black

SetLeave.doc: Request leaving the game. In DID mode with the player alive it forks a save instead; otherwise fades to black and flushes the cutscene queue.

SetModified.doc: Marks the game as modified (with log) once.

SetModifiedByFile.doc: Marks modified, naming the offending file.

SetModifiedForCustomGame.doc: Marks modified with reason 'Custom game' and sets the flag to 2.

SetMonitorView.doc: Switches to the target view or toggles monitor zoom for a side monitor.

SetWebUserName.doc: Stores the player name; returns it.

comments.text: cutscene 11 with movie parameters {2224, 96}; skipped for Terran gates

ShowWarpInScene.doc: Warp-out effect: fade, cutscene 11 (2224) unless Terran gate, then moves the ship away in space.

ShowWarpOutScene.doc: Warp-in effect at the destination: plays cut 2225 unless Terran gate, fades in and places the ship.

SilentMessage.doc: Queues a message without sound or popup (flag 4).

comments.text: starts at the inverse alpha of the target

StartFade.doc: Screen fade. A duration <= 0 sets the colour at once; otherwise starts a timed fade (Input updates it).

comments.text: writes m57, which NotifyCollisionWarn also uses as its throttle timestamp

StartFastForward.doc: Starts fast forward (SETA-like) unless killed or active already; plays sample 980.

StartFreezePlayer.doc: Increments the freeze counter; the first call sets space flag 1 on the sector (freeze). Returns the new level.

StartGateWarp.doc: Player jumps through a gate: counts the jump statistic (5030), stops the jump drive and starts WarpToSector to the sector of the destination gate.

StartKilled.doc: Marks the player killed and starts the Killed sequence in a fork.

StartSectorWarp.doc: Warp to a sector at a position (jump drive style). Counts a gate-jump statistic when the first argument is set.

Stop.doc: On shutdown clears the galaxy map menu if it is the active menu.

StopFastForward.doc: Stops fast forward, plays sample 981 (unless killed) and resets the time factor to 1.0.

StopFreezePlayer.doc: Decrements the freeze counter, clearing the space flag at the last level. Returns the new level.

StoreMessage.doc: Appends the message to the temporary (16), plot (32) or standard log. Temporary log keeps at most 10 entries and discards ones older than an hour.

SwitchWeaponsGroup.doc: Assigns a laser group to the turret of the active cockpit.

comments.text: key 806 = toggle classic steering

ToggleClassicSteering.doc: Enables or disables classic (mode 2) steering; hint text 35:4601.

ToggleFastForward.doc: Toggle key. Starting requires equipment 23 (SETA) and that neither the controlled ship nor the player ship is docked; otherwise announces missing equipment.

ToggleHUD.doc: Toggles the HUD overlay unless state bit 16384 forbids it.

ToggleMonitorMode.doc: Toggles monitors 1 and 2: disconnects them or shows/hides auto-mode ones. Sample 955 if anything changed else 956.

comments.text: key 805 = toggle mouse steering

ToggleMouseSteering.doc: Enables or disables mouse (follow) steering mode; switching on cancels autopilot and shows the hint 35:4600 when a key is bound.

TrackEnemyTarget.doc: Enemy-tracking key; blocked when state bit 2 is set.

TrackNextPlayerTarget.doc: As TrackNextTarget but only objects owned by the player.

TrackNextTarget.doc: Select next/previous object. Alternates direction when the key is pressed repeatedly.

comments.text: 2 500 000 m (2500 km) is the search radius; best distance starts at the far limit going forward, 0 going backward
nothing found beyond the current one: wrap around and take the nearest/farthest
custom galaxy objects (other than class 2085) are skipped for enemy tracking

TrackPrevNext.doc: Picks the next (dir=1) or previous (dir=-1) trackable object by distance from the controlled ship and optionally makes it the monitor's tracking target. Filter 1 = enemies, 2 = own objects, 3 = flying wares, 0 = everything. Returns 1 if a target was found.

TrackTarget.doc: Targets the next object in front (monitor DoTracking) unless tracking is blocked by state bit 2.

TranslateKey.doc: Translates a virtual key through the key map.

TranslateXBoxAssignToVK.doc: Converts an assignment id to a virtual key code; arg3 selects the secondary (modifier) code. Returns nothing for none (-2).

TranslateXBoxButtonToIOKey.doc: Maps pad button index to its input key code (296-311, 490, 492).

TryLeave.doc: Exit key handler: asks for confirmation unless killed or input/control is locked, in which case it leaves at once.

UpdateFavouriteShip.doc: Adds elapsed game time to the entry of the ship type the player flies; grows the array if types were added.

comments.text: fast forward ramp: step 0..10 every 250 ms; sample 982 on each step
time factor = 1.0 + (maxFactor-1) * step/10 in 16.16 fixed point

Vbi.doc: Per-frame update. When killed only runs the cutscene player. Otherwise ramps the fast forward time factor (one step per 250 ms real time, 10 steps), updates player age, then runs the per-frame hooks of the other singletons and station announcements.

comments.text: whole warp runs in a forked task
sample 1214 for Terran gates, 983 for normal gates
warp cutscene only if feature bit 1 is set and the gate is not Terran
ship parked far away (75 000 000) during the cutscene
cutscene 3 or 'warp' variant picked by monitor mode
target is no object (position array/none): enter at given position
target is a gate object: WarpEnterSector places the ship at the gate
speech: 13:1 + 7 + sector name id
mask 393278 = races that have patrols/police in core sectors
notoriety <= -100: the patrol greets the hostile player
voice id = race*100+16 (115 for Terran/ATF mask 393216)
pilot message 640 (warning) spoken by the largest military ship of that race
55 s later, if the player is still there, the patrol is alerted (message 641)
anti-tamper: if movie probe returns something else than 2, 20% chance
speaks 13:1100027/1100026 style lines (v21*7+3/4 = 1100023+...) then quits the game

WarpToSector.doc: Core sector change routine. Runs in a fork: stops the ship, plays the warp sound and effect, optionally plays the warp cutscene (feature bit 1) with the player frozen, leaves the old sector, frees bodies, enters the new one and restarts monitors. Then announces the sector name, may have a patrol of a hostile race warn the player in its core sector (message 640/641), and has a random 20% quit check.

comments.text: assignment: -2 none, 1 and 2 and 3 = steering/strafe/etc. axis pairs

XBoxAnalogueAssignment.doc: Binds a stick (0,1) or trigger (8,9) to a control-matrix axis pair, or as a button when assigned a button function.

XBoxAssignment.doc: Applies an assignment to a control: analogue handling for 0,1,8,9, button handling otherwise.

XBoxButtonAssignment.doc: Resolves the keys for a button assignment and binds them.

XBoxButtonAssignmentToVK.doc: Rebinds a pad button to the given keys, removing old bindings including qualifier variants (|0x2000, |0x4000), then resolves qualifier conflicts.

XBoxFirstTimeLoad.doc: Applies the default Xbox pad profile once.

comments.text: axes 256..259 = sticks, 262/263 = triggers

XBoxLoadDefaultProfile.doc: Assigns all 18 pad controls their default function (-1 = default) and sets dead zones of 20 on both sticks and triggers.

XBoxPadConnectedAndEnabled.doc: True if a pad is connected and pad mode got enabled.

comments.text: only logs if modified.txt already exists; arg3 (write flag) is not tested here

__SetModified.doc: Flags the game as modified and informs the engine. If modified.txt exists it appends a block with the reason, optional file, wall time, in-game time, player, ship and location.

150.name: Client

1650.doc: An asteroid field ('debris' object, engine type 28) that holds a density of minable rocks. Rocks (class 2012 Asteroid) are created from it on demand; its density drops as rocks are mined or destroyed, and it vanishes at 0. Created by the sector setup code, class code AS(asteroid).

0.doc: asteroid field subtype (type 28)
0.name: subType

1.doc: ware main type of the resource (15)
1.name: resourceMainType

2.doc: ware subtype of the resource; 1 = Silicon
2.name: resourceSubType

3.doc: amount of rock material left in the field
3.name: density

4.doc: mining yield of the resource
4.name: yield

5.doc: current hull of the field
5.name: hull

6.doc: 1 noFind, 2 unknown, 4 hidden, 8 invincible, 16 safe-pos, 32 scanned
6.name: flags

7.doc: text id overriding the name, -1 = none
7.name: overrideNameId

Activate.doc: Activates the field with no filter (see Activate2).

comments.text: engine flags2 |= 16 (script-managed object)
safe position: engine picks a free spot near the stored one, then position is read back

Activate2.doc: Creates the engine object. mode -1 always, 0 only for fields without the safe-position flag, above 0 only for fields that have it. Applies hull, density, unknown/hidden flags and the invincibility flag.

AddTo.doc: Adds the field to the sector's debris list and activates it if the sector is loaded.

comments.text: random rotation
flags = 2: not yet discovered by the player

Create.doc: Creates the field at a position with a random rotation. Hull and density are taken from the type; it starts as unknown (flag 2).

CreateDebris.doc: When a rock of this field is destroyed, creates a DebrisCreator for it and either hands it to the engine kill call or runs it in a fork.

CreateRock.doc: Creates a Asteroid object (class 2012) for an engine rock of this field and links it to the sector. Returns the new object.

Deactivate.doc: Stores position, hull and density and frees the engine object.

Destruct.doc: Removes the field from its sector's debris list and destroys the object.

DetailSwitch.doc: Called when the engine swaps the field's subtype for a different level of detail; refreshes subtype, density and hull from the new type.

comments.text: global parameter 69 selects the formula; 1 = tuned random count
wareValueFactor = gp75 / relValue (0 if the ware has no value)
no catch when scale is 0 and gp73 is 0
default: always one ware

GetCatchWareCount.doc: How many wares a successful catch yields for a ware, using the global tuning parameters 69 to 81. Mode 1 uses a random formula that depends on the ware's relative value and the scale; any other mode returns 1.

GetDensity.doc: Density, refreshed from the engine object while active.

GetDescriptionID.doc: Description text of the resource ware 15 with subtype m8.

GetHull.doc: Current hull, refreshed from the engine object while it is active.

GetHullPercent.doc: Hull as a percentage of the type maximum.

GetMaxHull.doc: Max hull of the rock type: SA type 28 with subtype m6.

GetName.doc: Resource name text; Silicon is special cased.

GetNameID.doc: Override name id if set, otherwise the ware name of the resource (main type 15).

GetNoFind.doc: True if the field is excluded from find/search functions (flag 1).

GetObjectMenu.doc: Returns 0: asteroid fields have no object menu.

GetOverrideNameID.doc: Returns the name text id override (field 14).

GetPosOfNextRock.doc: Position and rotation (array of 6) of the rock nearest to the requester, from real rock objects or from the cut layout. Returns 0 if none.

GetResourceMainType.doc: Returns the main type of the resource the rocks yield (field 8).

GetResourceName.doc: Name of the resource in the field.

GetResourceSubType.doc: Returns the subtype of the resource the rocks yield (field 9).

GetScanned.doc: Flag bit 32 of m12: the rock has been scanned.

GetSize.doc: Engine size when active, otherwise a fixed 200000.

GetSubTypeOfNearestRock.doc: Subtype of the rock nearest to the requester, or -1 if none.

GetType.doc: Returns the type code 28 (asteroid field, debris).

GetUnknown.doc: True while the field has not been discovered (flag 2).

comments.text: engine flags2 bit 2097152 = rocks are instantiated (detail mode)

HasCollectibleRocks.doc: True if there are rocks left that can be mined, either as real rock objects (detail mode) or according to the type's rock cut layout.

comments.text: hullDamage < 0 means use the full damage value
reason 0 = normal destruction

Hit.doc: Applies damage to the hull. When the hull reaches 0 the field self-destructs after a short delay unless it is invincible.

IsCollectible.doc: True if the engine object can be collected (e.g. by tractor beam). Returns nothing when inactive.

IsDetailUsed.doc: True when the engine object exists and is in detail mode (rocks instantiated).

IsHidden.doc: Flag bit 4 of m12: hidden object.

IsSafePosOnActivate.doc: True if the position is applied as a safe position when activated (flag 16).

KilledBy.doc: Destroys the field. Invincible fields ignore it. If the type creates debris, a DebrisCreator is attached to the engine kill so debris appears with the explosion.

Remove.doc: Deactivates the field and removes it from the sector.

RemoveRock.doc: Lowers the field's density by the density of the given rock.

RemoveRockBySubType.doc: Lowers the density by the density of an asteroid of the given subtype.

SelfDestruct.doc: Removes the field without damage credit.

SetDensity.doc: Sets the density. At 0 or less the field destroys itself on the next tick (reason 21).

SetHidden.doc: Sets or clears the hidden flag (4 / engine flag 16).

SetHull.doc: Sets the hull clamped to 0..max and pushes it to the engine object. Returns the stored hull.

SetHullPercent.doc: Sets the hull from a percentage of the maximum.

SetInvincible.doc: Sets or clears invincibility (flag 8 and engine flags2 8388608).

comments.text: engine flag 8 = unknown/unidentified marker

SetKnown.doc: Marks the field as known (clears flag 2 and engine flag 8) or unknown.

SetScanned.doc: Sets or clears the scanned flag (32).

SetTargeted.doc: Targeting an unknown field reveals it.

StartSelfDestructTimer.doc: Starts a task that destroys the field after a random 15 to 45 minutes (milliseconds below).

1650.name: AsteroidField

1651.doc: Helper created when an asteroid field rock is destroyed. It remembers where the rock was and later spawns the debris objects for it from the type's debris cut. Registered in the sector's debris-creator list so that it can be fired when the explosion happens.

0.doc: sector object that owns this creator
0.name: sector

1.doc: engine object type of the destroyed object (17 rock, 28 asteroid field)
1.name: objectType

2.doc: subtype of the destroyed object
2.name: objectSubType

3.doc: array of 6 values: position and rotation of the explosion
3.name: posAndRot

4.doc: resource subtype of the asteroid field
4.name: resourceSubType

5.doc: yield of the asteroid field
5.name: yield

6.doc: first percentage passed to the debris cut (always 100)
6.name: cutScaleA

7.doc: second percentage passed to the debris cut (always 100)
7.name: cutScaleB

Create.doc: Stores the parameters and registers this creator with the sector.

CreateDebris.doc: Unregisters from the sector and asks it to add the objects of the type's debris map cut, then deletes itself.

CreateDebrisFromExplosion.doc: Replaces the stored position with the explosion location and creates the debris right away.

Destruct.doc: Returns the object itself: no script-side cleanup, so Destruct is a no-op for this class.

SelfDestruct.doc: Called by the engine when the object dies; spawns the debris.

1651.name: DebrisCreator

1652.doc: The wreckage left by a destroyed station or other wreck-producing object. It is a floating, collectible object with a hull and a density, and removes itself after a random 15 to 45 minutes once nobody is near. Created by WreckCreator through the sector's AddWreckFromType.

0.doc: engine object type of the wreck
0.name: objectType

1.doc: engine object subtype of the wreck
1.name: objectSubType

2.doc: amount of material in the wreck
2.name: density

3.doc: current hull
3.name: hull

4.doc: 1 noFind, 2 unknown, 4 hidden, 8 invincible
4.name: flags

5.doc: game age (s) when the wreck was created
5.name: createTime

6.doc: text id overriding the name, -1 = none
6.name: overrideNameId

Activate.doc: Creates the engine object with the stored hull, density, unknown/hidden flags. Returns the engine object id or 0.

AddTo.doc: Adds the wreck to the sector and activates it if the sector is loaded.

comments.text: flags = 10: invincible (8) and unknown (2)

Create.doc: Creates the wreck at a position with random rotation. Starts as unknown and invincible; records the creation time.

Deactivate.doc: Stores position, hull and density and frees the engine object.

Destruct.doc: Removes the wreck from the sector and destroys the object.

GetCreateTime.doc: Game age at which the wreck was created.

GetDensity.doc: Density, refreshed from the engine object while active.

GetDescriptionID.doc: Description of the ware type (m6, m7).

GetGSubType.doc: Returns the game subtype of the destroyed object (field 8).

GetGType.doc: Returns the game type of the destroyed object (field 7).

GetHull.doc: Current hull, refreshed from the engine object while active.

GetHullPercent.doc: Hull as a percentage of maximum.

GetMaxHull.doc: Max hull of the ware-container type (m6, m7).

GetName.doc: Name of the ware type (m6, m7).

GetNameID.doc: Override name id if set, otherwise the ware name of (type, subtype).

GetObjectMenu.doc: Returns 0: wrecks have no object menu.

GetOverrideNameID.doc: Name override id stored in m12.

GetSize.doc: Engine size when active, otherwise fixed 200000.

GetSubType.doc: Returns the subtype of the destroyed object (field 8).

GetType.doc: Returns the type of the destroyed object, kept in field 7.

GetTypeCode.doc: Returns the type code: type << 16 | subtype, both taken from the destroyed object.

IsCollectible.doc: True if the engine object is collectible. Returns nothing when inactive.

IsHidden.doc: Flag bit 4 of m10: hidden object.

IsInvincible.doc: Flag bit 8 of m10: the object cannot be destroyed.

KilledBy.doc: Destroys the wreck unless it is invincible.

Remove.doc: Deactivates and removes the wreck from its sector.

SetHull.doc: Sets the hull clamped to 0..max. Returns the stored hull.

SetKnown.doc: Marks the wreck known or unknown.

SetTargeted.doc: Targeting an unknown wreck reveals it.

StartSelfDestructTimer.doc: Starts a task that waits a random 15 to 45 minutes, then keeps waiting in 30 s steps while the engine still finds the object, then destroys the wreck.

1652.name: Wreck

1653.doc: Helper created when a station is destroyed. It keeps the type and position of the dead station and, when the explosion finishes, adds a wreck of that type to the sector.

0.doc: sector object that owns this creator
0.name: sector

1.doc: main type of the destroyed object
1.name: wreckType

2.doc: subtype of the destroyed object
2.name: wreckSubType

3.doc: array of 6 values: position and rotation of the wreck
3.name: posAndRot

Create.doc: Stores the parameters and registers this creator with the sector.

CreateWreck.doc: Unregisters from the sector, asks it to add a wreck of the stored type at the stored position and deletes itself.

Destruct.doc: Wreck object (created by Station.KilledBy). Destruct is a no-op: returns this.

SelfDestruct.doc: Called by the engine on the kill; creates the wreck.

1653.name: WreckCreator

1700.doc: A person object: a passenger, a crew speaker or a marine (page name not given). Derived from the methods: it has pilot name, voice and face, a container (ship or station), an optional passenger transport and conversation state. A person is a marine when its skill array m18 exists with a fighting skill above 0; m18 holds mechanics (index 8), hacking (9), engineering (10) and fighting (11). Created by the ship boarding code (class 2073) and by CreateFromShip from a pilot.

0.doc: ship or station the person is inside; sector and position come from it
0.name: container

1.doc: object this person works for, set by SetOccupation
1.name: occupation

10.doc: game age when the person was created
10.name: creationTime

11.doc: statistics counters keyed by stat id (8010..8090)
11.name: marineStats

12.doc: ship this person is boarding, set by the boarded ship
12.name: boardingShip

2.doc: table of active conversation nodes, keyed by object
2.name: conversations

3.doc: parameters of each conversation in m109
3.name: conversationParams

4.doc: destination of passenger transport, 0 when none
4.name: passengerDestination

5.doc: payment for the passenger transport
5.name: passengerPayment

6.doc: price in credits to buy this marine
6.name: marineBuyPrice

7.doc: base marine price, random 10000..14999 when first needed
7.name: marineBasePrice

8.doc: ship this marine is heading to board
8.name: marineBoardTarget

9.doc: voice id of the marine, from owner race and gender
9.name: marineVoice

AssignMarineVoice.doc: Chooses the marine voice from the owner's race and this person's gender.

comments.text: subtype 274 of the person object
creation time is the current game age (g8)
marine statistics are initialised with zero (8010, 8020, 8030, 8040, 8070, 8080, 8090)

Create.doc: Creates a person from the parent ship class with subtype 274. arg1 is the name, arg2 the owner index in g7, arg3 the voice and arg4 the face. Resets the marine state and records the creation time. Returns this.

comments.text: owner mask 638208: the owner is taken from the subrace table g7

CreateFromShip.doc: Creates a person from the pilot of ship arg1: copies the pilot's name, voice, face, skills and aggression. The owner becomes the ship's true owner, or the owner by subrace when the owner is a faction-type object.

Destruct.doc: Removes the person from the marine boarding table of its target, from its container speakers and from the player's marine list, then calls the parent Destruct.

comments.text: suit object is created with launch flag 267

EjectSpaceSuitFrom.doc: Leaves ship arg1 in a space suit: creates a pod object (class 2064) at the ship's position, makes this person its pilot speaker and sets the status to 6. Marines get the owner set and the suit upgrade 16/17 when available.

comments.text: named person: answer ids 25000..25099 and 25150 use the container id to select text ids 20002..20049
node 20: answer 10021 is added

GetAnswers.doc: Appends answer ids for node arg1 to the answer array arg2 at index arg3 and returns the new index. The named person gets 2 or 3 answers chosen from the text table, plus a closing answer 10049 or 10050. Other persons take answers from the conversation (GetMDAnswers) and the parent. Node 20 adds answer 10021.

GetCreationTime.doc: Game age when this person was created (m117).

GetEnvironment.doc: Container, used as the environment object.

GetLocation.doc: Object where this person is: the container, or when the person is in a boarding state, the boarding target, or the boarded ship when the container is gone.

GetLocationDisplay.doc: Location as text for the player: the sector name for statuses 6 and 10, otherwise 'object (sector)' or just the object name.

GetMarineBoardTarget.doc: Ship this marine is heading to board (m115).

GetMarineVoice.doc: Voice id of the marine; assigned on first use.

GetNextTrainingCost.doc: Credit cost of training arg2 steps of skill arg1. Skill 4 is the sum of skills 1 to 3 times 6/5.

GetNextTrainingDuration.doc: Training time of arg2 steps of skill arg1, in the same units as the cost. Skill 4 is the sum of skills 1 to 3 times 6/5.

GetOverallMarineSkill.doc: Average of the four marine skills (fighting, hacking, mechanics, engineering). Nothing for non-marines.

GetPosInSector.doc: Position in the sector of the container, or nothing.

comments.text: named person: the node depends on the in-game hour: node 25167 in a 8 hour window, otherwise 25150

GetQuestion.doc: Dialog node for a question to this person. Special named persons (name from text 35:1102561) get fixed nodes by the in-game day cycle (25150, 25167, 25151), or 20001..20099 questions shifted by 5000. Node 0 and answers 10020/10021 return 26. Other questions use the conversation nodes, then the parent.

GetQuestionArray.doc: Speech sequence for question arg1. Non-negative ids use the parent. Negative ids are text ids that get their text array from the game; a player-owned person gives nothing.

GetQuestionBody.doc: Body (model) type for the question text, taken from the container's type and subtype; -1 without a container.

GetRandomMarinePrice.doc: Buy price of the marine: base price m114 plus 500 per point of the first 70 skill points and 2500 for each point beyond 70.

GetSector.doc: Sector of the container, or nothing when there is no container.

GetSkillLevel.doc: Skill by number: 1 hacking (m18[9]), 2 mechanics (m18[8]), 3 engineering (m18[10]). Other numbers return nothing.

IncMarineStats.doc: Adds arg2 to the statistic arg1 in m118 and refreshes the buy price.

IsFemale.doc: True when the female flag (bit 32768 of m13) is set.

IsMarine.doc: True when the person has a skill array with a fighting skill above 0 (m18[11]).

IsPassengerTransport.doc: True when a passenger transport with a payment and an existing destination is set.

ReassignMarineBuyPrice.doc: Recomputes the buy price from the skills.

SetAsFemale.doc: Sets the female flag (bit 32768 in m13).

SetBoarding.doc: Sets the ship this person is boarding (m119).

SetMarineBoardTarget.doc: Sets the ship this marine is heading to board (m115).

SetMarineStat.doc: Sets skill arg1 of the skill array to arg2, capped at 100. Negative values are ignored. Fighting skill 0 is not written.

SetPassengerTransport.doc: Sets the passenger transport: destination arg1 and payment arg2.

SetToMarine.doc: Sets the four marine skills directly: arg1 fighting, arg2 hacking, arg3 mechanics, arg4 engineering. Does nothing for invincible persons.

TrainToMarine.doc: Turns a person into a marine: creates the skill array with random values (fighting 1..40, the others 0..14), a buy price and a voice. Does nothing for marines or invincible persons.

1700.name: Person

200.doc: Speech, voice-over, music and sound control. dobj name: X_AUDIO. Speech is played as movie voice streams (MOV_ natives) with optional subtitles and face/mood clips; music tracks are movie handles. Used everywhere the game speaks or plays a sound; created via Set() from _Init.

0.doc: countdown of PlayMusicWithFade attempts while a fade is still running
0.name: musicRetryCounter

1.doc: face animation state: 1 idle, 2 after speech, 3 reset, 0 or 4 none
1.name: idleFaceState

10.doc: movie handle of the voice line being spoken
10.name: currentVoiceStream

11.doc: last master volume set, 0..255
11.name: masterVolume

12.doc: set to 0 by FadeSFXOut, otherwise unused here (probably a leftover)
12.name: sfxFadeFlag

13.doc: 1 while FadeSFXOut is lowering the FX volume
13.name: sfxFadeActive

14.doc: face clip table keyed by mood id (101..107, 501, 601); each entry = start and end min,sec,ms
14.name: faceTimings

17.doc: movie handle / track id now playing; -1 fading out, -2 stopped by fade
17.name: currentMusicTrack

18.doc: 1 while WaitForEndOfTrack waits for the current track to finish
18.name: waitForTrackEnd

19.doc: 1 while the SFX engage loop runs
19.name: engageLoopActive

2.doc: 1 while the credits movie plays
2.name: creditsActive

20.doc: 1 from start of SFX_Engage until the engage cycle ends
20.name: engageStarted

3.doc: task ids waiting to speak, FIFO
3.name: speechQueueTasks

4.doc: text page of the speech being played (0 = none)
4.name: speechPage

5.doc: text id of the speech being played; nonzero while speaking
5.name: speechId

6.doc: priority of the speech being played; higher wins
6.name: speechPriority

7.doc: bit 1 = movie array playing, bit 2 = stop requested
7.name: movieState

8.doc: task id that started the current movie array
8.name: movieOwnerTask

9.doc: movie handles per voice stream: [1] language+100, [2] language+200
9.name: voiceStreams

ChangeTrackMusic.doc: Loops a track from a new fork (non-blocking).

ChangeTrackMusicDelayed.doc: Waits 2 s and then loops the track in a fork.

ChangeTrackToCombatMusic.doc: Picks combat music: the sector's combat track, else the current track if it is one of the combat list, else a random combat track.

comments.text: client state flag 256 blocks music changes

ChangeTrackToSectorMusic.doc: Picks music for the player's current sector: the sector's own track (C3001 environment track), else the track for the environment type. Does nothing while the client state flag 256 is set.

comments.text: format string syntax: {count} or {a,b} inside the text chooses sub-entries

ConvertFormatArray.doc: Expands a speech spec array of (page, id) pairs, including {page,id,...} format groups, into a flat list of page/id pairs. Recursive.

comments.text: track = 19 + hash of x, y mod 22

EnvironmentToMusicTrack.doc: Returns the music track for an environment object: its own track if set, else a track derived from its position; random ambient track when no environment. Returns 13 when the player is killed.

FadeSFXOut.doc: Fades the FX volume down over about 0.7 s in a fork, stopping when m13 is cleared.

comments.text: BUG (probably): result of SFX_GetFXVolume is not returned, callers get nothing

GetFXVolume.doc: Intended to return the FX volume; currently returns nothing.

GetIdleFaceState.doc: Returns the idle face animation state.

GetLanguage.doc: Returns the current speech language id.

GetMasterVolume.doc: Returns the master volume last set.

GetSampleLength.doc: Returns the voice sample length (ms) for a text id in the current language.

GetSpeechPriority.doc: Returns the priority of the current speech, or -1000 when silent.

LoopMusic.doc: Plays a track looped without a fade.

MusicFadeIn.doc: Raises the volume of a music movie to the MOD volume over the given time (ms).

MusicFadeOut.doc: Lowers the volume of a music movie over the given time (ms), then stops it.

PlayCredits.doc: Plays the credits movie (movie 9) in a fork until it ends or AbortCredits is called.

PlayMovieArrayDirect.doc: Plays an array of movie clips (each {wait flag, movie, from, to...}) in order, taking over the movie channel from any other task. Returns 1 when all clips played, 0 when interrupted or on failure.

PlayMusicToEnd.doc: Lets the current track finish: after 3 s clears the track id so no new track is started.

comments.text: MOD volume <= 5 turns music off
track id is also used as the movie handle; MOV_LoadMovie with flags 144
playback failed: stop looping

PlayMusicWithFade.doc: Core music switcher: fades the current track out (if fade > 0), loads the track id as a movie, fades in and loops it while arg3 is set. track 0 stops the music. Ignores the request when the MOD volume is <= 5 or the track is already playing.

PlaySample.doc: Plays one sound id in a fork.

comments.text: flag 4096: use the special face clips 501/601
flag 2: append the final face clip 501 at the end of the speech

PlaySpeechFaceDirect.doc: Builds the face-clip sequence for a speech of the given length (ms) with random face variants and plays it. Returns the result of PlayMovieArrayDirect.

PlaySpeechScript.doc: Plays a speech line with mood 0 via PlaySpeechScriptWithMood.

comments.text: id 9 = close the comm window and clear the face
no voice file: duration is taken from the on-screen text (GetTextDisplayDuration)

PlaySpeechScriptWithMood.doc: Plays one speech line with a face clip. Looks up the voice length; if no voice file exists it falls back to a duration derived from the text. Returns the id on success, 0 if the face clip could not start.

SFX_EndEngage.doc: Stops the engage loop by clearing m19.

comments.text: start 934, loop 935, end 936

SFX_Engage.doc: Starts the engage sound sequence in a fork: sound 934 at start, loop 935 while m19 is set, and end sound 936 when the loop stops.

SFX_Stress.doc: Debug stress test: starts 1000 forks that play random sounds in a loop. Not used in normal play (probably).

comments.text: speaker 13: 1276 = Emergency Signal from, 1333 = Incoming message, 1278 = We are scanned, 1340 = We are being hailed

SampleIncomingTransmission.doc: Speaks the incoming-transmission phrase for a transmission type: 1360 emergency signal, 1361 incoming message, 1363 scanned, default being hailed.

comments.text: face timing table: keys 101..107 are the three random face clips of moods 0..2, 501 and 601 are special clips; {m1,s1,ms1, m2,s2,ms2} = start and end of the clip
music type 3 selected

Set.doc: Initialises audio at game start: volume 255, voice stream table, face timings, language and the music type 3 with the speech movie.

SetIdleFaceState.doc: Stores the idle face animation state (m1).

comments.text: voice streams are language+100 and language+200; fallback language 44 uses 144 and 244
no voice data at all: language 0

SetLanguage.doc: Sets the speech language: frees old voice movies, loads voice info for the language (fallback 44), and loads the two voice movies for the new language.

SetMasterVolume.doc: Sets the master volume and stores it in m11.

comments.text: GAME FEATURE bit 131072 disables subtitles
page 17 is timed by text length instead of voice length

ShowSubTitle.doc: Builds the subtitle from the (page, id) pairs and shows it in the comm window. Skipped when the game features disable subtitles or the duration argument is <= -50.

Speak.doc: Speaks one (page, id) line with priority 0.

SpeakArray.doc: Speaks a list of (page, id) pairs with priority 0.

SpeakArrayWithPriority.doc: Speaks a list of (page, id) pairs with the given priority.

SpeakArrayWithPriorityAndFace.doc: Speaks a list with priority and face id.

SpeakArrayWithPriorityAndFaceAndDuration.doc: Like the subtitle variant without subtitles: speaks a list with face and an optional time-warped duration.

comments.text: subtitle text is shown here and not per line
first clip (noise flag 1), middle clips (0), last clip (2)

SpeakArrayWithPriorityAndFaceAndDuration.doc: Speaks a list with face, stretches the time warp so the whole list lasts the given duration (ms), and shows the subtitles. Two-line lists use the single-line noise flag 3; longer lists use the first/middle/last flags 1, 0, 2.

SpeakArrayWithPriorityAndFaceAndNoise.doc: Speaks each (page, id) pair in the list with the given face and noise flag, showing its subtitle first.

SpeakWithPriority.doc: Speaks one (page, id) line with the given priority.

SpeakWithPriorityAndFace.doc: Speaks one line with priority and face/mood id; no duration override.

comments.text: page 0 and id 0 = silent line, no voice is played
voice file found: its stream is m9[stream]; otherwise duration comes from the text
station computer page 1271: random beep sounds 930..932 (flag 1 at start, flag 2 at end)
wait for the voice to end, or for the duration when no movie plays
superseded by a newer line: state reset and return 0

SpeakWithPriorityAndNoise.doc: Core speech routine: waits its turn in the speech queue (m3), handles priority interruption, starts the face clip and voice movie, and waits for the voice to finish. arg4 is a flag mask (1, 2 = station computer beep; 32768/65536 = radar overlay control; 131072 = no voice movie), arg5 1 = no face clip. Returns 1 when played, 0 if pre-empted.

StartMusic.doc: Plays a track once, with an optional fade-in time.

StopMusic.doc: Stops the music with an optional fade-out time.

comments.text: 1326 = {1} object on target; 1327 = {1} {2} with Greek letter

Targeted.doc: Announces a target: speaker 13 phrase 1326 (object on target) or 1327 with a Greek letter and extra arg when given.

WaitAndSpeakArrayWithPriority.doc: Waits until the current speech ends, then speaks the list.

WaitForEndOfSpeak.doc: Blocks until no speech is playing.

WaitForEndOfSpeakPriority.doc: Blocks while speech of at least the given priority is playing.

WaitForEndOfTrack.doc: Blocks while the given track is still the current track.

200.name: XAudio

2001.doc: A galaxy sector (page 2006: Sector; dobj SECTOR). Holds tables of everything inside it (ships, stations, gates, asteroids, nebulas, suns, planets, wares, wrecks), owner race, background, visibility/activation state and the NPC economy/military statistics used by the race logic. Activate creates the 3D scenes and brings all contained objects into the engine when the player is present.

comments.text: scene 600 is the 3D scene wrapper class
galaxy scene flag 4 and tiny system scale 1e-5 for the far backdrop
SetState(2001, 1, 0) shows the scene
background star/nebula instances are managed in a forked task

Activate.doc: Brings the sector into the 3D engine. Creates the sector, galaxy-background and dust scenes, activates suns, planets, nebulas, gates, stations, asteroids, wrecks, ships (ships without a safe position first), spawns asteroid swarms and starts the galaxy background task. Reference counted; returns the engine sector object id.

ActorHasMissionOffer.doc: Returns the mission type offered by the actor, or -1.

AddAsteroid.doc: Adds an asteroid to the sector and sets this sector as its environment.

AddCustomGalObj.doc: Adds a custom galaxy object (page 2006 class 1001) to the sector.

AddDebris.doc: Adds a debris object to the sector and sets this sector as its environment.

AddDebrisCreator.doc: Registers an object that creates debris in this sector. Creators are not environment-linked.

AddDesiredJobShipsByJob.doc: Adds a delta to the desired ship count of a job in this sector.

AddDock.doc: Adds a dock: registers it as a station, resource trader and for player ownership/visibility.

AddFactory.doc: Adds a factory and registers its products and resources with the GodEngine economy tables.

AddFlyingWare.doc: Adds a flying ware (a cargo object in space) to the sector and sets this sector as its environment.

AddGate.doc: Adds a gate, setting its bit in gateIdMask and slot in gateByDirection.

comments.text: ships of the player (owner g8) raise the visible count

AddLandedShip.doc: Registers a ship landed on a station. The player's landed ships raise the visible count; class 2033 ships are added to the landed list.

AddLandedShips.doc: Registers each ship docked in the container with the sector (visibility of player ships).

AddLocalShipCountByJob.doc: Adds a delta to the local ship count of a job in this sector.

AddMissionOfferType.doc: Registers an actor as offering a mission of the given type bit.

AddNebula.doc: Adds a nebula and records its inner range if it reduces visibility.

AddNumStartFactories.doc: Adds to the count of start factories of this sector.

comments.text: object main type: 17 asteroid, 28 custom object (1650), 8-16 ware in space (2084)

AddObjectsFromCut.doc: Populates the sector from a 3D scene file ('cut') by spawning an object for each path body: asteroids (17), custom objects (28) or floating wares (8-16). Each gets a count/yield scaled by percent between minPercent and maxPercent.

AddPlanet.doc: Adds a planet to the sector and sets this sector as its environment.

AddShip.doc: Adds a ship, filing it by class: 2134 moveable, 2135 stationary, else other. Registers carriers' docked ships.

AddSun.doc: Adds a sun to the sector and sets this sector as its environment.

comments.text: a sector without an owner gets race 8 of gRaces (probably the neutral race)
editor flag bit 1 = the sector is in the galaxy

AddToGalaxy.doc: Adds the sector to the galaxy. A sector without an owner gets race 8 (g7[8]), then the in-galaxy flag (editor flag bit 1) is set.

AddVisible.doc: Increments visibleCount, marks the sector known and rebuilds local ships on first visibility with focus.

AddWreck.doc: Adds a wreck to the sector and sets this sector as its environment.

AddWreckCreator.doc: Registers an object that creates wrecks in this sector.

AddWreckFromType.doc: Creates a wreck object (class 1652) for a destroyed object type, if that type leaves a wreck.

CleanUpMissionOffers.doc: Removes mission offer entries whose actor no longer exists or is now active in 3D.

CountLandedPlayerShips.doc: Recursively counts player-owned ships docked in a container, optionally of a class.

comments.text: six gate slots
five mission offer tables
default mission quotas 100% each

Create.doc: Initialises an empty sector at the given galaxy coordinates, resetting all object tables and state.

Deactivate.doc: Reference-counted shutdown of the 3D sector: runs pending debris/wreck creators, deactivates all contained objects, destroys swarms and 2085 objects, frees the scenes and engine sector.

Destruct.doc: Destroys all contained objects and resets visibility state.

comments.text: flags 0x200000 | 0x400000 (backdrop rendering flags)
clear engine flag 128, then re-set 64 periodically

DoGalaxyTake.doc: Task that creates the star and nebula background instances of the galaxy scene and then keeps the engine flag 64 set every 10 s (scaled by warp multiplier) while the sector is active.

EvaluateMissionQuota.doc: True if the number of current offers of the (single-bit) mission type is below the global limit (parameter 85+type) scaled by the sector's quota percent.

FindAsteroid.doc: Searches asteroids. Params: resource sub type (-1 any), yield filter (positive = at least, negative = at most), flags (65536 only scanned, 2097152 skip unknown plus FindShip's distance/random/array flags), reference object, max distance, max count, x/y/z.

FindDebris.doc: Searches debris objects by resource sub type and yield limit; flag 65536 requires scanned, 32768 requires collectible rocks.

FindFlyingWare.doc: Searches wares floating in space by main type and sub type (-1 any), with the usual distance/random/array flags.

FindGateObject.doc: Finds gate(s) and jumpbeacons in the sector. Flags: 4096 include beacons, 33554432 sort by distance, 16777216 random pick, 1073741824 return array, 4194304 use x/y/z instead of the reference object, 2097152 skip unknown, 262144 skip hidden, 16384 only jumpable for `jumper`, 8192 fall back to nearest gate in galaxy. Returns an object, an array or 0.

FindNearestMilitaryOutpost.doc: Finds the station owned by the given race, of a military-outpost type (flag 1 in the table g40), with the shortest route from this sector. Returns the station or 0.

FindNebula.doc: Searches nebulas by sub type (-1 any) and effect mask (32768 shield, 65536 hull, 131072 visibility reduction), with the usual distance/random/array flags.

comments.text: flag 1048576: use the slower variant that also scans docked ships
relation filter flags: 134217728 enemy, 268435456 neutral, 536870912 friendly
flag 32768: only ships of the reference object's wing

FindShip.doc: Searches ships in the sector. Params: owner race id, class id, type code (-1 any), flags, reference object, max distance, max count, x/y/z. Flags: 1048576 include docked, 1073741824 return array, 33554432 sort by distance, 16777216 random pick, 4194304 use x/y/z, 262144 skip hidden, 524288 race-logic ships only, 131072 docking allowed for reference, 32768 same wing, 134217728/268435456/536870912 enemy/neutral/friend filter. Returns a ship, an array or 0.

comments.text: possible bug: with flag 524288 this skips ships that ALLOW race logic control, the opposite of FindShip/FindStation which skip those that do not

FindShipInObj.doc: Searches ships docked inside a carrier/station/sector object. Params: container, race id, class id, type code, flags, reference object, max count, required owner object. Same flag semantics as FindShip.

FindStation.doc: Searches docks and factories in the sector with the same parameter layout and flags as FindShip (race, class, type code, flags, reference, max distance, max count, x/y/z).

comments.text: walks square rings of radius `ring` around the sector (first ring uses a 3 count), checking each sector's docks, then factories

FindStationInGalaxy.doc: Searches for a station in expanding rings of sectors around this one, up to maxJumps route length. Filters by owner race, class, type code (or ware category with flag 0x80000000), factory id and docking permission for the reference ship. Flag 67108864 requires exactly maxJumps. Returns a station, an array or 0.

GetAvrMilitaryState.doc: Smoothed average strength of the given group.

GetCurrentMilitaryState.doc: Current strength of the given group, from militaryState.

GetDebris.doc: Returns the debris table of the sector (field 14).

GetDescription.doc: Localised sector description from page 19, or an empty string.

GetDesiredJobShipCount.doc: Returns the whole table of desired ship counts per job.

GetDesiredJobShipCountByJob.doc: Returns how many ships of a job the sector wants; a negative stored value is clamped to 0.

GetDustScene.doc: Returns the dust particle 3D scene of the sector (field 42, probably).

GetEastGate.doc: Returns the gate on the east side (gate slot 3).

comments.text: skip docks of race 10 unless includePirateDocks is set

GetEconomyStatus.doc: Aggregates stock, max storage and per-hour flow for wares over all factories (and docks). Returns {productsTable, resourcesTable, stationCount}, each entry {stock, capacity, flow}.

GetEditorFlags.doc: Returns the editor flag word. Bit 1 (value 1) means the sector is in the galaxy.

GetEnvironment.doc: Sectors are not inside another object: returns 0.

GetFactoriesPlayer.doc: Returns the table of player-owned factories (field 26).

GetFlyingWares.doc: Returns the table of flying wares (field 13).

GetGalaxyScene.doc: Returns the galaxy map 3D scene (field 41, probably).

GetGate.doc: Gate object with the given gate id (0 N, 1 S, 2 W, 3 E).

GetGateDirXY.doc: Returns the gate in the direction of the (dx, dy) step: east for dx>0, west for dx<0, south for dy>0, north for dy<0.

GetGateIDs.doc: Returns the gate id table of the sector (field 12).

GetGates.doc: Returns the warp gate table of the sector (field 10).

GetLocalShipCount.doc: Returns the table of local ship counts per job.

GetLocalShipCountByJob.doc: Returns the number of ships of a job that are currently in this sector.

GetMissionOfferArray.doc: Returns a flat array [objectId, type, ...] for all mission offerers, or 0 if none.

GetMissionQuotaBuild.doc: Returns the build mission quota of the sector (index 2).

GetMissionQuotaFight.doc: Returns the fight mission quota of the sector (index 1).

GetMissionQuotaThink.doc: Returns the think mission quota of the sector (index 3).

GetMissionQuotaTrade.doc: Returns the trade mission quota of the sector (index 0).

GetMissionQuotas.doc: Returns the mission quotas of the sector (trade, fight, build and think counts).

GetMusicTrack.doc: Returns the music track id of the sector.

GetName.doc: Localised sector name from page 7, or 'Sector XX-YY' if no text exists.

GetNebulaRanges.doc: Returns the nebula range table of the sector (field 47).

GetNextFreeFactoryID.doc: Returns the lowest factory id (numbering) not yet used by a factory of the same text-id group in this sector.

GetNorthGate.doc: Returns the gate on the north side (gate slot 0).

GetNumStartFactories.doc: Returns the number of factories that the galaxy start placed in this sector.

GetObjectID.doc: Returns the native sector handle (field 34), 0 when the sector is not loaded.

GetObjectInSector.doc: Walks up the environment chain and returns the object that is directly in this sector (or 0 if the object is gone).

GetObjectsPlayer.doc: Returns the table of player-owned objects (field 23).

GetOwner.doc: Returns the owner race object of the sector (field 2).

GetPlanets.doc: Returns the planet table of the sector (field 4).

GetPlayerObjectCount.doc: Counts player objects here (optionally of a class), including player ships docked inside stations and carriers.

GetPopulation.doc: Returns the population value of the sector (field 39, probably).

GetRelation.doc: Relation of an object to this sector: 1 if the object's owner owns the sector, -1 if the sector owner's notoriety toward the object's owner is at or below the hostility threshold (-100 in core sectors, else -10000), 0 otherwise.

GetScriptVariable.doc: Returns one script variable of this sector by name, or nothing when there are no variables.
