GetScriptVariables.doc: Returns the table of script variables kept on this sector.

GetSector.doc: Returns the sector itself; objects use it to find their sector.

GetSectorScene.doc: Returns the 3D scene of the sector (field 40, probably the local space).

GetShips.doc: Returns the ship table of the sector (field 3).

GetShipsIncludingDocked.doc: Returns a table of all ships in space plus every ship docked in carriers and stations.

GetShipsMoveable.doc: Returns the table of moveable ships (field 21).

GetShipsOthers.doc: Returns the table of other ships (field 22).

GetShipsPlayer.doc: Returns the table of player-owned ships (field 24).

GetShipsStationary.doc: Returns the table of stationary ships (field 20, probably ships that do not move).

GetSouthGate.doc: Returns the gate on the south side (gate slot 1).

GetStations.doc: Returns the station table of the sector (field 19).

GetStationsPlayer.doc: Returns the table of player-owned stations (field 25).

GetSuns.doc: Returns the sun table of the sector (field 5).

GetTradeStats.doc: Returns the trade statistics table of the sector (probably).

GetUnknown.doc: Returns the sector's unnamed flag word (m37); purpose not known.

GetVisible.doc: Returns the visibility flag of the sector (field 38).

GetVisited.doc: Returns the visited marker of this sector.

GetWarObjectID.doc: Returns the war map object id if this sector is a war sector, else nothing.

GetWareAmount.doc: Returns the ware amount value of the sector (probably).

GetWestGate.doc: Returns the gate on the west side (gate slot 2).

GetWings.doc: Returns a table of all wings of ships in this sector that belong to the given owner.

GetWrecks.doc: Returns the wreck table of the sector (field 15).

GetYourName.doc: Returns the display name of the sector (same as GetName).

HasJumpableGate.doc: True if any gate in the sector is jumpable for the given ship.

HasJumpableJumpbeacon.doc: True if any jumpbeacon (class 2062) in the sector is jumpable for the given ship.

HasMissionOffer.doc: Returns {type, actor} if the object is (or contains) a mission offerer, else {-1, 0}.

HasTerranGate.doc: True when one of the sector's gates is a Terran gate.

HasUpdateFocus.doc: True when the update focus counter of the sector is non-zero (m46 != 0; meaning of the focus not known).

comments.text: flag bit 4: core sector

IsCoreSector.doc: True when sector flag bit 4 is set (core sector).

IsEnemy.doc: True if the relation of the object's owner to this sector's owner is hostile.

comments.text: flag bit 8: job initialisation disabled

IsJobInitDisabled.doc: True when sector flag bit 8 is set, so jobs are not initialised here.

IsJumpable.doc: True if the ship can leave through a gate or beacon here, or if the sector has no jump exit at all (no Terran gate, no jumpable gate, no beacon), in which case jumping is allowed.

IsObservedByPlayer.doc: True if the sector is active in 3D, or has update focus and visible player objects.

IsVisible.doc: True when the visible count of the sector is above zero (probably counts the player's ships here).

comments.text: ignore NPC-restricted pirate-style stations and Xenon/Khaak (mask 192) owners
special case: ware type 11 produced from resource 1048577 is scaled by 603729 (about 0.0092 in 16.16 fixed point)
secondary resources (class 2044 stations skipped) are consumed at a nominal rate
ware main types 8, 9, 10, 16 consume 6, others 12
only docks owned by races in mask 262718 (the trading races) add demand

RefreshEconomyStats.doc: Rebuilds tradeStats (per ware: production, consumption, stock, resource stock, best-store) from all NPC factories, plus trade-dock demand, and wareAmounts from NPC ship cargo. Yields via TI_Delay(1) twice to spread the work. Values are per 3600 s.

comments.text: skip classes 2038, 2032, 2136 (probably non-combat objects)
carriers (2033) also count their docked fighters (2034)
average = (4*old + new)/5

RefreshFightStats.doc: Recomputes the military strength of every race group in the sector: sums ship strength/1000 for allied (+) and hostile (-) ships per group 1-19, then updates militaryState with a 4:1 moving average.

RemoveAsteroid.doc: Removes an asteroid from the sector and clears its environment.

RemoveCustomGalObj.doc: Removes a custom galaxy object from the sector.

RemoveDebris.doc: Removes a debris object from the sector and clears its environment.

RemoveDebrisCreator.doc: Unregisters a debris creator from this sector.

RemoveDock.doc: Removes a dock from the sector: from the docks and the stations tables, from the station list of the galaxy, and it releases the ships that were landed on it.

RemoveFactory.doc: Removes a factory from the sector: from the factories and the stations tables, from the station list of the galaxy, and releases its landed ships.

RemoveFlyingWare.doc: Removes a flying ware from the sector and clears its environment.

comments.text: custom galaxy objects (m18) are destroyed with the other tables
clears the owner (field 2)
clears editor flag bit 1 (in galaxy)

RemoveFromGalaxy.doc: Destroys the object tables of the sector (ships, planets, suns, docks, factories, asteroids, nebulas, gates, flying wares, debris, wrecks, custom objects, stations and so on) and clears the in-galaxy flag and the owner.

RemoveGate.doc: Removes a gate; another gate with the same id (if any) takes over the slot, else the id bit is cleared.

RemoveLandedShip.doc: Reverse of AddLandedShip: lowers the visible count for the player's ships and removes class 2033 ships from the landed list.

RemoveLandedShips.doc: Unregisters each ship docked in the container.

RemoveMissionOfferType.doc: Removes an actor from the offers of the given type bit.

RemoveNebula.doc: Removes a nebula from the sector and recalculates the nebula ranges.

RemovePlanet.doc: Removes a planet from the sector and clears its environment.

comments.text: class 2033 ships carry landed ships, which are released here

RemoveShip.doc: Removes a ship from the sector tables (all ship tables), clears its environment and notifies the owner change. A class 2033 ship also releases its landed ships.

RemoveSun.doc: Removes a sun from the sector and clears its environment.

comments.text: the count never goes below zero

RemoveVisible.doc: Decrements the visible count of the sector, never below zero.

RemoveWreck.doc: Removes a wreck from the sector and clears its environment.

RemoveWreckCreator.doc: Unregisters a wreck creator from this sector.

ResetBackground.doc: Resets the sector background to a given type and re-reads the chosen star and nebula indices from the engine.

ResetVisible.doc: Recomputes visibleCount from player objects, including landed ships, and rebuilds local ships if the sector just became visible.

SetBackgroundType.doc: Sets the background type of the sector. A loaded sector is updated at once through the native sector handle.

SetBgNebulaIndex.doc: Sets the background nebula index of the sector. A loaded sector is updated at once.

SetBgStarsIndex.doc: Sets the background stars index of the sector. A loaded sector is updated at once.

SetCoreSector.doc: Sets or clears the core-sector flag (4).

SetDesiredJobShipCount.doc: Replaces the table of desired ship counts per job.

SetFlags.doc: Sets the sector flags word. Bit 4 is core sector, bit 8 disables job initialisation.

SetJobInitDisabled.doc: Sets or clears the flag that disables job initialisation in this sector.

SetKnown.doc: Marks the sector known/unknown to the player and refreshes the galaxy map menu (class 2228) if open.

SetLocalShipCount.doc: Replaces the table of local ship counts per job.

SetMissionQuotas.doc: Sets the percent quotas for trade, fight, build and think missions.

SetMusicTrack.doc: Sets the music track id played in this sector.

SetNoEvents.doc: Sets or clears the no-events flag (2).

SetOwner.doc: Sets the owner race, mirroring it into the galaxy map data (GS_SetSectorOwner).

SetPopulation.doc: Sets the population value of the sector (field 39, probably).

SetScriptVariable.doc: Sets script variable `name` to a value array; an array whose first element is 0 deletes the variable and frees the table when empty.

comments.text: size is pushed to the native sector (object id in m34) when it exists

SetSize.doc: Sets the sector size and passes it to the native sector when it exists.

SetUpdateFocus.doc: Increments/decrements the update-focus counter (player or camera interest). On first focus of a visible sector rebuilds local ships; notifies ships that their environment has focus.

SetVisited.doc: Sets the visited flag, updating the visited-sectors statistic (5020) of the player race and checking sector-visit achievements. The temporary sector is never marked.

ShipOwnerChanged.doc: Updates the player-ships tables and visibility when a ship changes owner.

StationOwnerChanged.doc: Updates the player-owned station/object/factory tables and visibility when a station changes owner.

StopGalaxyTake.doc: Frees the background instances and kills the DoGalaxyTake task.

UpdateNebulaRanges.doc: Rebuilds nebulaRanges as [pos, innerRange] pairs for nebulas that reduce visibility.

UpdateRelations.doc: Asks all stations and ships to refresh their relations.

__FindShipIncludingDocked.doc: FindShip variant that also descends into carriers (2033) and stations (2016, 2006, 2007) to include docked ships.

__destroyObjectTable.doc: Self-destructs (reason 17) every object in the table, each in its own forked task.

2001.name: Sector

2002.doc: A planet in a sector (dobj SECTOR's planets; GType 4). Has a type, colour (used as light), fog parameter and optional owner. Created by sector setup code and activated as an engine object when the sector is active.

0.doc: planet subtype / engine planet type id
0.name: planetType

1.doc: owning race object, set by scripts
1.name: ownerRace

2.doc: light colour 0xRRGGBB
2.name: colorRgb

3.doc: atmosphere fog parameter
3.name: fogParameter

Activate.doc: Creates the engine object with light colour and fog and starts it in the sector's space.

AddTo.doc: Adds the planet to a sector and activates it if the sector is active.

Create.doc: Creates a planet at x,y,z; colour defaults to the type's colour.

Deactivate.doc: Frees the native planet object and clears its handle, when the planet is active.

Destruct.doc: Removes the planet from its sector's planet table, then runs the base destruct.

GetColor.doc: Returns the planet colour packed as 0xRRGGBB (field 9). It is written as the planet colour in the galaxy file.

GetColorBlue.doc: Returns the blue component of the planet colour (bits 0 to 7).

GetColorGreen.doc: Returns the green component of the planet colour (bits 8 to 15).

GetColorRed.doc: Returns the red component of the planet colour (bits 16 to 23).

GetFogParameter.doc: Returns the planet fog parameter (field 10), written as fn in the galaxy file.

GetName.doc: Returns the constant name PLANET.

GetOwner.doc: Returns the owner race object of the planet (field 8).

GetTypeCode.doc: Type code: main type 4 shifted by 16 bits | planet type.

InitPos.doc: Sets position with a fixed rotation (0, -16384, 0).

Remove.doc: Deactivates the planet if it is active, then removes it from its sector.

SelfDestruct.doc: Removes the engine object and destroys the planet.

SetColor.doc: Sets the colour from red/green/blue bytes and updates the engine light.

SetFogParameter.doc: Sets the fog parameter of the planet and passes it to the native planet when it exists.

SetOwner.doc: Sets the owner race object of the planet.

SetRot.doc: Rotation is not stored for planets: the body is empty.

2002.name: Planet

2004.doc: A ship object (page 2006: Ship; dobj: SHIP). Base class of all ship kinds (moveable, big, little, carrier, astronaut and others) and parent of the passenger class 1700. Created by the galaxy and ship setup code and by the subclasses. Holds the ship's fleet, formation, passengers and marines, pilot, missile and laser state, jobs, relations and docking slot.

0.doc: flag word: 31 destroyed, 29 civilian, 27 race covered, 19/20 laser target mode, 9 hired
0.name: shipFlags

1.doc: bits: 0 hide as enemy, 1 patrol env, 2 forgive, 3 no help call, 10 no freight drop, 11 autojump, 12 emergency jump
1.name: behaviourFlags

10.doc: number of shield bays from the subtype
10.name: shieldBayCount

11.doc: per laser slot, starts at -1 (probably an assignment id)
11.name: laserAssign

12.doc: per laser slot, starts at 1 (probably enabled)
12.name: laserState

13.doc: per turret value, starts at 0
13.name: turretState

14.doc: value set by SetReloaderShield; meaning not known
14.name: reloaderShield

15.doc: per shield bay: -1 empty, otherwise the installed shield
15.name: shieldBays

16.doc: selected missile subtype for the player, -1 for none
16.name: currentMissileType

18.doc: hue shift in degrees, 0..359, random per ship
18.name: hueModifier

19.doc: colour saturation modifier, 65536 is the default
19.name: saturationModifier

2.doc: ship subtype id within type 7; index into native type tables
2.name: subType

21.doc: missile cooldown after a launch in ms, default 10000
21.name: missileCooldown

22.doc: earliest absolute time for the next missile launch
22.name: nextMissileTime

26.doc: job id for C6001 idle rate and jump range, 0 for none
26.name: jobId

28.doc: leader object of the current job
28.name: jobLeader

29.doc: owner object (faction or the player's ship owner)
29.name: owner

3.doc: formation leader object, or nothing
3.name: formationLeader

32.doc: game time of the last docking
32.name: lastDockingTime

37.doc: game time of the last attack on this ship
37.name: lastAttackTime

4.doc: formation followers array, nothing when empty
4.name: formationShips

5.doc: formation pattern 0..7 used by ReorgFormation
5.name: formationType

54.doc: owner group mask of friendly groups
54.name: friendsMask

55.doc: owner group mask of enemy groups
55.name: enemiesMask

57.doc: speed upgrade in percent, scales max speed and acceleration
57.name: speedUpgradePercent

58.doc: step upgrade in percent, scales movement steps
58.name: stepUpgradePercent

6.doc: status array: [8] mech, [9] hacking, [10] engineering, [11] fighting, [12] status
6.name: statusData

60.doc: trade container volume taken by passengers and marines
60.name: passengerVolume

61.doc: maximum laser power from the subtype
61.name: laserPowerMax

72.doc: docking object this ship occupies, or nothing
72.name: dockSlot

77.doc: excuses used in the current time window
77.name: excuseCount

78.doc: game time of the last excuse
78.name: excuseTime

8.doc: maximum hull strength from the subtype
8.name: maxHull

82.doc: per-command script overrides for this ship
82.name: commandScripts

86.doc: table of passengers and marines aboard
86.name: passengers

87.doc: wing object this ship belongs to
87.name: wing

88.doc: missile resupply counts by subtype, stored plus one
88.name: missileResupply

89.doc: ammo resupply counts by type, stored plus one, or nothing
89.name: ammoResupply

9.doc: number of laser slots from the subtype
9.name: maxLasers

90.doc: fuel resupply count, stored plus one
90.name: fuelResupply

91.doc: minimum jump range for autojump, default 1
91.name: autojumpMinRange

92.doc: shield percent that triggers emergency jump, 0..100
92.name: emergencyJumpMinShields

93.doc: marines to load into a boarding pod being launched
93.name: pendingPodMarines

94.doc: fleet leader object, nothing when not in a fleet
94.name: fleetLeader

comments.text: player-controlled / autopilot / player-object flags
pirate ships (owner g7[8]) have a 5% chance to be hostile to the races in mask 393790
start turret scripts when the sector is already active

Activate.doc: Creates the 3D object for the ship and applies all stored state: group, relations, hull, shield, flags, hue, shields, lasers, autopilot, position. Called when the sector becomes active. Returns the 3D handle.

ActivateStartTasks.doc: Starts a command script per turret (turret 1..n) for AI ships, or unfreezes turret scripts for player ships. Turrets of text type 2/5/6 use the alternate script.

AddAllFollowersToTable.doc: Adds this ship and all its formation followers, recursively, to a table keyed by ship.

AddCargoUpgrades.doc: Adds a random extra cargo bay size in a per-mille range of the maximum extension.

AddCriticalWare.doc: Like AddWare but enlarges the cargo extension to fit overflow.

AddDefaultItems.doc: Fits default shields, lasers, missiles, upgrades and marines for a newly created ship.

comments.text: main turret with more than 3 guns: scale gun count by fight ranking
class 2073 gets a steeper scale

AddDefaultLasers.doc: Equips the ship with default lasers per turret. Mode 0: one gun of the first turret; 1: random shipyard-like loadout with 3% chance of special lasers; 2: full loadout with 20% chance of special. Also adds ammunition for ammo weapons.

AddDefaultMissiles.doc: Adds a default missile type to a ship; none for mode 0, random amount for mode 1, full for mode 2. 3% (mode 1) or 20% (mode 2) chance to take a special missile.

AddDefaultShields.doc: Fits shields into the shield bays: best available type, with mode 1 chance 10% to take one lower; mode 0 fits only one bay with the weakest shield.

comments.text: ware (16,17) = engine tuning, (16,18) = rudder optimisation
race-mask owners' freighters (class 2038) get half the extra cargo size
owners with mask bits 64/128 (Khaak, Xenon) get no ware extras
owner mask 393216 (races 17/18): ware (16,109) instead of (16,10)
ships that can be boarded may carry (16,105),(16,102),(16,103) boarding items
ware (16,23) added to every ship; (16,35) to fast class 2073 ships

AddDefaultUpgrades.doc: Gives a newly created ship random default software/hardware upgrades (engine tuning, rudder tuning, extra cargo bay, plus random ware class 16 items and boarding wares). Not for classes 2135/2061/2136. Parameter 0 skips the random extras.

AddFlags.doc: Sets the given bits in the ship flag word (field 13).

AddFormationShip.doc: Adds a follower to this formation and sets its leader to this ship, then reorganises the formation. A follower already present only has its leader set again.

comments.text: laser type 29 = tractor beam: disconnect before replacing

AddLaser.doc: Adds (positive count) or removes (negative) lasers of a type, installing into the first free laser slots or clearing the last matching slots. Returns the number of lasers changed.

AddLaserForTurret.doc: Adds a laser to the cargo and installs it into a gun of the turret.

comments.text: start mask: all standard laser general-types, flags below remove classes
iterate turrets from last to turret 0 (main guns are filled last)
main turret with many guns: scale gun count by the player's fight ranking
the first suitable (best, since the loop runs from top type down) laser type is taken with probability value/800
special lasers 28/29/35 only when their flag (2048/4096/8192) is set
nothing picked by chance: fit at least the last suitable type
flag 1<<30: fill remaining guns with a random mix of the extra candidates

AddLasersPerValue.doc: Randomly fits lasers to every turret of the ship, scaled by a value score (higher = better weapons). Flags mask out laser classes (bits 2,4,8,16,32,16384) or allow special lasers (64..1024, 2048/4096/8192 for specific types); flag 1073741824 additionally mixes in extra laser types. Also adds ammunition for ammo weapons.

AddMarine.doc: Adds a marine to the passenger table, removing it from its previous container first. Counts its volume in passengerVolume. Returns 1 on success.

AddMaxLasers.doc: Fills every laser bay with the given laser type.

AddMaxMissile.doc: Raises or lowers the per-type maximum missile count (allocating the array on first use); returns the change.

AddMissile.doc: Adds missiles to cargo; keeps the HUD missile selection of the player cockpit in sync.

AddMissilesPerValue.doc: Adds random missiles scaled by a value score. Flags: 65536 removes some missile classes, 131072 adds heavier classes.

AddMoney.doc: Adds money to the paying object: the trade station m42 if it is set and this is not the player ship, otherwise the owner m41.

AddOptimumLasers.doc: Fits lasers into all bays choosing, per turret, the first type from the given preference list that the turret accepts and the ship can transport.

AddPassenger.doc: Adds a person (class 1700) as passenger, or as marine if it is one. Its volume (ware 12,22) is added to passengerVolume. Returns 1 on success.

comments.text: new passenger when asked for, or when the other ship has no pilot

AddPassengerFromPilotSpeaker.doc: Moves a pilot or a new passenger from another ship into this ship's passengers. The pilot is taken over if the other ship has one (and createNew is false), otherwise a new passenger is created from the other ship.

comments.text: mask 62 = the five main races
20% veteran marines with fighting 50..99 and other skills 30..99

AddRandomMarines.doc: Adds random trained marines to ships that can be boarded. Not for races g7[6]/g7[7] or ships that already have marines; amount scales with mode (1 = at least half the free space). About 20% of marines get high random skills.

comments.text: free all shield 3D objects before rebuilding
count > 0: fill to full, else keep the previous shield energy

AddShield.doc: Adds (or with a negative count removes) shields of a type to the cargo and re-installs shields into the bays from the best type downward. Returns the count actually changed. If count flag is positive the shield is filled completely.

AddShieldsPerValue.doc: Fits shields into bays based on a random 'value' score (higher value, better shields).

AddSpeedUpgrades.doc: Adds engine and rudder tuning with a random level in the range centred on level (0..1000 per mille) with the given spread.

AddTo.doc: Adds the ship to an environment.

AddTo2.doc: Adds the ship to a sector/station (stations get the dock-port argument) and activates it if the target has a 3D object.

AddToFormation.doc: Puts this ship into the formation of another ship. 0 removes it from its current formation.

comments.text: race mask 393344 owners and lucky ships get ware (16,52), else (16,51) for class 2073 or job group 1

AddUpgrades.doc: Adds random ware class 16 upgrades whose chance scales with the per-mille level and spread (about 1 in 10..30 per item per ~150 per mille). Always adds (16,23); (16,52) or (16,51) depending on level/owner.

comments.text: marines (flag 1024) are passengers, not cargo
ware type 107 = veteran marines
special ware keys: 1048593 = (16,17) engine tuning, 1048594 = (16,18) rudder tuning, 1048592 = (16,16) cargo extension, 1048636/37/48 = (16,60),(16,61),(16,72) software

AddWare.doc: Adds (positive) or removes (negative) cargo and returns the actual change. Marines are created or released as passengers; unique wares can only be held once; updates volume, extra speed/rotation/cargo upgrades, software switching and life-support.

AddWeapons.doc: Adds lasers and missiles by value score and flags; with flag 1 also adds extra ware(16,...) support items depending on owner mask.

AllowRaceLogicControl.doc: True when the race AI is allowed to give this ship orders (flag 65536 clear).

comments.text: parent class (GBody) processing first
weapon type 29 = tractor beam: attach the beam when shields are down or same owner, and mark the attacker's tractor target
weapon main type 10 sub type 35 = boarding pod: board the target ship
weapon flags2 bit 256: attacker counts as the player
attacker is a hostile ship of a different owner and the weapon belongs to that owner group
possible pilot ejection: player attacked this ship, not alert state, owner not in mask 1024, cockpit body exists, capture not disabled
only when shields are nearly gone and hull is low (random fraction of max hull)
m50 = next age at which ejection may be tried again, m51 = back-off interval (doubled each try, reset to 30 s if >300)
ejection chance: 30 - morale, -5 if attacker is weaker, + damage, - back-off/30; scaled by the player's fight rank for one special race
pilot message 28 unless the owner is in mask 192
stat counter 5080 = ejected pilots
achievement: pilot ejected
random equipment damage from the attacker's max laser
player attacked someone else's ship: notoriety -1, at most once per minute
when landing, report mode 2 (or 3 for main type 18 targets) to Signal_Attacked

AttackedBy.doc: Reaction to a hit: tractor-beam handling, boarding pods, player attack consequences (notoriety, pilot ejecting when almost dead and the pilot's nerve breaks), minor equipment damage, setting the attacker and raising Signal_Attacked. Called with the attacking event object and the weapon event.

AttackedByHandler.doc: Hook run for non-player ships when attacked. Here: if the player attacks a ship of a race that issues licenses, the player loses that race's license. Returns 1.

BreakCommand.doc: Interrupts the running command script (sets interrupt flag) and stops the ship, without resetting the command state.

comments.text: arg1 unpacked: type = bits 16..23, subtype = bits 0..15
g46 = per-ware flags: 1024 marines, 8 upgrades, 1 seller stock not changed (probably unlimited supply)
payer is the docked station itself: a free transfer, handled by LoadWare
marine candidates: station products with marine price <= arg3 (or any when arg3 is 0)
random marines, one at a time, while the payer can afford them
the marine is removed from the player's own pool g8 when the seller is g8
upgrades: lower the count until the total price fits the money
price limit arg3 exceeded: no trade
units affordable at the unit price

BuyWare.doc: Buys up to arg2 units of a ware from the docked station (class 2016). arg1 packs the ware type in bits 16..23 and the subtype in bits 0..15. Marines are bought one at a time from the station's product list (price limited by arg3 when non-zero), upgrades are bought as a set, and other wares by unit price. Returns the number bought.

comments.text: m54 = last call time; at most every 15 s
tell the owner object (m42)
owner race decides which of its ships respond

CallForHelp.doc: Calls for help after being attacked: notifies the owner's station, the formation leader and all followers, and the owner race's help logic. Throttled to once per 15 s unless forced.

CallbackBeginRunThisScript.doc: Script callback before a command script runs; stops the old command in slot 0.

comments.text: this == g9: the current player ship; m3 is the engine object id
tip 17 shown if no alert and the player owns equipment 23 (probably the autopilot/navigation software)

CallbackBeginStartThisScript.doc: Script callback fired before a command script is started in slot 0. Stops the current command; for the player ship also switches the cockpit autopilot on and may show a game tip (17) when the alert is off and equipment 23 is installed.

CallbackEndRunThisScript.doc: Script callback after a command script has run to the end; stops the command in slot 0.

CallbackEndStartThisScript.doc: Script callback after the command script start finished; for the player ship it switches the autopilot flag off again.

CallbackInterruptThisScript.doc: Override: when this ship's script task is interrupted, also sets the interrupt flag (m12 bit 128) and halts the ship (mode 5 unless a stop mode is given).

comments.text: params may be wrapped as {21, array}; copy the inner array

CallbackStartFreezedThisScript.doc: Callback used when a command script is started while the ship is under monitor control (frozen). Unpacks the saved parameter array and re-sets the command record via SetCommandFromScript.

comments.text: slot > 0 = turret number; stop its turret object

CallbackStopThisScript.doc: Script callback when a command script is stopped. Slot 0 is the ship command (interrupts the timer task, stops the ship, clears the command field, switches the player autopilot off); slots above 0 are turret scripts and stop the turret object.

CanBeBoarded.doc: Always false in this class; boarding-capable subclasses override it.

comments.text: bit 8 of field 14 set = calling for race help is disabled

CanCallHelpFromRace.doc: True when the ship may call for help from its race (bit 8 of field 14 is clear).

comments.text: only subtype 35 (boarding pod) has extra conditions
player only: speech 13:610 when there are no marines aboard (text not in the English table)
player only: speech 13:607 when the target shields are not down (text not in the English table)

CanFireMissile.doc: Checks a missile launch at a target. Only the boarding pod (subtype 35) has extra rules: the target must be a ship that can be boarded and has marines able to board, this ship needs marines aboard, and the target's shields must be down. The player gets a speech line when a check fails.

CanForgiveAttack.doc: True when the ship can forgive an attack (bit 4 of field 14).

comments.text: class 2033 is the carrier type: its dock is handled through the carrier path
non-carrier dock path (class 2016) for NPC and player ships
flag 524288 selects the alternate dock port slot 65793

CanLand.doc: Decides whether this ship can dock with the event object arg1 (a station, carrier or hangar). Returns 1 when the docking completes, 0 otherwise. The branch with the player ship also handles docking animation and music.

comments.text: boarding pod is missile type 10,35 and must be in the missile mask

CanLaunchAllMarinesAtTarget.doc: True if all marines can be launched at a ship target of another owner: needs marines aboard and either a marine launch ability or a boarding pod (missile 10,35) with the right mask.

CanLaunchMissileBarrageAtTarget.doc: True if the ship is a missile boat with a loaded current missile type, and the target belongs to another owner.

CanMoveThroughGates.doc: True unless the ship subtype is 211 (not allowed to use gates).

CanPlayerChangeTo.doc: True if the player can switch to this ship from the current one: player-owned with cockpit, either docked in the same station or within range with transporter device (16,34).

comments.text: class 2064 = carrier-like player ship

CanPlayerEnter.doc: True if the player flies a class 2064 ship and this player-owned ship is within two ship sizes (docking range).

comments.text: scanner and target must be in the same environment, which must be a sector (class 2001)
range check against global parameter 11
player-owned ships need the scanner ware 16,13

CanScan.doc: True if this ship can scan a target: same sector, within the scanner range (global parameter 11), and for player-owned ships the scanner ware 16,13.

CanTransportWareType.doc: True if the ship's transport class allows the ware.

CanTransportWareType2.doc: True if the ware is already aboard or transportable.

comments.text: player branch: warp only when not already warping and flag 524288 is not set on the ship

CanWarp.doc: Handles a gate warp event arg1 for this ship. Player ships start a gate warp through the client; other ships leave the sector through the hyperspace routine.

comments.text: ware 16/79 is credits, moved from the captured ship to the captor
speech 13/5004 played when the player captures a ship

CaptureShip.doc: Called when this ship is captured by the owner of arg1. Credits in cargo go to the captor, the new owner takes the ship and the old owner's name is kept in the log.

CatchWare.doc: Takes the ware crate that is the event object arg1 into this ship. Returns 1 when it was taken.

comments.text: ware 16/79 is credits: paid to the player, not stored as cargo
no room in the cargo bay: show message text 35:4696 for player ships

CatchWareObject.doc: Takes ware crate arg1 into this ship. Goodie crates give money, shields or missiles directly; other wares go to cargo. Scripts C3001 and C5000 get the first chance. Returns 1 when taken.

ChangeCurrentMissileType.doc: Cycles to the next missile type that the ship can carry and has in cargo; -1 after the last.

ChangePilot.doc: Clears the pilot state. When arg1 is set, a new random pilot name and gender for the owner's race are chosen.

comments.text: cargo wares with g46 bit 4 (unique items) are moved to the new ship

ChangePlayerShipTo.doc: Hands the player's controls over from this ship to arg1: monitors, ownership, cargo flagged g46&4 and the favourite-ship record move to the new ship. Runs only when this ship is the current player ship (g9).

CheckFormation.doc: True if the given ship is a follower of this ship, directly or through a follower's formation.

CheckLifeSupport.doc: If the ship has no life support (class 2030 excluded; ware (16,39) missing or forced), removes all life-dependent wares (flag 256) and releases passengers. Returns 1 when life support is present.

comments.text: the user average speed flag (bit 30) applies only without the argument
parameter 13 below max speed: cap = parameter + max / 10; otherwise cap = max * 9 / 10

CheckSpeedLimit.doc: Recomputes the speed limit m93. A formation with follow mode is limited to its formation speed. Without the argument, the user average speed flag caps it at the global parameter 13 plus a tenth of max speed, or at 90 percent of max speed.

ClearAction.doc: Clears the stored default-action fields m55/m56.

comments.text: callback array 21: its second item is the argument list
player cannot take commands right now: speak 13:135 Command rejected and show the message
command upgrade flag 1024 removes the bit 16 (not an order to a ship)
command upgrade flag 2048 adds the bit 256
not the player: flag 8 when the monitor is controlling this ship on cockpit 0
command 0: stop the current command; the player hears 13:1263 Autopilot off
command 2000 (upgrade 5): starts the upgrade script with the player ship as target
player hears 13:1264 Autopilot activated, others 131 Command accepted
command 2002 (upgrade 7): dock at the tracked object if it is a station or ship that allows docking
docking granted: speak 13:1283; denied otherwise (13:1284)
upgrade commands in the list open a sub-menu through class 2274
custom and extended commands (200..263, 300..363, 400..., 1400+) open a sub-menu when the upgrade exists
broadcast orders 4100..6999: the second and third digit give the order, the first gives the group
dock at the station order (ship.bc.dockat)
move to sector order (ship.bc.movesector)
return home order (ship.bc.returnhome)
follow me order (ship.bc.followme)
follow order (ship.bc.follow)
protect me order (ship.bc.protectme)
attack target order (ship.bc.attacktarget)
protect order (ship.bc.protect)
attack order (ship.bc.attack)
kill enemies order (ship.bc.killenemies)
kill enemies and land order (ship.bc.killenemiesland)
group 2 (station/carrier) or 3 (galaxy sector) or 4 (all): the order runs on the ships of that group

CmdConsoleCommandExec.doc: Runs a command console command (arg2) at console level arg1 (0 = ship commands, 10/11 = turret or fleet level). Commands that need a menu open the next menu through a class 2274 menu object and return 2. Simple commands start their script and speak the answer (13:131 accepted, 13:135 rejected, 13:1263 autopilot off, 13:1264 autopilot on, 13:1283/1284 docking granted/denied). Broadcast orders (4100..6999) start a script on the ships of the group, with the script name from a !ship.bc.* table. Returns 1 when done, 2 when a sub-menu opened, 0 otherwise.

CmdConsoleCommandExecCallback.doc: Empty callback for the command console. Always returns 0.

CmdConsoleEntryExec.doc: Runs the action of a command console entry. The switch has no cases in this build, so it does nothing.

CollisionWarn.doc: Collision warning callback. Player-owned ships with 3D flag clear raise a HUD warning; otherwise the ship stops unless m45 says collisions with a certain object (m46) are ignored.

CopyResupplyFromShip.doc: Copies the missile resupply counts of every missile subtype from another ship.

CountMarines.doc: Number of marines in the passenger table m98.

comments.text: rotational acceleration limit default 50
marine and passenger tables start empty
age timers start at the player's current game age
missile cooldown starts 5000 ms after creation
ships that cannot move through gates start with autojump

Create.doc: Initialises a new ship of subtype arg4: flags, hull, lasers, shields, turrets, timers and the speed defaults. Sets autojump when the ship cannot move through gates.

comments.text: race 1 (Argon): 40% female names

CreateAddMarine.doc: Creates a new marine (class 1700) of the owner's race (random main race for player/Xenon), optionally with a random skill bonus, and adds it to the ship. Returns whether it was added.

comments.text: race outside 1..20: random race from mask 262718
race 1: 40 percent chance of a female name and gender

CreateAddPassenger.doc: Creates a new person (class 1700) of a race with a name and adds it as a passenger. Race outside 1..20 is random. Returns the new person or 0.

CreateCommMenu.doc: Opens the communications menu: squad menu or ship menu (class 2278) for player ships, base menu for others.

Deactivate.doc: Saves hull, shield and position from the 3D object, stops tasks, frees the 3D object and queues the ship in the regeneration list (C304).

DeactivateStopTasks.doc: Stops turret objects and stops (AI) or freezes (player) the turret scripts.

comments.text: cancel pending rebuild requests

DecoupleShips.doc: Splits the ship into several independent ships (cut scene based, e.g. Xenon/Khaak formations). Marks the ship, then in a forked task removes it from its container, calls SA_DecoupleShips and destroys the original object. Returns 1 when started, 0 when no cut scene exists.

comments.text: invincible pilot is ejected in a suit; other pilots are destroyed (astronauts of class 2064 are always destroyed)
the first remaining fleet member becomes the new leader
invincible passengers are ejected, the others destroyed
removed from the global object lists C304 and C305

Destruct.doc: Destroys the ship: releases the pilot and passengers, passes fleet leadership on, frees the dock slot, removes the ship from the hired list, sector, wing and global lists, then calls the parent destructor.

DisableCapture.doc: Sets or clears the 'capture disabled' flag (4).

DisableCommunication.doc: Sets or clears flag 64 of m13 (no communication).

DisableDropFreight.doc: Disables or enables dropping freight (bit 1024 of field 14).

comments.text: a non-player ship stops its current command when cockpit 0 is left

DisableScriptFromMonitor.doc: Freezes the turret or cockpit script that belongs to cockpit view arg1 when the player leaves that view. Cockpit 0 also stops the autopilot.

DisableSelling.doc: Sets or clears the 'selling disabled' flag (8).

DisbandFleet.doc: Leader only: releases all followers from the fleet and clears the fleet leader.

DoKill.doc: Delayed destruction: waits one tick, kills the 3D object (optionally attributing a killer) and destroys the script object without any rewards.

DoSignalTrade.doc: Routes a trade event: count > 0 means this ship receives wares (load or buy), count < 0 means it gives them (unload or sell). With a price and a foreign partner it is a buy/sell, otherwise a plain load/unload.

DoTempRemoveFromWing.doc: Temporarily removes the ship from its wing (e.g. while executing a command) and flags it (m13 bit 8).

comments.text: roll below the percent value selects a random jump target
owner mask 918526 filters the sectors that may be picked
the old sector is recorded only when it differs from the target
start the jump to the temporary sector

DoUnfocussedJump.doc: Starts a jump to a sector: with arg percent chance a random neighbour sector of the 24 x 20 sector grid g6 is picked, otherwise the temporary sector. The player's previous sector is remembered first.

DoesCommunicate.doc: False for ships of race g7[12] (Khaa'k); player ships always communicate; others unless disabled.

comments.text: speed upgrades (16/17, 16/18) become the extra speed values

DowngradeTakeOver.doc: After a takeover some equipment is lost: lasers, shields and missiles survive with about 90 percent chance, lasers with 50 percent on a race-7 hull. Cargo keeps a random part. Upgrade counts 16/17 and 16/18 set the extra speed and rotation speed.

comments.text: SE_LinFunc maps 0..title to 30..99 percent (extrapolates above 33)

DropFreight.doc: Drops part of the cargo as freight in the sector. The share is random between 30 and 99 percent, scaled by the player's fight title (GetTitleFromFightRanking), then passed to DropFreightPercent. Does nothing when freight dropping is disabled.

lasers (type 8) and shields (type 9) are only dropped at 70 percent or more
ware types with g46 bit 1 are never ejected
missile subtypes: chance in percent that a missile stack is ejected
roll against the ejection chance, then drop a random part of the stack
spawn a ware crate (2084) at the ship position

DropFreightPercent.doc: Ejects a percentage of this ship's cargo as ware crates (class 2084) and returns the total value of the ejected wares. arg1 is the drop percent; values below 70 keep lasers and shields.

comments.text: freight key: wareType = bits 16..23, subtype = bits 0..15
WareTypeIsIllegalForRace: the race would confiscate it
eject container: the freight is left in the sector

DropIllegalFreight.doc: Ejects every freight item that is illegal for the given race (arg2) as an eject container (class 2084) and removes it from the ship's cargo. Returns 1 if anything was dropped. The player unlocks ACH_EJECT_CRATE when the dropped value is 10000 or more.

EjectPassenger.doc: Removes a passenger and ejects it into space in a space suit. Returns the suit result, or 0.

comments.text: ware types 5 and 6 cannot be ejected
flag 256 wares are destroyed instead of ejected
crate created with the ware count that actually left the cargo

EjectWare.doc: Ejects arg2 units of ware arg1 from this ship as a crate. Scripts C3001 and C5000 can handle it first. Wares flagged g46 bit 256 vanish without a crate. Returns the crate object, or 0.

EnableScriptFromMonitor.doc: Reverse of DisableScriptFromMonitor: unfreezes the turret or cockpit script for cockpit view arg1. Cockpit 0 cancels a pending docking and restores the autopilot for NPC ships.

comments.text: invincible passengers cannot be enslaved

EnslavePassenger.doc: Turns a passenger into one unit of ware 16,6 in the trade container. Invincible passengers cannot be enslaved. For the player the capture is reported to C150.

FillContextMenu.doc: Builds the right-click / interaction menu for a ship: info, communicate, trade, enter ship, capture, command console (orders submenu), own-ship options (exchange, weapons, change ship, self destruct), landed/owned ships, wing commands, dock, drones and marine/missile barrage entries. Button ids are the case labels of OnContextMenuUpdate/Return.

902 = remove laser
groups 1..4: 903..906 add, 907..910 remove, 911 remove from all

FillLaserContextMenu.doc: Builds the weapon-picker menu for one laser slot of a turret: remove/info for the installed laser type, pages (12 entries each) of available laser types with counts, and group buttons 1..4 (add to / remove from fire group). Returns 1.

comments.text: 913 = deselect current missile

FillMissileContextMenu.doc: Builds the missile-picker menu: info/unselect for the current missile type m28 and pages of missile types with counts (button id 21000 + type). Returns 0 when there are no missiles at all.

stop early once 5 candidates are found

FindEnemyInFiringRangeOfTurret.doc: Picks a random enemy ship, factory or dock in the current sector that a given turret can currently hit. Collects up to 5 candidates (ships first, then factories, then docks) and returns one at random; returns 0 if none.

then pick a lower subtype in stock
then look upwards from the best one

FindMissileForTarget.doc: Missile subtype to use against a target: starts at the target's best missile and walks down to one this ship's mask allows and that is in stock; if none, looks upwards. Returns -1 if nothing is available.

FindNearestEnemyShip.doc: Returns the nearest enemy ship in this ship's sector within maxRange (0 = unlimited), via Sector.FindShip; nothing if the ship is not in a sector.

FindNearestEnemyStation.doc: Returns the nearest enemy factory or dock in the sector within maxDistance (<=0 means unlimited). Skips objects flagged NoFind.

comments.text: walk all missiles (ware type 10) in the sector container

FindNearestMissileAimingAtMe.doc: Returns the owner object of the missile in the sector that is aimed at this ship and is closest to it, or nothing if none.

current target gone or hull <= 0: pick one of the alternative targets

FireAllTurretsOnTarget.doc: Fires every turret at the given target; when the target dies it switches to other ships found near it. Returns the number of turrets that fired.

FireLasersOnDebris.doc: Fires one turret at a rock field (class 1650) or a single asteroid (class 2012). Handles mining/laser hits that split asteroids into debris, and (for a ship without a 3D object) simulates the effect abstractly. Returns 1/true if the turret fired, 0 otherwise.

FireLasersOnTarget.doc: Fires one turret at a target (ship, station, asteroid...). Three paths: with a 3D object it fires real shots; a ship simulated without 3D uses either per-laser statistics (when global parameter 121 is on) or a coarse random model; both end in target.Hit(shield, hull, extraHull, this). Repair lasers heal friendly targets via Repair instead. Returns 1 when something happened.

FreeSpaceForMarines.doc: True if at least one more marine fits aboard.

GetAcceleration.doc: Acceleration of the subtype, scaled by the speed upgrade percent m69.

GetAction.doc: Current action id (m55): e.g. 3 enter gate, 4 warp in, 5 attack run, 8 defensive move, 12 avoid collision, 13 leave hyperspace, 15 collect, 21 jump, 22 marine run.

GetActionTarget.doc: Target of the current action, or 0 if no action or the target no longer exists.

GetActionTargetName.doc: Display name of the action target for those action ids that have a named target.

GetAllMarines.doc: Table of the marines aboard, keyed by marine.

GetAllowedMaxSpeed.doc: Max speed, capped by the speed limit m93 when one is set.

GetAmmoResupply.doc: Ammo resupply count for a type (stored plus one), or nothing if unset.

GetAmmunitionCount.doc: Loaded ammunition (ready rounds) of an ammo ware.

GetAmmunitionCountReload.doc: Loaded rounds; reloads a magazine first if empty.

GetAnswers.doc: Adds the answer ids for a question to the answer table: 10008 and 10009 for question 20, and 10022 (excuse) for question 21 when the ship has the matching flag and no enemy is here.

GetAttackTarget.doc: Attack target object, cleared when it no longer exists.

GetAttacker.doc: Returns the last attacker if it still exists, is from another owner, and attacked less than 600 age units ago; otherwise clears it and returns 0.

GetAutojumpMinRange.doc: Returns the minimum range for autojump (field 104).

owner mask 64 multiplies by 2

GetBaseDefenceLevel.doc: Base defence level against boarding (table index 2), scaled by owner mask.

GetBaseSpeed.doc: Base max speed of the subtype from the native type table.

GetBoardingHullDefence.doc: Hull defence against boarding from the boarding table (index 1), doubled for ships with mask 393216.

GetClassCode.doc: Ship class code text (page 1263): civilian code or by generic subtype.

GetCmdConsoleCommands.doc: Builds the command console menu for this ship into the table arg4, starting at index arg3, and returns the new count. arg1 is the console level (0 = the ship's own commands, 10 or 11 = the fleet/turret level), arg2 is the menu id (-100 top, -101 .. -108 submenus, 4000..6000 broadcast menus). Each entry is {commandId, flags}; -99 is a separator. Flags are built from the sector and dock state; the bit meanings are not verified.

comments.text: -6 is added for class 2034 ships that are not the player ship

GetCmdConsoleEntries.doc: Fills the command console top-level entries (-9, -7, -5, -4, -3, and -1 unless class 2019; -6 only for class 2034 ships that are not the player's) and returns the new count.

GetCockpitName.doc: Cockpit name text (page 2021) or the number as fallback.

GetCockpitNameID.doc: Text id for the cockpit; none for cockpit 0, -1 if unnamed.

GetCommand.doc: Current command id, read from turret 0's command.

GetCommandAndPars.doc: Returns the command id followed by the eight parameter slots (m58..m65) as an array.

GetCommandPreload.doc: Returns the preload data of the command with this id, as given by the command library C703.

global lookup per class in the chain, using the owner

GetCommandScript.doc: Script for a command: this ship's own override first, then the global overrides up the class chain up to class 2004. Returns 0 for none or for an ignored command.

GetCommandTarget2Name.doc: Name of the second command target, for commands that have one (23 attack and land, 9/28 buy/sell with station).

GetCommandTarget2ScriptDataType.doc: Script data type of the second command parameter.

comments.text: 91: target is the player ship

GetCommandTargetName.doc: Text shown for the command's target in the UI: object name for object-target commands, ware name (or 'None') for buy/sell, 'Radius: %s' for radius commands. Command ids follow page 2010.

GetCommandTargetScriptDataType.doc: Script data type of the first command parameter.

GetCurrentGalaxyFlightTimeStep.doc: Returns the galaxy-flight time step in ms: 5 s when the current sector has update focus, else 30 s.

GetCurrentSpeed.doc: Current speed from the native ship, or the max speed when there is no native ship.

GetCurrentUpgrades.doc: Installed level of an upgrade ware.

GetDeckNumber.doc: Deck number from the ship boarding table (index 0).

GetDecoupleShipsCutScene.doc: Returns the cut scene id used for decoupling; 0 in the base class (overridden by subclasses).

GetDefaultEquipment.doc: Returns the default equipment table of the ship (field 37).

GetDefaultFormationType.doc: Default formation type for the race of this ship's owner.

GetDefaultFormationTypeFromRace.doc: Default formation type for a race (table g39), or 1 for races out of range 1..19.

GetDescriptionID.doc: Description text id; the one after the name id.

GetDestination.doc: Destination object, cleared when it no longer exists.

GetDockBaySize.doc: Always 0 for a ship; dock bays exist only on carriers and stations.

GetEmergencyJumpMinShields.doc: Returns the shield percentage needed for the emergency jump (field 105).

GetEnemiesMask.doc: Returns the mask of enemy races (field 68).

comments.text: range = 500 * global parameter 97 (default 5000)

GetExchangeTargets.doc: Table of player ships/stations between which the player can transfer wares: ships in the carrier, fellow ships in the same dock, or ships in range with ware (16,34) installed (transporter device).

GetExtraTradeContainerSize.doc: Returns the extra trade container size (field 72).

GetFireMissileNextTime.doc: Returns the time of the next missile shot (field 35).

GetFireMissileTimeDiff.doc: Returns the time difference between missile shots (field 34).

GetFlags.doc: Returns the ship flag word (field 13). Bits are listed in the methods that use them.

GetFleetLeader.doc: Returns the fleet leader ship (field 107), 0 when the ship is not in a fleet.

comments.text: ships outside any fleet are skipped
with the argument set, only ships marked with-fleet or leaders are kept

GetFleetShips.doc: Ships of this ship's fleet, keyed by ship. With a true argument only ships that are with the fleet or are leaders are returned.

GetFormationDist.doc: Base formation spacing: four times the ship size.

GetFormationDistToLeader.doc: Distance of this ship's formation slot from the leader plus its own formation size.

comments.text: the leader is cleared when the object no longer exists

GetFormationLeader.doc: Returns the formation leader (field 16). A leader that no longer exists is forgotten.

GetFormationShips.doc: Returns the ships of the formation (field 17).

GetFormationSize.doc: Radius the formation needs around this ship: the largest follower distance, but at least the base formation distance.

GetFormationType.doc: Returns the formation type of the ship (field 18).

GetFormattedName.doc: Builds the full ship name from prefix/race/job/type/variation parts and abbreviates parts (variation to initial, race prefix to short form from page 1266) so it fits the given pixel width. Template is text 35:11.

GetFreeShieldBays.doc: Number of empty shield bays (entries equal to -1 in m27).

comments.text: volume of one marine is ware 16,107

GetFreeSpaceForMarines.doc: Marines that still fit: capacity minus marines aboard, limited by the free trade container space per marine.

GetFriendsMask.doc: Returns the mask of friendly races (field 67).

GetFuelResupply.doc: Fuel resupply count (stored plus one, so this returns the value minus one).

GetFullRepairPrice.doc: Total price to repair all missing hull percent; nothing if the ship has no hull.

GetGSize.doc: Generic (group) size of a ship; constant 10000.

GetGSubType.doc: Returns the game subtype of the ship, looked up from its subtype (field 15).

GetGroupRelation.doc: Relation to a race group: 1 for own race, squad's relation if in a squad, -1 enemy, 1 friend, nothing neutral.

comments.text: owner mask 393216 multiplies the base by 4

GetHackingSecurity.doc: Hacking security of the ship: random roll up to boarding table index 3 plus the base from index 4, scaled by owner mask and the player's own race type.

GetHueModifier.doc: Returns the hue modifier of the ship (field 31).

GetHull.doc: Current hull points (read from the 3D object when active).

GetHullPercent.doc: Hull as percent of the maximum.

GetInstalledWares.doc: Wares always installed on the ship type (via global GetInstalledWares).

GetJobID.doc: Returns the job id of the ship (field 39).

GetJobIdleRate.doc: Idle rate of the ship's job from C6001, with a random jitter of plus or minus 10. Returns nothing without a job.

GetJobJumpRange.doc: Jump range of the ship's job from C6001. Returns nothing without a job.

GetJobLeader.doc: Job leader object. Cleared when the leader no longer exists, or has no job and no war object id.

GetJobNameID.doc: Text id of the job name: explicit or from the job (C6001).

GetLaser.doc: Current laser energy; nothing if the ship has no damaging lasers.

GetLaserGroupMasks.doc: Per laser-slot bit mask of fire groups.

GetLaserPercent.doc: Laser energy as percent of maximum.

GetLaserTargetMode.doc: Laser target mode for the ship: 2 when the mode 2 flag is set and a targeting ware (16,56 or 16,57) is present, 1 when the mode 1 flag is set, otherwise nothing.

GetLaserTypeInTurret.doc: Installed laser type of a gun in the turret, or -1.

GetLasers.doc: Array of installed laser types per slot.

GetLastAttackTime.doc: Returns the time of the last attack on the ship (field 50).

GetLastDockingTime.doc: Returns the time of the last docking (field 45).

GetMaxDamageMissileType.doc: Missile subtype with the greatest damage that the ship can carry and is allowed to transport; -1 if none.

comments.text: followers with allowed speed of 5000 or less are ignored (probably not moving)

GetMaxFormationSpeed.doc: Speed limit for a formation: the slowest follower's allowed speed times 98 percent, capped at this ship's max speed.

GetMaxHull.doc: Maximum hull of the ship type.

GetMaxLaser.doc: Maximum laser energy; nothing if the ship has no damaging lasers.

GetMaxLaserDamage.doc: Sum of the shield-damage, hull-damage and special damage of the installed lasers.

GetMaxLaserStrengthInTurret.doc: Sum of max energy of the lasers in the turret that are in the current group.

GetMaxLaserTargetMode.doc: Highest laser target mode this ship can use: 2 with a targeting ware (16,56 or 16,57), otherwise 1.

comments.text: subtype 262 carries 30 marines

GetMaxMarines.doc: Marine capacity: 30 for subtype 262, otherwise nothing (no marine capacity).

GetMaxMissiles.doc: Returns the maximum number of missiles (field 30).

GetMaxShield.doc: Maximum total shield strength of the installed shields.

GetMaxShieldType.doc: Returns the maximum shield type the ship subtype can carry.

comments.text: hull between 10 and 90 percent of max hull maps the speed linearly

GetMaxSpeed.doc: Max speed: base speed scaled by the speed upgrade percent (m69). Below 90 percent hull the speed falls linearly, to 30 percent of the speed at 10 percent hull.

GetMaxUpgradedSpeed.doc: Max speed with all speed upgrades of the subtype, ignoring hull damage and m69.

GetMaxUpgrades.doc: Maximum level of an upgrade ware for this ship type: engine (16,17), rudder (16,18) or cargo extension (16,16).

GetMinimumTradeContainerSize.doc: Base cargo capacity of the ship type.

GetMissileArrayAimingAtMe.doc: Returns a table with the owners of all missiles in the sector that are aimed at this ship. Returns nothing outside a galaxy sector.

GetMissileMask.doc: Bit mask of missile classes the ship type can carry.

GetMissileResupply.doc: Missile resupply count for a subtype. Copied from the owner ship the first time it is read.

GetMoney.doc: Returns the money of the paying object (see AddMoney).

GetName.doc: Display name; forwards to GetYourName.

comments.text: 13/1328 is the format template; slots 2..11 are page,id pairs filled below
ship-specific pseudo-random pick from the object id (-this % 5)
mask 262718 = races that have per-ship names in page 1000

GetNameArray.doc: Builds a composite text-id array {13,1328, page,id ...} for the ship name: race prefix, race-specific name, job name, type name and variation, controlled by the name flags. Returns a simple {17,id} or {1000,id} pair for overridden or unique names.

comments.text: player ships: type name and variation only

GetNameFlags.doc: Name-composition flags: bit 1 race prefix, 2 race name, 4 ship type name, 8 variation, 64 job name. Override, then unique-ship flags from C6001, else 13 (others) or 12 (player ships).

GetNameID.doc: Text id (page 17) of the ship name: override id if set, else the ware name of the ship type.

GetNeededJumpEnergyPerSector.doc: Jump energy needed to leave the current sector, from C5006.NeededEnergyForJump.

GetNoFind.doc: True when the ship cannot be found by searches (bit 262144 of field 13).

GetNumCockpits.doc: Number of cockpits of the type.

GetNumInstalledShields.doc: Returns how many shield bays have a shield installed (entries of field 28 that are 0 or more).

GetNumLaserBays.doc: Returns the number of laser bays (field 22).

GetNumRemainingLasers.doc: Lasers of a type that are available but not installed.

GetNumShieldBays.doc: Returns the number of shield bays (field 23).

GetNumTurrets.doc: Number of turrets of the type.

GetObjectMenu.doc: Menu class used for the object: 2211.

GetOverrideNameID.doc: Returns the fixed name text id, or negative when none.

GetOwner.doc: Owner object of the ship (field m41).

GetOwnerObject.doc: Returns the owner object (e.g. the station the ship belongs to); clears the reference if that object no longer exists.

GetPassengers.doc: Returns the passenger count or table of the ship (field 99).

GetPilotAggression.doc: Pilot aggression 0..30; none for the player ship.

GetPilotFace.doc: Pilot face id: stored or generated from owner, subrace, ship type group and gender.

GetPilotFightSkill.doc: Pilot fight skill 0..30. Player ship: from fight ranking. Else stored value; unique ships use their C6001 value adjusted by a ship-id offset (for race 8 also pulled toward the player's rank); otherwise generated from subrace.

GetPilotMorale.doc: Pilot morale 0..30; 30 for the player ship.

GetPilotName.doc: Pilot name: custom, player name for player ships, or generated by owner race/subrace/gender.

GetPilotSpeaker.doc: Returns the speaker id of the pilot (field 98), used for voice lines.

GetPilotSubraceID.doc: Pilot subrace id, or a pseudo-random one derived from the ship id and owner race.

GetPilotTradeSkill.doc: Pilot trade skill; player ship from trade ranking, else stored or generated.

GetPilotVoice.doc: Pilot voice id: stored or generated from owner, subrace and gender.

GetPos.doc: Returns the position/rotation/direction array (12 values), refreshed from the 3D object.

GetPriceForUpgrade.doc: Price of the next upgrade levels.

GetQuestionBody.doc: Returns the dialog body id for the question. Always -1 (none) here.

GetQuestionHeader.doc: Returns the dialog header id for the question. Always 0 here.

GetRawName.doc: Name for non-player ships: override name, ware name, or the formatted name limited to 190 pixels.

GetRebuild.doc: True when the ship is rebuilt (bit 67108864 of field 13 is clear).

GetRelation.doc: Relation to another object's owner race; none when relation checks are disabled (m13 bit 1).

GetRelationEnemyOf.doc: Relation to another object also checking its enemy-of relation to this ship.

GetRepairPrice.doc: Price of repairing 1% hull per full repair unit; based on ship value scaled by the notoriety-dependent repair modifier (default 2%).

flag 8 in the ware table: upgradable ware with levels
flag 1: use the buyer's normal price instead of the minimum price

GetSalePrice.doc: Price at which the ship would be sold to a station or owner: hull price (station product price or average), minus repair cost, scaled by the buyer's notoriety, plus installed equipment and upgrades.

GetSaturationModifier.doc: Returns the saturation modifier of the ship (field 32).

GetScannerRange.doc: Scanner range from the global parameters, by the scanner ware fitted: 16,52 gives parameter 6, 16,51 gives parameter 5, otherwise parameter 4.

GetShieldBoardingThreshold.doc: Returns entry 5 of the ship boarding table: the shield value that enables boarding (probably).

GetShieldPercent.doc: Current shield as percent of the maximum.

GetShieldPowerGenerator.doc: Shield power generation of the subtype from the native type table.

GetShieldRating.doc: Installed shield capacity as percent of what the best shield type in all bays would give.

GetShields.doc: Array of installed shield types per bay.

GetShoppingList.doc: Shopping list of the ship's job, if it has one.

GetSize.doc: Radius/size of the ship from its 3D object, or 10000 when the ship is not active.

GetSlotIndex.doc: Returns the slot index of the ship (field 86).

GetSlotObject.doc: Returns the object that holds this ship in a slot (field 85).

GetSpeakerByName.doc: Finds a speaker (pilot or passenger) by pilot name. For a carrier (class 2033) the search continues in its ships.

GetSpecialMissileMask.doc: Missile class mask restricted to the race's special missiles.

GetSpecialTurretLaserMask.doc: Laser class mask of the turret restricted to the special lasers of the race.

GetSpeedLimit.doc: Returns the speed limit of the ship (field 94).

GetStandardMissileMask.doc: Missile class mask restricted to the race's standard missiles.

GetStandardTurretLaserMask.doc: Laser class mask of the turret restricted to the standard lasers of the ship's race (Terran/Pirate-like races 7,17,18 use the ship type's default race).

GetStartingHangar.doc: Returns the hangar object this ship is starting from, if it is in the start-in-hangar state (m55 = 1 and no sector); otherwise nothing.

GetStatus.doc: Status value (slot 12 of m18), or nothing if it was never set.

GetStepX.doc: Movement step along X for the subtype, scaled by the step upgrade percent m70.

GetStepY.doc: Movement step along Y for the subtype, scaled by the step upgrade percent m70.

GetStepZ.doc: Movement step along Z for the subtype, scaled by the step upgrade percent m70.

GetStrength.doc: Combat strength estimate: shield + hull + maximum laser damage.

GetTotalAmmunitionCount.doc: Loaded rounds plus 200 per magazine in cargo.

GetTotalPriceForUpgrades.doc: Total price for a number of upgrade levels starting at the current level.

GetTradeContainerSize.doc: Total cargo capacity: type base size plus extension.

GetTrueOwner.doc: Owner object of the ship (field m41).

GetTruePassengers.doc: Passengers aboard that are not marines, keyed by person.

GetTrueWareTypeCount.doc: Spare count of a ware: cargo minus installed shields/lasers and minus default equipment.

GetTrueWareTypeCountWithHardware.doc: Spare count of a ware: cargo minus the shields/lasers currently installed.

GetTurretCommand.doc: Command id given to the turret via script, if numeric.

GetTurretFiringMask.doc: Bit mask of the turret's guns that are in the current fire group.

GetTurretTrackingAimFromScript.doc: Target object set for the turret by a script command, if it exists.

GetTypeCode.doc: Packed type code: 458752 (type 7 shifted by 16) with the subtype added.

GetUnknown.doc: Returns bit 131072 of field 13. Its meaning is not known.

GetWantedCount.doc: Returns the amount of the wanted freight (field 83).

GetWantedFreight.doc: Returns the ware the ship wants to buy (field 82).

GetWantedFreightPrice.doc: Returns the price the ship offers for its wanted freight (field 84).

GetWarWingID.doc: Returns the war wing id of the ship (field 38).

GetWareTransportClass.doc: Maximum transport class of wares the ship type can carry.

comments.text: ware flags in g46: 1 = installed/equipment, 2 = unique, 8 = upgrade with levels, 1024 = marines

GetWareTypeContainerSize.doc: How many units of a ware the ship could hold in total: cargo size divided by ware volume, or 1/upgrade limit/large number for hardware wares; marines are limited by their quarters.

GetWareTypeCount.doc: Cargo count of a ware; marines are counted from passengers.

GetWareTypeCountVolume.doc: Cargo volume used by a ware type.

GetWareTypeCountWithPredefined.doc: Cargo count plus predefined (built-in) count for the ship type.

GetWareTypeFree.doc: How many more units of a ware fit: marine space, unique item free, upgrade levels left, or cargo free / volume.

GetWing.doc: Returns the wing id of the ship (field 100).

comments.text: page 1706 holds the names of player ship types

GetYourName.doc: Name shown for the ship: custom player name, override name, or for player-owned ships the type name plus variation (fallback 'Your Object'); other owners use GetRawName.

GiveFormationLeadershipTo.doc: Hands the formation to the follower arg1. Arg1 joins this ship's own leader (or becomes free), and the other followers join arg1. Each follower gets Signal_FormationLeaderChanged.

HasCockpit.doc: True if the ship type has a cockpit body.

HasCommandPreload.doc: True if the ship's command preload with this id is available (asks the command library C703).

HasCommandUpgrade.doc: True (returns the upgrade record) if the ship has the upgrade that unlocks this command id, as given by the command library C703.

HasFreight.doc: True if the ship carries any freight: any non-zero entry in the freight table m35.

HasIllegalGoods.doc: True if the cargo contains wares illegal in the current sector owner's law.

comments.text: attacker in another environment is ignored (except class 2066 mines)
player hits another owner: notoriety -1 at most once a minute
attacker becomes an enemy
attack registered only if long enough since the last (1.5 time steps)
possible bug: attacker may be 0 here (death without attacker) but arg4.GetObjectID() is called unconditionally

Hit.doc: Entry point for a weapon hit by 'attacker' (shield, hull and shield-piercing damage). Handles notoriety, relation changes, calls for help, damage, and death (kill notoriety, StartKilled for the player, Signal_Killed and KilledInGalaxy for NPCs).

comments.text: equipment damage uses the larger of shield damage and hull+pierce

HitDamage.doc: Applies damage: shieldDamage first reduces shields; the remaining hull damage (hullDamage, scaled by what the shield absorbed; negative means 'take the overflow') and extra damage that ignores shields reduce the hull. Also calls MakeDamage for random equipment damage.

IgnoreCommandScript.doc: Marks a command as ignored for this ship (script -1).

InitPos.doc: Sets initial position with default orientation (forward vector 65536).

InstallCriticalWare.doc: Like InstallWare but ignores cargo-space limits by raising the extra trade container size by the overflow.

comments.text: fly effect bit 32 = special weapon; bit 128 = special flag tracked in m12 bit 256
fly effect bit 64 = ammunition weapon, counted in m78
ammo ware encoded as (class<<16)|type

InstallLaserInTurret.doc: Replaces the laser in a gun slot of the turret: removes the old laser (and its damage totals, ammo and special flags), installs the new type if the turret accepts it and updates damage sums m75..m78 and ammo. Returns 1 if a laser was installed.

InstallWare.doc: Adds ware and installs it: lasers, shields and missiles through their own handlers, other wares through AddWare.

IsAttacked.doc: True when this ship has an attacker and was attacked less than 60 seconds ago (m53 is the last attack time).

IsAutoPatrolSectorToEnv.doc: True when the ship returns to its environment in auto patrol (bit 2 of field 14, probably).

comments.text: bit 2048 of field 14 = autojump enabled

IsAutojumpActive.doc: True when the autojump is enabled (bit 2048 of field 14).

IsAutopilotActive.doc: True while script task slot 0 (the command script) is running.

IsAvailableForDefaultJob.doc: True when the ship is idle: no current command of the active kinds, no attack target and no attacker. Used to pick ships for default jobs.

IsBeingBoarded.doc: Always false in this class; boarding subclasses override it.

IsCapturable.doc: Base: ships cannot be captured; overridden in subclasses.

IsCargoVisible.doc: True when the cargo of the ship is visible (bit 268435456 of field 13).

IsCivilian.doc: True when the ship is civilian (bit 536870912 of field 13).

IsCmdConsoleEntry.doc: True if the command console menu of this ship contains the given entry id.

IsCommunicationDisabled.doc: True when communication is disabled (bit 64 of field 14).

IsDecoupledShipsLeader.doc: True if this ship is the leader of a group of decoupled ships (flag 16384).

IsDisabled.doc: True if the ship is disabled (flag 1024).

IsDocked.doc: Returns the environment object if the ship is inside a station, dock or carrier-like container (classes 2016/2033/2014), else nothing.

IsDockingAllowedForShip.doc: True if the ship is a class 2092 ship with the same owner and this has a cockpit.

IsDockingPossibleOf.doc: True if the given object is a class 2092 ship and this has a cockpit.

IsDropFreightDisabled.doc: True when dropping freight is disabled (bit 1024 of field 14).

IsEmergencyJumpActive.doc: True when the emergency jump is enabled (bit 4096 of field 14).

IsEnemy.doc: True if the other object's owner is an enemy, or (enemy-of enabled) the other considers this ship an enemy.

IsEnemyHere.doc: True if the object's owner would be attacked by this ship given notoriety (threshold -100 in the owner's core sector, else -10000); pirates attack all.

IsEnemyOfEnabled.doc: Flag 16: the ship may be an enemy of others.

IsFleetLeader.doc: True when this ship is its own fleet leader.

IsHiddenInSectorMap.doc: Hidden state used for the sector map; inside a sector uses the base class logic.

IsHired.doc: True if the ship is a hired ship (flag 512).

comments.text: capture-capable equipment: class 2064, or wares 16/72 and 16/61 (marine / capture gear)

IsInCaptureRange.doc: True if the ship is a marine carrier (class 2064 or has ware 16:72 / 16:61) and target is within 15000 m of its hull.

IsInFleet.doc: True when the ship has a fleet leader.

IsInFollowMode.doc: True when the ship is in follow mode (bit 64 of field 13).

IsInHomeSector.doc: True if the owner object is in the same environment as the ship.

IsInOwnerCoreSector.doc: True if the ship is in a core sector owned by its owner.

IsJumpCountDown.doc: True while the jump-drive countdown of this ship is running (m12 bit 24).

IsLaserInGroup.doc: True if laser slot belongs to the fire group (bit mask per slot).

IsMarineCapable.doc: True if the ship can carry marines: marine volume is allowed, life support is on, and with the argument set there is free room.

comments.text: the turret loop starts at 1, so turret 0 is never checked (possible bug, or intended)

IsMissileBoat.doc: True if a turret other than turret 0 has no laser mask, i.e. carries missiles.

comments.text: negative slot = no missile
missile must be in GetMissileMask() and in stock
m34 is the next allowed fire time; 600000 ms = 10 min window

IsMissileReady.doc: True if the missile at the given slot is in the ship's missile mask, the ship has stock of it, and the reload timer has expired.

IsNotifyCommandNoneEnabled.doc: True if the 'notify when command ends' option (m13 bit 5) is on.

IsPassengerCapable.doc: True if the ship can take passengers: passenger volume (ware 12,22) is allowed, life support is on, and with the argument set there is free room.

IsPilotFemale.doc: True if the pilot is female (stored gender 2, else generated).

IsPlayerWingMen.doc: True if flagged as player wingman.

IsPropertyListHidden.doc: True when the property list of the ship is hidden (bit 524288 of field 14).

IsRaceCovered.doc: True when the race covers the ship (bit 134217728 of field 13).

IsScanIllegal.doc: True if a scan by the player here would be illegal: a foreign, not-hired ship in a restricted owner's sector without the player's licence.

IsSelfDestructing.doc: Non-zero while the self-destruct countdown runs.

IsShowNotAsEnemy.doc: Returns bit 1 of field 14: the ship is shown as not an enemy (probably).

IsStartActionEnabled.doc: True unless StartAction has been disabled (flag 4096).

IsTargetInFiringRangeOfTurret.doc: True if the target object is inside the firing range of this ship's turrets. Only valid in a galaxy sector (class 2001) in the same environment; returns 0 otherwise.

IsTargetVisible.doc: False when either object is hidden and the distance exceeds the global stealth range plus both sizes.

IsTurretForMissile.doc: Stub, always false here; the turret check is IsTurretForMissiles.

IsTurretForMissiles.doc: True if the turret has no laser mask (a missile turret).

IsWithFleet.doc: True when the ship flies with its fleet (bit 1048576 of field 14).

comments.text: reason 17 = silent removal (no LogDestroyed)

JumpOutOfExistence.doc: Makes a non-player ship vanish with a jump flash and then self-destruct (reason 17, no wreck or log).

16 s charge for NPC ships unless flags 1|2

JumpToSector.doc: Jump drive / gate warp to a destination, which may be a gate (2014), sector (2001) or position object (2062). Player: charges the drive with a voice countdown then starts the warp. NPC ships: wait for slots, burn energy cells, vanish and are re-added at the target. Flags: 1 = no energy cost / forced, 2 = skip countdown, 4 = no jump-drive ware needed, 8 = free of energy. Returns 3 success, 6 failure.

comments.text: cause 3 only counts as a hostile kill if the killer is an enemy
player kill: statistics by ware type and sub type
forked pilot message 9 (kill confirmation)
weapon type 9 and class 2134 victim: achievement PlasmaBurstKill
stop the object with mode 8 (destroyed)
wreck object (class 1653) if the type creates a wreck
destroy the script object

KilledBy.doc: Death handler. cause: 2 = weapon, 3 = collision-like (needs enemy check), others unspecified. Updates notoriety and relations, stats and achievements (plasma burst kill), removes from formations/rebuild lists, drops freight, spawns a wreck and destroys the object.

LaunchAllMarines.doc: Starts command 80 (launch marines) at a target when CanLaunchAllMarinesAtTarget allows it.

the first drone ware with stock is used; the launch count is capped by the stock

LaunchFightDrones.doc: Launches up to arg1 fight drones from the cargo in the current sector. Drone wares are 16,10 (class 2067), 16,110 (class 2146) and 16,109 (class 2147). Arg2 is the target for command 13, otherwise the drones attack this ship (command 4). Returns the number launched.

comments.text: pilot object class 2064 created with launch flag 267

LeaveShip.doc: Ejects the pilot from this ship. For a ship owned by a mission-controlled group a pilot object (class 2064, escape pod or suit) is created and returned. Clears the pilot and hands the ship to the free-ship owner g7[12].

LoadAmmunition.doc: Loads a magazine (200 rounds) from cargo if no rounds are loaded. Returns 1 on success.

comments.text: g46 bit 1024 = marine ware (moved as passengers)
g46 bit 1 set: station stock is not changed

LoadWare.doc: Takes arg2 units of a ware out of the docked station (or carrier, class 2033) into this ship. Marines are moved one by one. Returns the number loaded.

comments.text: texts 35:1100050..1100054: destroyed, from factory, in sector, by

LogDestroyed.doc: Writes a destruction entry to the player's log for player-owned ships and for ships of other owners that carry flag 512. arg1 is the killer object, if known.

MakeBreak.doc: Stops the ship's model with the break code 9 (a braking stop used when a command is broken off).

comments.text: damage is ignored while the shield is above 15 percent and the hit is smaller than the shield
non-forced hits miss with 60 to 95 percent chance, growing as the hull gets weaker
roll 0..9: 0 laser, 1 shield, 2 missile destroyed; 3..7 a cargo ware; other values a random ware type 11..16
cargo hit: the ware must exist; flags g46 bit 4 (unique) and bit 8 protect it
destroying ware 1048601 in the player ship resets the grid

MakeDamage.doc: Applies arg1 damage to this ship. Shields absorb the hit first; then a random equipment piece (laser, shield, missile or cargo ware) can be destroyed. arg2 marks a forced or heavy hit (80 percent base, cannot miss).

MissileLaunched.doc: Hook called when a missile was launched; empty in this class.

comments.text: client state bit 16 prevents docking
message 102302: docking not allowed
message 102301: no dock port free

MovePlayerTo.doc: Moves the player ship to a sector (warp) or docks/lands at a station or ship, checking permission and playing refusal messages.

MoveTo.doc: Moves an active ship to another environment without deactivating it; frees the dock slot. Falls back to Remove+AddTo.

NoSafePosOnActivate.doc: True when the ship is activated without a safe position (bit 32 of field 13).

comments.text: incoming-message text built from page 35 with the ship name, message type 16

NotifyCommandStopped.doc: After a command ended: tells listeners after 3 s, and (for the player's own ships with notify enabled) posts the message that the ship has no command, unless its menu is open.

comments.text: C302 = GodEngine request queue; class 2135 excluded

NotifyEnvironmentHasFocus.doc: Called when the ship's sector gains or loses the player focus. When focus is gained, it removes the ship from the GodEngine request queue and interrupts its current task. Ships of class 2135 are skipped.

NotifyMsgBoxReturn.doc: Message box result handler: box id 32 with answer 1 starts the self-destruct sequence of the player ship.

comments.text: wing buttons are 350 + wing id

generic menus: 2266 exchange, 2305 exchange targets, 2268 software menu, 2217 trade, 2265 equipment, 2330 graphs, 2232/2233 landed/owned ships
