OnContextMenuReturn.doc: Executes the chosen context menu button: opens menus (details, comm, freight, weapons, generic menus by class id), issues commands to the ship (follow, protect, attack, dock, stop) with a spoken confirmation, handles wing commands (351..359), drone orders, marine launch and missile barrage, scan, capture and self destruct confirmation.

comments.text: ids 351..359 are wing buttons; disabled while docked or when the player cannot accept commands

OnContextMenuUpdate.doc: Per-frame update of context menu buttons: disables buttons whose preconditions are no longer met (communication range, scan, enter/change ship, capture range, empty landed lists, docking, self-destruct) and refreshes dynamic button texts.

OnContextMenuUpdateInfo.doc: Fills the info panel of the command console entry (id 650) with the current command and its target name (2020:2 Command:).

comments.text: sample 1010; speech: ware name + voice line 1274
voice line 1275 after removing

OnLaserContextMenuReturn.doc: Handles the laser picker: install the chosen type in the turret slot, add/remove the laser to fire groups 1..4 (903..910), clear all groups (911), remove the laser (902) or open ware info (917). Plays a sample and a spoken confirmation.

OnLaserContextMenuUpdate.doc: Disables a laser type button when the turret's laser mask cannot take that type's group.

OnMissileContextMenuReturn.doc: Handles the missile picker: select the chosen missile type, deselect (913) or open ware info (917).

OnMissileContextMenuUpdate.doc: Disables a missile type button when this ship's missile mask does not include its group.

OwnerObjectDestroyed.doc: Called when an owner object is destroyed; clears the owner reference and the squad default homebase if it pointed to it.

Patch17_CheckCargoSize.doc: Patch 1.7 fix: if the ship carries ware 5/61 and m72 (probably cargo size) is at least 36000, reduce it by 6000.

comments.text: rebuild requests of stations 302 or 303 are cancelled for this ship
game tip 7 shown unless the player is in alert mode

PilotLeftShip.doc: Resets all crew and command state when the pilot leaves: formation, turrets, rebuild requests, ownership, job and autojump. Warns the player when the ship is capturable and in view.

ReceiveDialogParameter.doc: Dialog parameter hook. Not used by this class: always returns -1.

ReleaseFromSlot.doc: Releases the ship from its dock slot, clears the slot fields and resets the native dock port.

ReleasePassenger.doc: Removes a passenger. An invincible passenger is ejected into space instead of destroyed. Returns 1 when released.

ReleasePilotSpeaker.doc: Destroys the pilot speaker object and clears the pilot slot. Returns 1 when a pilot was released.

Remove.doc: Deactivates the ship and removes it from its environment.

RemoveAllFormationShips.doc: Detaches all followers from the formation and stops them.

RemoveCopyPilotSpeaker.doc: Returns a passenger object for the pilot: the current pilot speaker if there is one, otherwise a new speaker created from this ship. The argument is passed on as in RemovePilotSpeaker.

RemoveFlags.doc: Clears the given bits in the ship flag word (field 13).

RemoveFormationShip.doc: Removes a follower from this formation, clears its leader, and reorganises the rest from the removed position.

RemoveFromFleet.doc: Removes this ship from its fleet; if it is the leader, the whole fleet is disbanded.

RemoveFromFormation.doc: Removes this ship from its formation leader.

RemoveMarine.doc: Removes a marine from the passenger table and frees its volume. Returns 1 on success.

RemovePassenger.doc: Removes a passenger or marine from this ship. Returns the removed object, or nothing if it was not aboard.

RemovePilotSpeaker.doc: Removes the pilot speaker and returns it. With the argument set the pilot left the ship (PilotLeftShip), otherwise the pilot is changed (ChangePilot 0).

RemoveSpeakerObj.doc: Removes a pilot or passenger object from this ship. Returns true if the object was the pilot or a passenger.

comments.text: patterns 0 to 6 first move the last follower to the inserted index
pattern 0: rows alternate left and right of the leader, half a slot per step

the leader is reorganised too, so nested formations stay consistent

ReorgFormation.doc: Lays out the followers in the pattern of formationType (m17), sets each follower's offset and stops it, then reorganises the leader. arg1 is the index a follower was just inserted at (-1 for none); the last follower is moved there first. Patterns, probably: 0 alternating rows, 1 single line, 2 and 3 four-way blocks, 4 eight slots around the leader, 5 ring of four, 6 spiral, 7 random scatter.

comments.text: listener event 4096 = repaired

Repair.doc: Repairs the hull by 'amount'; notifies listeners with the repairer.

ResetResupply.doc: Clears the pending resupply table (m100) and its counter (m101).

whether the player has a licence to this owner's space

Scan.doc: Scans a target. The player's scan reveals cargo and checks for illegal goods; the owner's notoriety and the reaction of the target are handled in a forked task after 1 to 2 seconds. NPC scans can make the target drop illegal freight or attack.

ScannedBy.doc: Base scan bookkeeping for the parent class, then the Signal_Scanned event for this ship.

SelectAndFireMissileOn.doc: Fires a missile at the target if the fire roll succeeds and a ready missile is found for it. Returns true on launch.

distance to the target surface, reduced by 2/3 of both sizes
two passes: second pass installs a second laser type for remaining guns

SelectAndSwitchLaserForTarget.doc: Chooses the best laser type for the turret against a target (SETA-independent AI weapon selection) and installs it in all guns of the turret. Without a visible 3D target it just picks the longest range laser. Returns true if something was changed.

SelectLaserForTarget.doc: Same selection logic as SelectAndSwitchLaserForTarget but only returns the best laser type for the turret and target (or -1) without installing it.

comments.text: relax criteria: drop bit 1 first

SelectNewFormationLeader.doc: Chooses a new formation leader with the criteria of __selectNewFormationLeader. If nobody qualifies, the criteria are relaxed in turn: bit 1, then bit 2, then any follower.

reason 17 (jump away) is not logged as destroyed

SelfDestruct.doc: Destroys the ship without a killer. Reasons: 22 and 11 create a wreck, 14 is ignored if invincible (ship moved back instead), 17 silent removal, 18 landed. For the player it only sets the killed state.

SellWare.doc: Sells arg2 units of a ware from this ship to the docked station (class 2016) for its price. If the station is the ship's own container, it delegates to UnLoadWare. Marines can not be sold. Returns the number sold.

SendMessage.doc: Sends a message to the player in a fork, see SendMessageSync.

SendMessageSync.doc: Passes a message from this pilot to the player through the client (C150.ReceiveMessage) if the client is not in the blocked state (flag 32), the pilot has a voice and no voice is playing (C620).

comments.text: signal ids: 1000 attacked, 1003 leader changed, 1005/1006 help, 1010 damaged, 1011 scanned, 1012 docked, 1013/1014 buy/sell, 1015/1016 load/unload, 1017 wing remove, 1018 change sector

SendSignalFromScript.doc: Entry for MSCI scripts that raise a signal on this ship: validates the data-type codes in the argument pairs (65542 ship, 65543 station, 65544 sector, 9 = ware type, 4 = number) and calls the matching Signal_ function.

SetAmmoResupply.doc: Stores an ammo resupply count for a type (stored plus one).

SetAsPlayerShip.doc: Marks the 3D object as player object and resets the current missile when set.

SetAttackTarget.doc: Sets the attack target of the ship (field 93).

comments.text: attacker from the same owner: no change
m53 = age stamp of the attack (0 when cleared)

SetAttacker.doc: Records the object that last attacked this ship, with the game age of the attack. Attacks by the owner's own objects are ignored and the previous attacker is returned.

SetAutoPatrolSectorToEnv.doc: Enables patrol-to-environment mode (bit 1 of m13). When the ship is owned and has an environment, it is also registered in the owner's patrol list for that sector.

SetAutoWeaponSwapAllowed.doc: Enables or disables automatic weapon swapping. The field bit 4 in m13 is the disable flag, so true clears it.

SetAutojumpActivated.doc: Enables or disables autojump (bit 2048 of field 14).

comments.text: negative values are rejected

SetAutojumpMinRange.doc: Sets the minimum range for autojump. Negative values are ignored.

SetCanCallHelpFromRace.doc: Enables or disables calling for help from the race (bit 8 of field 14).

SetCargoVisible.doc: Sets or clears the cargo visibility (bit 268435456 of field 13).

comments.text: the civilian flag is mirrored to the native object (flags2 bit 24)

SetCivilian.doc: Sets the civilian flag (bit 29) and mirrors it to the native ship flags (bit 24).

SetCommand.doc: Sets the current command id and mirrors it to the script object command.

comments.text: 9/28 buy/sell ware and 10/29 best-price variants: m81 = ware key (type<<16|subtype)

SetCommandFromScript.doc: Stores a command and up to four (data type, value) parameter pairs coming from a script. For buy/sell ware commands (9, 10, 28, 29) it also caches ware, count and price.

SetCommandScript.doc: Sets a per-ship command script and its parameter. A script of 0 removes the entry.

SetCommandTarget.doc: Sets the first parameter pair (data type, value) of the command.

SetCommandTarget2.doc: Sets the second parameter pair (data type, value) of the command.

SetCoverRace.doc: Sets or clears race cover (bit 27) for a ship of race g7[8]. Covered ships leave the owner's patrol list and their relations are refreshed.

SetCoverRaceRecursive.doc: Applies race cover to the formation leader of this ship if there is one, otherwise to this ship and its formation.

SetCurrentMissileType.doc: Selects the current missile type and refreshes the player HUD (C605).

SetDefaultEquipmentCount.doc: Sets how many units of a ware belong to the default (shipyard) equipment; 0 removes the entry.

SetDestination.doc: Sets the destination of the ship (field 92).

SetDisabled.doc: Sets or clears the disabled flag.

SetDisowned.doc: Hook called on an owner object when it loses this ship; empty here.

SetEmergencyJumpActive.doc: Enables or disables the emergency jump (bit 4096 of field 14).

SetEmergencyJumpMinShields.doc: Sets the shield percentage needed for the emergency jump. Accepted only from 0 to 100.

SetEnemyOfEnabled.doc: Sets the enemy-of flag and updates the 3D object.

comments.text: war-object (plot) ships create their wings after a short random delay
remember time of entering a station
player ship (g9) entering a capturable ship: stat 5310 and capture

SetEnvironment.doc: Moves the ship logically into a new environment (sector or station). Updates owner patrol lists, fires sector change, spawns war-object wings, resets cargo visibility, auto-captures when the player enters an capturable ship (2033).

SetExtraTradeContainerSize.doc: Sets the size of the purchased cargo bay extension (clamped to the allowed range) and mirrors it into the ware table key 1048592 (16,16).

SetFireMissileNextTime.doc: Sets the time of the next missile shot (field 35).

SetFireMissileProb.doc: Sets the probability of firing a missile (field 33).

SetFireMissileTimeDiff.doc: Sets the time difference between missile shots (field 34).

comments.text: a leader outside any fleet first becomes the leader of its own fleet
a leader that is only a member is made the leader
this ship led its fleet: leadership is handed to the new leader

SetFleetLeader.doc: Joins this ship to the fleet of the given leader; nothing removes it from its fleet. Makes the leader a fleet leader first if needed.

SetFollowMode.doc: Sets follow mode (bit 6 of m12): the ship follows its formation leader.

SetForgiveAttack.doc: Enables or disables forgiving attacks (bit 4 of field 14).

comments.text: guard against a formation cycle: a follower of this ship is detached from its leader

SetFormationLeader.doc: Sets the formation leader. If the new leader is one of this ship's followers, it is first detached from its current leader.

SetFormationPos.doc: Stores this ship's formation offset in the position array (indices 9 to 11).

comments.text: formation types 0 to 7; ReorgFormation holds the layouts

SetFormationType.doc: Sets the formation pattern (0..7) and reorganises the formation.

SetFuelResupply.doc: Stores the fuel resupply count (stored plus one).

SetGroupRelation.doc: Sets the explicit relation to a race group; keeps friend mask (m66) and enemy mask (m67), then pushes to the 3D object.

SetHidden.doc: Sets hidden flag and mirrors it to the 3D object flag 16.

SetHighlighted.doc: Sets highlight flag and 3D flag2 bit 8192.

SetHired.doc: Sets or clears hired flag and registers the ship with the player's hired list; never for player-owned ships.

SetHueModifier.doc: Sets the hue modifier and passes it to the native ship. Ignored for subtypes whose default race is 2 (their colour is fixed).

SetHull.doc: Sets the hull, clamped to 0..max. Invincible ships are kept at least at 92% hull.

SetInvincible.doc: Sets invincible flag (32768) and the matching 3D object flag2 bit.

SetJobLeader.doc: Sets the leader ship of the job (field 41).

SetKnown.doc: Marks the ship as known or unknown. Unknown is bit 17 of m12 and the native flag 8. Making it known tells the player's race knowledge through SetRaceKnown.

SetLaserTargetMode.doc: Sets the laser target mode in m12: 2 sets bits 19 and 20, 1 sets bit 19 only, anything else clears both.

SetLastAttackTime.doc: Sets the time of the last attack on the ship (field 50).

SetMissileResupply.doc: Stores a missile resupply count for a subtype (stored plus one).

SetNoCollWithSpecial.doc: Sets flag 512 in m13: no collision with special objects, and mirrors it to the 3D flags.

SetNoFind.doc: Sets or clears the no-find flag (bit 262144 of field 13).

SetNoSafePosOnActivate.doc: Sets or clears the no-safe-position flag (bit 32 of field 13).

SetNotifyCommandNone.doc: Switches the 'notify when command ends' option (m13 bit 5).

SetOverrideNameFlags.doc: Sets name-composition flags overriding the defaults.

SetOverrideNameID.doc: Sets a fixed name text id (page 17) overriding the automatic name.

SetOwned.doc: Hook called on an owner object when it receives this ship; empty here.

comments.text: player takes the ship: cancel pending rebuild requests
class 2135 ships become known to the player at once
player's own ship rotates faster (100) than other player ships (50)

SetOwner.doc: Changes the owner race of the ship. Cleans up old owner links (messages, rebuild requests, patrol lists, squad), updates sector visibility, sets SA group, relations and, when the player becomes the owner, resets job, enemy flags and rotation limits.

SetOwnerObject.doc: Sets the owner object (e.g. home station), notifying the old and new object.

SetPilotFemale.doc: Sets pilot gender (only for subrace 1); stored as flag+1.

SetPilotFightSkill.doc: Sets pilot fight skill 0..30 (not for the player ship).

SetPilotMarine.doc: Copies the marine's fighting, hacking, mechanics and engineering skills into the status array (slots 11, 9, 8 and 10).

SetPilotMorale.doc: Sets pilot morale 0..30 (stored in the name/pilot array slot 5).

comments.text: the pilot must be a 1700 object that is not inside a container

SetPilotSpeaker.doc: Makes a free passenger (class 1700) the pilot: copies its pilot data, status and owner to this ship and links it as the pilot speaker. Does nothing if a pilot is already set.

SetPilotSubraceID.doc: Stores the pilot's subrace id (slot 0 of the pilot-skill array).

SetPilotTradeSkill.doc: Sets pilot trade skill 0..30 (not for the player ship).

SetPilotVoiceAndFace.doc: Stores custom voice and face ids.

SetPlayerWingMen.doc: Marks or unmarks the ship as a player wingman (flag 2).

SetPos.doc: Moves the ship to a safe position near the given point.

SetPropertyListHiddenState.doc: Sets or clears the hidden state of the property list (bit 524288 of field 14).

comments.text: combine race enemies (m68) and personal enemies (m67) into an enemy; m66 are friends

SetRaceGroupRelation.doc: Sets the race-derived (notoriety based) relation to a race group: m68 holds forced race enemies. Updates SA group relation (-1 enemy, 1 friend, 0 neutral).

SetRaceLogicControl.doc: Enable/disable race AI control of the ship (flag 65536 set means no race logic).

SetRaceRelationsFromNotoriety.doc: Rebuilds the race enemy mask from the owner's notoriety toward each race. Enemy at <= -10000 (-100 in the owner's core sector), friend above 10000.

comments.text: colour parameter block chosen by race
default race: no hue range, saturation 65536
hue range wraps around 360

SetRandomColorModifier.doc: Picks a random hue and saturation for the ship from the race colour ranges (global parameters). A hue of 0 gets the default saturation, otherwise the range saturation.

SetRandomGalaxyDirection.doc: Sets a random forward direction vector from random angles.

comments.text: bit 67108864 set = no rebuild, so true clears the bit

SetRebuild.doc: Sets whether the ship is rebuilt. Bit 67108864 of field 13 means the ship is NOT rebuilt: set rebuild clears the bit, clearing it sets the bit.

SetRelation.doc: Sets this ship's relation to the owner race of another object.

SetRelationsFromNotoriety.doc: Rebuilds friend and enemy masks from the owner's notoriety toward each race (enemy <= -10000, friend > 10000). Skips race 10 (Xenon) unless the parameter is set.

SetRelationsToAll.doc: Sets the same relation to every race except the owner's.

SetRotAccelLimit.doc: Sets the rotational acceleration limit (at least 1) and passes it to the native ship.

SetSaturationModifier.doc: Sets the colour saturation modifier and passes it to the native ship.

SetSectorRelations.doc: Pushes all stored relation masks of races 1..19 to the 3D object.

SetShield.doc: Sets the shield strength (clamped at 0). On inactive ships clamps to the maximum and queues regeneration if below.

SetShowNotAsEnemy.doc: Sets bit 0 of m13 (show as not enemy) and the matching native flag (bit 30 of flags2).

SetSlot.doc: Stores the docking object and the port index this ship occupies.

SetSpeed.doc: Sets current and desired speed, clamped to [0, max speed].

SetStartActionEnabled.doc: Enable/disable the default StartAction behaviour (flag 4096 set means disabled).

SetStatus.doc: Stores a status value in slot 12 of the status array m18, creating the array on first use.

SetTractorTarget.doc: Remembers the ship currently attached by tractor beam to this one.

SetUsrAvrSpeed.doc: Sets flag bit 30 of m12: the user average speed limit used by CheckSpeedLimit.

SetWantedFreight.doc: Stores the ware key the ship is supposed to carry.

SetWing.doc: Sets the wing id of the ship (field 100).

SetWithFleet.doc: Sets or clears the with-fleet flag (bit 1048576 of field 14).

SetYourName.doc: Sets a custom player-given ship name and clears the override name id and flags.

ShipAttackedBy.doc: Hook called when the ship is attacked; empty here.

comments.text: still cooling down if the next launch time is in the future, within 10 minutes; longer waits are treated as stale
a negative subtype picks the first missile with stock and an allowed group
native launch when this ship and the target have native objects
without a target object only guided missiles (guidance flag 1) can launch
hit roll: 95 percent for non-ships, 30 percent for ships, 60 percent for class 2073 (big ships)
boarding pod hit: 84 percent of hits break marines out

ShootMissile.doc: Fires a missile at a target in the same sector, after the launch cooldown has passed and with stock available. With a target object id it launches natively. Otherwise the hit is rolled: 95 percent for non-ships, 30 percent for ships, 60 percent for big ships. A boarding pod that hits breaks marines out of the hull with 84 percent chance.

comments.text: a turret with lasers and no missile mask is refused as the launcher
no turret given: the nearest cockpit's turret without lasers is used
the cockpit closest to the enemy wins
guidance flag 4: extra volley of missiles
guidance flag 2: 250 ms between volley shots
successful launch: one missile leaves the cargo
boarding pod (missile 35): marines are launched in the pod
last missile of the selected type: the current type is reset

ShootMissileSECOBID.doc: Fires a missile of a subtype at a target object id through a turret, or through a missile turret chosen automatically (the nearest to the target among turrets without lasers). Guidance flag 4 fires a volley of extra missiles in a forked task. Returns the new missile object (class 2085) or 0.

comments.text: 600000 ms = 10 min; the timer m34 counts absolute game time (TI_ units)
failed roll: retry in 1 s

ShouldFireMissile.doc: Rolls the missile fire chance (m32, percent) when the reload window is over. On a failed roll it postpones the next check by 1 s.

comments.text: 65542 = ship data type, 65543 = station data type
no shield left: also raise signal 1010 (Damaged)

Signal_Attacked.doc: Signal 1000: ship was attacked by a ship or station. mode: 0 normal, 2/3 while landing. Starts or interrupts the command script, and also fires Damaged when shields are gone.

Signal_BuyWare.doc: Signal 1013: ship bought wares. Args are partner, ware, count and price (each with data type 9/4), plus the other ship.

Signal_CallForHelp.doc: Signal 1008: another ship calls for help against 'enemy'. Both objects are passed with their data type codes.

Signal_Captured.doc: Signal 1004: ship was captured (pilot left). Same argument layout as Signal_Killed with the capturer.

comments.text: data type 65544 = sector

Signal_ChangeSector.doc: Signal 1018: ship entered a new sector. Runs secondary signals and the command script registered for 1018.

comments.text: stat counter 5180 = passengers delivered
owner is paid the passenger fare
player ship docking at a station reveals its wares
player ship picks up marines waiting at the station
args: {data type 65543 (station), station}
signal 1012; priority -1 for the player, -19 for NPCs
NPC: interrupt the running script with the command script

Signal_Docked.doc: Called when the ship docks at a station: pays out passengers for this destination, lets the player's marines be picked up, and runs the secondary-signal / command script for signal 1012 (docked).

Signal_FollowerNeedsHelp.doc: Signal 1006 (to the leader): a follower was attacked by 'attacker'.

Signal_FormationLeaderChanged.doc: Signal 1003: the formation leader changed to newLeader.

comments.text: data type code chain: 65559 / 65562 / ships 65542 / stations 65543 / sectors 65544 / other 65553; then type 18 (command) and m57..m65

Signal_Killed.doc: Signal 1001: this ship was destroyed. Builds the argument list (killer with its data type code, followed by the current command parameters) and runs secondary signals plus the command script.

Signal_LeaderNeedsHelp.doc: Signal 1005 (to followers): the formation leader was attacked by 'attacker'; passes leader and attacker with data type codes.

Signal_LoadWare.doc: Signal 1015: wares were loaded (transferred) into the ship.

Signal_RequestUnDock.doc: Signal 1009: undock requested. Interrupts the running command script or starts the registered one.

Signal_SellWare.doc: Signal 1014: ship sold wares. Same arguments as Signal_BuyWare.

Signal_UnloadWare.doc: Signal 1016: wares were unloaded from the ship.

Signal_WingRemove.doc: Signal 1017: ship removed from its wing. Passes the current command and parameters (m57..m65).

StartAction.doc: Starts the default action of the ship. Sets the home sector m43 first when it is not set. Does nothing when flag 4096 is set.

StartExecuteCommand.doc: Starts command arg1 with target arg2. Thin wrapper around StartExecuteCommand8.

StartExecuteCommand2.doc: Starts command arg1 with two parameters, arg2 and arg3. Wrapper around StartExecuteCommand8.

StartExecuteCommand4.doc: Starts command arg1 with four parameters, arg2..arg5. Wrapper around StartExecuteCommand8.

comments.text: command ids are the ship command numbers used by C2004 (0 = stop, 11 = set owner object, 20 = restart default action)
commands without arguments
commands 25/50/52: optional sector argument (patrol-like), 65544 = sector tag
station target is optional; anything that is not a station (class 2016) is dropped
arg2 must be a sector (class 2001); x/y/z are given in script units and divided by 500
class 2084 object target only
command 48 only for sector target with arg6 == 7 or 45
command 26: arg3 is a position array {x,y,z[,sector]}; sector defaults to the ship's own sector
command 5 (follow): target tag chosen by class: 9001 formation, 1700 person, 2004 ship, 2016 station, 2001 sector, else generic
command 104: tag from target class (station / ship / generic)

StartExecuteCommand8.doc: Entry point for ship commands issued from MSCI scripts / the UI with up to 8 arguments. Normalises each command id's arguments into a typed array (type tags 65542 ship, 65543 station, 65544 sector, 65553 generic object, 21 sub-array, 4 integer, 9 object id) and forwards it to StartExecuteCommandFromScript. Coordinates are divided by 500 (script units).

comments.text: command 11: only accept a station / carrier as owner object
GetCommandScript returns {scriptId, parameter} for the command id, or 0
command 72 starts with script flag 16
command 71 (board ship): target must be a ship that CanBeBoarded
commands 78/79 only valid for class 2092 ships
command 28: remember wanted sector/amounts in m81..m83, negative counts clamped to 0
command 104: flag word comes from arg[3]

StartExecuteCommandFromScript.doc: Validates the typed argument array for a ship command and, if it matches the command's expected signature, starts the command script via StartThisScriptID (or the frozen variant when the ship is currently controlled through the monitor). Wrong argument shapes are silently ignored. Commands 28/9 also store the wanted sector/wares into m81..m83.

StartFollowLeader.doc: Starts the follow-leader command (command 5) with arg1 as the leader.

StartJob.doc: Starts the job script of job id m38 through the job table (C6001). When there is no job script, falls back to StartAction.

StartKill.doc: Starts the kill command against the target (command 13).

StartKillAllEnemiesAndLand.doc: Starts the kill-all-enemies-and-land command (command 14) with a landing target.

StartKillAndLand.doc: Starts the kill-and-land command against the target (command 23) with a second parameter.

StartKillPreferred.doc: Starts the preferred-kill command (command 23) against the target.

comments.text: sample 929 is the alarm, repeated every 0.9 s (only audible for the player)
one spoken number per second on page 1951

StartSelfDestructSequence.doc: Starts the self-destruct countdown: alarm sound loop, voice announcement (13:1100026 'Self destruct sequence initiated') and spoken count from 9 down, then selfdestruct with reason 22 (the player gets StartKilled).

StartTransferToHangar.doc: Starts a transfer to hangar arg2: command 7 (dock) when docking is possible and allowed, otherwise command 4.

comments.text: -1: no turret is under the player's cockpit control
the player's active turret is started freezed, others run free when no turret is manned (m3 check)
command 0 stops all turret scripts

StartTurretCommand.doc: Starts a turret command: 100..107, 900..963 run the turret command script on one turret (-1 for all turrets, skipping turrets not in the player's active monitor), 0 stops the turret scripts. Returns 1 when started, nothing otherwise.

Stop.doc: Stops the 3D object with stop mode 5.

StopCommand.doc: Cancels the current command completely (all scripts, formation membership, slot).

StopCommandReleaseFromSlot.doc: Releases the dock slot when the ship is no longer docked to that slot object.

StopShip.doc: Stops the ship dead (speed, glide and rotation to 0); optionally also cancels the current command.

StopTurrets.doc: Stops the script tasks of all turrets (task ids 1..n-1) and task 33.

comments.text: FindShip with a fixed class/relation filter mask, max 200 results
skip ships of the excluded owner race id
the player's ship counts double

StrengthInRange.doc: Compares military strength around this ship: sums GetStrength() of friends (own side) and enemies found within a range. Returns either the ratio enemy/friend in percent (asRatio set) or friend minus enemy strength.

SwitchFleetLeader.doc: Hands fleet leadership to another ship; all other fleet members are re-linked to it.

SwitchLaserOfTurret.doc: Installs laser type into a gun of the turret if the cargo holds one (or empties the slot for type < 0). Returns success.

SwitchSoftware.doc: Keeps the mutually exclusive software pair (16,61)/(16,72) consistent depending on which of (16,60)/(16,61)/(16,72) are installed.

TradeWare.doc: Trade entry point; adds or removes cargo.

comments.text: free container space plus the passenger's volume (ware 12,22) must cover one marine (ware 16,107)

TrainPassengerToMarine.doc: Turns a passenger aboard into a marine if there is room, then adds it as a marine. Returns the AddMarine result.

comments.text: angle tolerance 150; minimum speed value 160

TurretTurnToObject.doc: Orders a turret to rotate towards an object using the 3D object. Returns 9 when aligned, 12 for the other finished state, 4 while still turning or if the ship has no 3D instance.

comments.text: ships of class 2004 may refuse to carry this ware type
player-owned ship: never unload more than the station can take
g46 bit 1024: marines, taken from the passenger table m98
marines owned by the player pool g8 are returned to it
normal ware: station receives transferable units, the ship loses arg2 units
possible loss: an NPC ship loses arg2 units while the station only receives v5

UnLoadWare.doc: Unloads arg2 units of a ware from this ship into the docked station (class 2016 or carrier 2033), limited by the station's free space. Marines are handed to the station, or released as passengers when the ship is not the player's. Returns the number unloaded (marines: count moved).

comments.text: only the player ship (g9) uses this jump
no temporary sector yet: create one, and stop if that fails
target sector is not jumpable: message 35:4906 and stop
less than 5 of ware 11,0 (energy): speech line 13:1100056 Jump device aborted, not enough energy
DoUnfocussedJump(2): arg is the percent chance of a random target
old sector record: element 3 is the sector object
return to the old sector

UnfocussedJump.doc: Jump for the player ship when it is not the focus: a jump to a sector of the player's choice is replaced by a random or temporary sector jump. Needs jump energy (ware 11,0).

UpdatePosition.doc: Refreshes the stored position array from the 3D object.

UpdateRelations.doc: Recomputes relations from notoriety unless the ship is fighting or a flagged owner; then pushes them to the 3D object.

UseAmmunition.doc: Consumes loaded rounds (negative delta); removes the entry when empty.

comments.text: rotation acceleration scales with pilot fight skill (+0..2 random)
big ship (2073) with more than one turret and no laser in turret 0
flight mode 2 = attack

__AttackRunOnTarget.doc: Attack flight against a ship/station until in firing position (or timeout). Rotation acceleration depends on the pilot's fight skill; big ships without a front laser use SA_AttackObjectBig. Returns 4 default, 7 interrupted, 8 target gone, 9 reached attack position, 12 timeout.

comments.text: returns nothing: refused
more than an hour since the last excuse: count reset, allowed
fewer than 3 excuses in the window: allowed

__CanExcuse.doc: Counts an excuse for this ship and returns 1 if it is allowed. Excuses are allowed at most 3 times per hour of game time; an excuse within 90 seconds of the previous one is refused and counted.

comments.text: target is an unbroken rock field: slow down and idle shortly first when already close
action id 15 = collecting
flight mode 3
next collectible rock position
off-screen ship waits for a while after each step

__CaptureObject.doc: Flies to and collects/captures an object: picks up debris rocks (class 1650) with SA_CollectDebris or tractors ware-like objects with SA_CaptureObject. Returns 4 default, 6 nothing left to collect, 7 interrupted, 8 target gone, 9 done, 12 timeout.

comments.text: action id 8 = defensive move (m55)
collision: action 12 (avoid collision) with a clearance of 3x size + 25000

__DefensiveMove.doc: Evasive flying for a given time (ms): the ship manoeuvres away from the attacker via SA_DefensiveMove; with no 3D instance it just waits. Returns 4 when the time is up, 7 if interrupted.

comments.text: remember the no-safe-pos flag so it can be restored on exit
action id 3 with the gate as target
reserve a warp-in slot (m84 gate, m85 slot index)
after the alignment phase request the warp-through slot
fly in front of the gate container at the slot position
align to the gate's rotation angles, then switch to the through phase
m45 collision-warning mode: ignore the gate object (m46)
player ship (g9) is moved by the jump code instead of being warped away here
no 3D instance: abstract movement towards the gate
wait if the gate's warp-out slot is occupied
jumped: remove the ship (not the player) and mark the gate known for the player's ships

__EnterHyperspace.doc: Flies a ship into a gate to jump through it. For slot-using ships (class 2019) it reserves warp-in and warp-through slots on the gate. Result codes: 3 jumped, 6 gate invalid, 7 interrupted, 8 failed or gate changed.

comments.text: player ship: fixed formation slot behind the leader
other ships: random slot in a box that scales with the formation size
SA_GetGlobalParameter(12, 0) is the escort leash distance, plus both sizes
state 6 when following, state 14 when escorting
if either object is hidden on the sector map, break off when the distance exceeds the leash
collision: avoid the model, keeping this ship's size plus 50000 units
player ship (not class 2073): rotation accel fixed to 80
SA_EscortObject with the stored formation offset m0[9..11]

__EscortObject.doc: Escorts another object (arg1) at a formation offset kept in m0[9..11], or follows it closely when arg3 is set. Ends when the object is gone or out of the sector, when the attack flag is raised, or when the timeout arg4 (ticks, 0 = none) passes. Returns 4 when released, 7 when aborted, 8 when the target is lost, 10 when the follow is complete, 12 on timeout or leaving the escort distance.

comments.text: only followers of the same owner that are enemies of the player (g9) and can be excused

__ExcuseFollowers.doc: Excuses followers of this ship that are enemies of the player: their relation to the player is set to neutral, recursively.

comments.text: m55 = 9 is the state flag for flying to a sector
GS_Route returns the index of the next gate on the route
ship class rules may forbid this gate (CanMoveThroughGates)
player ship: the client plays the gate warp animation in a fork
player: wait for the warp to finish, then warp in at the destination
failed jump out of hyperspace: self destruct after 1 tick (state not 3 or 7)

__FlyToNextSector.doc: Routes the ship to a neighbouring sector through a gate and jumps through it. Returns 3 when the jump succeeded (the caller loops), 6 when no route or gate is usable, 7 when aborted by a hyperspace state, otherwise the hyperspace result code.

comments.text: state 8: idling
SA_Idle is limited to 60 s per call
drift speed = one third of max speed
drift radius = sector size + 2500000 units
nothing to drift with: wait for an interrupt

__Idle.doc: Idles the ship for arg1 ms. Outside a station or hangar it drifts randomly around its position in the sector when the player watches the sector; otherwise it waits for an interrupt. Returns 4 when the time has passed, 7 when aborted through the attack flag.

comments.text: the station must be in a galaxy-level sector (class 2001) and the same environment
collision: avoid it before continuing
fly into the container; result 1 = inside, 5 = failed, 7 = retry
clear movement flags and the state flags
not landed: release from the slot
landing at a class 2016 station by the player's faction: mark it as known
player: the client takes over the landing in a fork; the loop then waits forever
landed ship: shield set to 100000000 so it cannot be hit while in the hangar
signal the station that the ship has docked

__LandInHangar.doc: Flies the ship into a station or carrier bay and lands it. Loops while the ship moves in; returns 2 on success, 7 when aborted through the attack flag, 8 when the target disappeared or refused the docking, 6 when it can not land. The player ship halts forever after landing: the fork ends the command and the client takes over.

comments.text: leave the old sector (keep sector objects of class 2014 untouched)
action id 13 = leaving hyperspace
exit direction is the gate's direction inverted
retry SA_StartInHangar until it succeeds (1) or the ship is rejected (6)
ship has no 3D instance: place it at the gate's warp-out position
m80 = tractor target: forked task flies the towed ship through the next sector and re-attaches it with the tractor beam
wait until the gate is more than 1750000 + 2*size away
tractor connect at the collision centre of this ship's 3D instance
if the towed ship has no command, restart its previous command (8 params)

__LeaveHyperspace.doc: Brings the ship out of the destination gate in the new sector: removes it from the old sector, places it at the gate with opposite direction, re-adds it, starts it in the gate hangar and warps it in. Also lets a tractored ship follow through. Returns 3 on success, 6 if the gate is gone.

comments.text: action id 4 targeted at the sector
m45 = collision-warning mode 327684 (ignore gate object m46)
the player ship is warped in by the camera code, not here
m12 bit 22 = ship removed meanwhile

__LeaveHyperspaceWarpIn.doc: Final warp-in step after leaving a gate: places the ship into the warp effect at the gate, waits for it to clear the hangar and resolves collisions. Not executed for the player's own ship warp-out code path except via JumpToSector.

comments.text: action id 22 = marine run
success only when within size sum + 500000

__MarineRunOnTarget.doc: Flies close to a target so boarding marines can be launched; like the attack run but with fixed rotation and range. Returns 4/7/8/9/12 like the other run functions (9 when within boarding distance).

comments.text: state 10: moving to a position
unless flag 131072 (no safe position) is set, redirect once to the nearest safe position
SA_MovePos returns 1 on arrival

__MovePos.doc: Flies the ship to a fixed position (x, y, z) with an arrival radius arg4, through the 3D model when it exists or through galaxy steps otherwise. The first move may be redirected to a safe position. Returns 4 on arrival, 7 when aborted.

comments.text: state 20: moving on with an existing path
SA_MovePosContinue returns 1 on arrival

__MovePosContinue.doc: Same as __MovePos but continues an earlier movement with SA_MovePosContinue. Used when a path is already being followed. State 20.

comments.text: action id 5 with target in m56 (attack-type action)
hidden in the sector map: give up if too far from the target
collision avoidance: action id 12
asteroid (2012) without parent: only mining lasers (bullet 28) can break it, approach closer
rock field with detail: aim at the nearest rock
fly to the aim position, else rotate the turret to it and check firing range

__MoveToBreakDebris.doc: Flies into firing position against a rock field / asteroid so the turret can break it, until in range. Result codes: 4 default, 6 target unusable, 7 interrupted, 8 target gone, 9 in position, 12 timeout. For a ship without 3D instance a galaxy-level flight step is used.

comments.text: loops per sector jump until m1 (current sector) matches

__MoveToSector.doc: Flies the ship from sector to sector until it is in the sector of the target object. Returns 4 on arrival or the failure code of the failing jump.

__MoveToStation.doc: Flies to a station and docks with it. Returns 4 when docked, 6 when docking is not possible or the target is gone.

comments.text: native group is set to the owner id

__SetCoverRaceRecursive.doc: Sets race cover on this ship and all its formation followers, sets the native group to the owner id and refreshes relations.

comments.text: dock port flag 0x200000: ships may use the port; 0x100000: the port animation is needed
docking loop: retries while the dock port is busy or the animation runs
keep the in-hangar position if the model still exists
m93 = -1: no speed limit when moving under the container
player docking in a cockpit: stop the monitors and reset tracking
C605 = the cockpit monitor object; reset its state after docking
m45 = ship movement flags for the hangar state (327683 with dock port, 589826 otherwise)
avoid colliding with the model inside the hangar

__StartInHangar.doc: Places the ship inside a docked object (station or carrier) and sets up its dock port and hangar state. Returns 4 when done, 6 when the ship can not be placed.

comments.text: docked at a gate: leave hyperspace towards it
docked inside a ship that is itself docked: cannot start (code 6)

__StartIntoSpace.doc: Brings a docked ship into normal space before it moves. Leaves a gate (class 2014) by hyperspace, refuses if it is docked inside a docked ship (class 2004), otherwise starts it in its hangar. Returns 0 when the ship was not docked.

___testForPlayerOwnedShips.doc: True if the sector (or the station/carrier when arg1 bit 128 is set) holds a player-owned ship of the kind given by arg1: 1 = attack ships (2038, 2039, 2032), 2 = escort and support ships, 3 = wingmen, 5 = class 2067, anything else = pilot-type ships (2133 except 2061, and 2073). The player ship itself is not counted.

__cmdConsoleBroadcastCheckCmdUpgrade.doc: True if any ship in the table has the command upgrade arg2.

comments.text: groupKind 3 needs a galaxy sector, kind 2 needs a station or carrier; otherwise the order is disabled
kind 4 = all fleet ships (-1), others = the group picked by target digit
no ships in the group: all entries disabled

__cmdConsoleBroadcastExec.doc: Adds the broadcast order entries (ids arg1+1 .. arg1+15) for a fleet or sector group to the menu table. Each entry is enabled (flag 0) only if a ship in the group has the matching command upgrade. arg1 = 2000 + kind * 1000 + group * 100, where kind 2 = station or carrier, 3 = galaxy sector, 4 = whole fleet.

comments.text: group -1: the fleet
group 1: fighter-type ships (classes 2133, 2073)
group 2: attack-type ships (classes 2038, 2039)
group 3: class 2034 ships
group 4: player wingmen
group 5: classes 2026, 2027, 2142
group 7: class 2067
group 8: class 2034 ships owned by the container
group 9: attack ships (2038, 2039) owned by the container

__cmdConsoleBroadcastGetShips.doc: Returns the table of the player's ships (not the player ship itself) that belong to a broadcast group, optionally only those with the command upgrade arg3. Group -1 is the whole fleet, -2 the fleet with the flag set. arg4 stops after the first ship. Returns 0 when there is none.

__cmdConsoleStartScript.doc: Starts the script of a command upgrade record on this ship for the given turret or slot. arg4 true means the script starts frozen (waits for the player).

comments.text: v2: 5 s step when the sector has update focus, else 30 s
step shortened to 5 s when the player is watching
already within stopDist: arrived (code 10)
clamp the step length to 20000000 units
m0[6..8] = unit direction towards the destination
speed is 0: cannot move (code 6)
random reaction delay of 80..129 ticks added to the wait
wait for interrupt; the remaining time is subtracted from the step
keep the 3D model in sync with m0, if one exists (m3)
done arriving: code 10; otherwise 11 = keep going
arg5 < 0: wait the step time; else the given time

__galaxyFlightStep.doc: Flies the ship in galaxy (sector-level) space toward a point, in steps, until it is within stopDist of it. Returns 10 when arrived, 11 when the caller should continue, 6 when it cannot move, and writes the position back into m0.

__getRawLaserTargetMode.doc: Laser target mode from the flags only, without the ware check: 2, 1 or nothing.

comments.text: bit 1: only followers of this ship's class
bit 2: highest strength wins
bit 4: lowest max speed wins

__selectNewFormationLeader.doc: Best follower to become the next formation leader. Scans from the last follower; the criteria bits are 1 same class as this ship, 2 highest strength, 4 lowest max speed.

__setupDecoupledShip.doc: Initialises a ship created when a ship is decoupled from its carrier (see DecoupleShips): copies position, owner object, relations, attacker and pilot skill from the parent, adds randomised upgrades/weapons scaled by the fight skill, and then activates it in the scene or starts its default action / formation following.

__setupSceneShip.doc: Initialises a ship spawned for a cut scene: takes position/rotation from a scene object or from the player ship, picks its owner race from g7[race], adds default lasers/upgrades/missiles, activates it and starts its default action.

__setupSceneShipPC.doc: Initialises the player's ship in a cut scene from the scene object's position and rotation and activates it in the given container.

comments.text: m57 = command id, m58..m65 = its parameter pairs (data type, value)

__stopCommand.doc: Core of StopCommand. With keepScripts=0 stops all scripts, leaves the formation and releases the slot; with keepScripts=1 only resets the movement state (used when starting a new command). Clears command id and parameters and ends a running jump countdown.

2004.name: Ship

2006.doc: A factory station (page 2006: Factory, engine type 6). It holds product, resource and secondary-resource tables, runs the production loop (Production) and the AI trade loop, and keeps per-ware prices for the player's own factories. Complex hangars redirect stock, relations and menus to the complex's hangar object.

0.doc: ware main type of the currently produced product
0.name: productMainType

1.doc: ware subtype of the currently produced product
1.name: productSubType

10.doc: script task id of the Production loop, 0 if stopped
10.name: productionTaskId

11.doc: production efficiency; solar plants use sun colour, others 40
11.name: efficiency

12.doc: player factories: table product ware code -> sell price
12.name: productPrices

13.doc: player factories: table resource ware code -> buy price
13.name: resourcePrices

14.doc: player factories: table secondary resource ware code -> buy price
14.name: secondaryResourcePrices

15.doc: storage capacity multiplier, grows for high value products
15.name: storageFactor

16.doc: factory number shown in the name (page 12 + 100)
16.name: factoryId

17.doc: name given by the player, 0 if none
17.name: customName

18.doc: complex hangar object this factory is attached to, or 0
18.name: complexHangar

19.doc: game age when the current cycle started
19.name: currentProductionStart

2.doc: table product ware code -> seconds per cycle
2.name: productionTimes

20.doc: accumulated surplus resource value that shortens the next cycle
20.name: bonusTime

21.doc: length in seconds of the current production cycle
21.name: currentProductionTime

22.doc: text id overriding the name, -1 = none
22.name: overrideNameId

23.doc: override for the name composition flags, 0 = default 52
23.name: nameFlagsOverride

24.doc: base wait of the Production loop in ms (1000 focused, 60000 normal)
24.name: updateInterval

25.doc: game age after which ware statistics are sampled again
25.name: nextStatisticTime

26.doc: table ware code -> array of 10 stock samples plus write index
26.name: wareStatistics

3.doc: table product ware code -> items per cycle
3.name: productionCounts

4.doc: only reset to 0, never read (probably unused)
4.name: unusedField47

5.doc: only reset to 0, never read (probably unused)
5.name: unusedField48

6.doc: table of product ware codes
6.name: products

7.doc: table of resource ware codes
7.name: resources
