8.name: resourceMainTypeMask

9.doc: table of secondary resource ware codes
9.name: secondaryResources

comments.text: 851968 = 13 << 16: fallback product (main type 13, subtype 0)

AddDefaultProductsAndResources.doc: Adds the default product of the factory subtype and its default player resources, then initialises prices.

AddProduct.doc: Adds a product and makes it the current one; the production loop is restarted if it was running.

AddTo.doc: Adds the factory to a sector and activates it if loaded.

AddWare.doc: Adds a ware (negative removes). Forwards to the complex hangar when this factory is a complex member, else changes the local count.

CanBuyWareType.doc: True when the factory buys this ware (input or intermediate).

CanSellWareType.doc: True when the factory sells this ware (output).

Create.doc: Creates a factory (engine type 6) and resets its production state.

CreateCommMenu.doc: Communication menu, taken from the complex hangar if attached.

comments.text: efficiency 25 is immediately replaced by 40

CreateCommon.doc: Resets all production state, tables and price tables (the price tables only for player factories).

Destruct.doc: Stops the tasks, notifies owned ships, deletes landed ships and removes the factory from its sector.

comments.text: a group short of stock: add only what is there
short of inputs while producing: set flag 2 and, when a ship exists, flag 32768 on it

EnoughResourcesForProduction.doc: Checks whether stock covers the needed relative value across the enabled resource groups. Clears or sets flag 2 (no resources). With arg2 true returns the coverage percent instead of a boolean.

GetComplexHangar.doc: The complex hangar this factory belongs to, or 0.

GetCurrentProductionStart.doc: Game age at which the current cycle started.

GetCurrentProductionTime.doc: Returns the production time of the current cycle (field 65).

comments.text: the description text follows the name text (id + 1)

GetDescriptionID.doc: Returns the description text id, which is the name text id + 1.

GetGroupRelation.doc: Relation to a race group, taken from the complex hangar if attached.

GetName.doc: Custom name or the composed raw name.

GetNameArray.doc: Name as a 16-element text id array (page, id pairs), the form used by the menus.

comments.text: 52 = type name + factory number + size suffix

GetNameFlags.doc: Name composition flags: 1 race prefix, 2 sector tag, 4 type name, 16 factory number, 32 size suffix.

GetNameID.doc: Override name id if set, otherwise the ware name (6, subtype).

GetNeededRelValue.doc: Relative value (price units) of one production cycle. Player factories use the player relative value table.

GetNeededRelValue2.doc: Relative value of one cycle of the given product key, scaled by the output count.

GetOverrideNameID.doc: Returns the name text id override of the factory (field 66).

GetProductMainType.doc: Returns the main type of the current product (field 44).

GetProductSubType.doc: Returns the subtype of the current product (field 45).

GetProductionCount.doc: Returns the production count of the current product, taken from the per-product table (field 47) keyed by main type << 16 | subtype.

GetProductionResourcePercent.doc: Resource coverage percent for the current product, or nothing when no product is set.

GetProductionTime.doc: Returns the production time of the current product, taken from the per-product table (field 46) keyed by main type << 16 | subtype.

GetProducts.doc: Returns the product table of the factory (field 50).

comments.text: tag only for the races in mask 262718; picks one of five texts by the object id
35:11 = name format string

GetRawName.doc: Composes the factory name from race prefix, a 'Alpha/Beta...' style tag, type name, factory number and size name according to the name flags.

GetRecommendedMinSellPrice.doc: Lowest sensible sell price per unit: the cost of the inputs for one cycle, divided by the output count.

GetRemainingCycleTime.doc: Seconds left in the current production cycle.

GetResources.doc: Returns the resource table of the factory (field 51).

GetSResourceConsumptionPerTime.doc: Consumption of a special resource over the given time, scaled by the factory type. Returns 0 for pseudo wares and for the random 1-in-8 skip of ware 16:1.

GetSResourcePrices.doc: Table of secondary resource prices (player factories).

GetSResources.doc: Returns the secondary resource table of the factory (field 53).

GetScaleFactor.doc: Scale factor of the factory type (fixed point, 65536 = 1.0).

GetStatisticCycleTime.doc: Estimated time to cycle through all stock samples. Never returns less than 4800.

GetWareStatistic.doc: Returns the statistic value for a ware index (table field 70, probably production or trade counters).

GetWareTypeBestStore.doc: Best storage amount for a ware, scaled by the factory type. Minimum 4 for sold wares. Returns 0 when the ware is not traded here.

GetWareTypeCount.doc: Stock of a ware: forwarded to the complex hangar if there is one, marines count as the marine list size.

GetWareTypePrice.doc: Price of a ware. Player factories use their own price tables; other factories compute a price from stock level, average price and the type's min/max price percentages.

GetYourName.doc: Custom name or the player-factory name format from page 1706 filled with the raw name.

comments.text: sum of R+G+B scaled to 0..25 (efficiency percentage unit)

InitPowerPlantEfficiency.doc: For solar power plants (gsubtype 4) sets the efficiency from the colours of the sector's suns.

InitWarePrices.doc: Player factories only: gives every product/resource/secondary resource without a price its average price.

InitialFill.doc: Fills stock at the start: sell wares get a random best-store amount, buy wares a fraction, and pseudo wares a flag value of 1.

IsProducing.doc: True while the production loop is running (flag 8).

IsWareCategory.doc: True if a ware type code is a factory of the same kind as this one: the same subtype, both the generic type, or factories with the same default product.

NeededResourcesPerCycle.doc: Resource amounts needed for one production cycle, sized from a relative value budget. Returns a table keyed by ware key.

NeededResourcesPerCycle2.doc: Like NeededResourcesPerCycle, but the budget comes from the product key (GetNeededRelValue2).

NoResources.doc: True when production is running (flag 8) and flag 2 (no resources) is set.

comments.text: no product list or no shipping type: set placeholder product -1/-1, wait 1000 ms and stop
pick the product with the lowest stock ratio that still fits in storage
marines 16:106 and 16:107 purge old marines and create new ones instead of storing the ware

Production.doc: Main factory loop, started once (flag 8). Picks the product with the lowest stock ratio, consumes input wares per resource group, waits the production time, and stores the output. Runs until flag 8 is cleared; stops with a placeholder product when nothing is set up.

RemoveResource.doc: Removes a resource and recomputes the main type mask.

ResourceMainTypeAvailable.doc: Total relative value of stock in one main type group.

ResourceTypeAvailable.doc: Stock count of a sell ware, or nothing when the factory does not sell it.

RestartProductionTask.doc: Restarts a running production loop: stops it, waits until it has ended, then starts it again.

SetComplexHangar.doc: Attaches the factory to a complex hangar; the factory's own stock table is dropped.

SetOwner.doc: Changes the owner; a factory that becomes the player's gets price tables.

SetUpdateFocus.doc: Sets the trade update interval: 1 s when the player focuses the object (and wakes Trade), otherwise 60 s.

SetWareTypePrice.doc: Sets the price of a product or resource (player factories only).

StartProductionTask.doc: Waits until the universe is built, then forks the production loop if it is not running.

StartTasks.doc: Waits until the universe is built, then starts the idle script (player), the production loop and, for non-player factories, the trade loop.

StopProduction.doc: Stops production: clears flag 8, resets product tables and kills the production task.

StopProductionTask.doc: Clears the producing flag so the loop ends at its next check.

ToggleProductionTask.doc: Starts or stops production (context menu button 657).

comments.text: g46 bit 1 marks pseudo wares (credits, time) that are not stock items
special case: ware 16:1 for shipyard-type subtype 4 is sold only one time in 8 and only when room is left
sell rate by ware group: groups 8, 9, 10 and 16 use 6, others 12
sleep until the next update or an interrupt (SetUpdateFocus)

Trade.doc: Trade loop for stations and factories. Buys missing inputs, sells surplus outputs, and sleeps for the update interval m67 (1 s when focused, 60 s otherwise). Flag 4 keeps the loop alive.

TradesWithWareType.doc: True when the factory buys or sells this ware.

UpdateGalaxyWareStation.doc: Tells the global trade manager (class 300) which products and resources this factory offers.

UpdateWareStatistic.doc: Records the current stock of one ware in a 10-sample ring buffer kept per ware key.

2006.name: Factory

2007.doc: An equipment/trade dock station (page 2006: Dock, engine type 5). Besides the Station behaviour it keeps a table of tradeable wares, runs the AI trade loop and a patrol/defence loop, and for the Hub (subtype 43) manages realignable gate links. Subclasses are the Goner, Trade, Equipment, Pirate and Kha'ak docks.

0.doc: never read or written apart from the initial 0 (probably unused)
0.name: unusedField43

1.doc: table ware code -> price; also the products/resources lists
1.name: tradeables

2.doc: script task id of the Control loop, 0 if not running
2.name: controlTaskId

3.doc: Fighter (class 2034) set on patrol in the sector
3.name: patrolFighter

4.doc: M3 fighter (class 2023) acting as defence leader
4.name: leaderM3

5.doc: name set by the player, 0 if none
5.name: customName

6.doc: text id overriding the name, -1 = none
6.name: overrideNameId

7.doc: trade loop base interval in seconds (5 focused, 300 normal)
7.name: updateInterval

8.doc: Hub only: 3 link slots (X, Y, Z axis); array, {-1} locked-empty or 0
8.name: gateLinks

9.doc: Hub only: game age of the last gate realignment
9.name: lastRealignTime

AddDefaultTradeables.doc: Empty override: a dock adds no default tradeables.

AddShip.doc: Landed ship is also registered with the global ship list.

AddTo.doc: Adds the dock to a sector and activates it if loaded.

comments.text: g46 flag 1024 = marine ware

AddTradeable.doc: Adds a ware to the tradeables table with its average price (or 1) and notifies the trade manager. Marine wares are not added to the player's docks.

AddWare.doc: Adds stock. On the player's docks new wares become tradeable automatically unless flagged (g46 bit 8). Non-player docks only accept wares they trade; equipment docks swallow unknown ship/laser wares and report them as added.

CanBuyWareType.doc: Player docks buy anything; equipment docks buy any ship/laser/shield class wares (8 to 10); others only their tradeables.

comments.text: about 200 s between control rounds

Control.doc: Defence loop of AI docks. Occasionally spawns pirate or police ships (subtype 13), then makes sure a leader M3 and a patrolling Fighter owned by the dock are assigned (command 15 for the leader, patrol for the fighter, formation for the rest). Runs until stopped.

comments.text: engine type 5 = station dock
m44 reset: dock starts with an empty tradeables table
subtype 43 = Hub: three link slots, each {-1} (locked/empty)

Create.doc: Creates a dock. Pirate (gsubtype 2) and Kha'ak (gsubtype 1) docks force their owner race to 8 and 9. Pirate docks are neutral to race 10. The Hub (subtype 43) allocates its three gate-link slots.

Destruct.doc: Stops the AI tasks, notifies owned ships, deletes landed ships and removes the dock from its sector.

comments.text: link entry layout: [gate, destGate, startTime, readyTime, gateId, destGateId, hubGateA, hubGateB, locked]

DisconnectGate.doc: Hub: undoes a gate link. The original gate is reconnected to its original destination and the slot is cleared (or set to {-1} if it was locked). Returns 1 if a link was removed.

GateLinkExists.doc: True if the slot has a link or if the sector holds gates in both the direction and its opposite.

GetDescriptionID.doc: Description text id: the name id plus one, by the game's text layout for stations.

GetGateLastRealignTime.doc: Game age of the last gate realignment.

GetGateLink.doc: Link entry of the slot for a direction, or 0.

GetLinkForGateDirection.doc: Maps a gate direction (0 and 1 = X axis, 2 and 3 = Y, 4 and 5 = Z) to the Hub link slot index 0..2, or -1.

GetName.doc: Custom name or the dock type name from page 17.

GetNameID.doc: Override name id if set, otherwise ware name of (5, subtype).

GetNumberOfLinks.doc: Number of slots that are not {-1}-locked.

GetOverrideNameID.doc: Returns the name text id override of the dock (field 50).

GetProducts.doc: Returns the dock's product table (m44). GetResources and GetSResources return the same field m44, which looks like a copy-paste; check whether it is intended.

GetResources.doc: Returns the resource table of the dock (field 45).

GetSResourceConsumptionPerTime.doc: Units of a secondary resource consumed during the given time, using the same rate formula as Trade; marines are never consumed.

comments.text: same field 45 as GetResources: docks have no separate secondary resources (probable copy of the same getter)

GetSResources.doc: Returns the secondary resource table of the dock. It is the same field (45) as GetResources.

GetWareTypeBestStore.doc: Target stock level for a ware, scaled by the global store parameters (117 to 120). Returns nothing for wares the dock does not trade (equipment docks accept main types 8 to 10).

GetWareTypeNormalPrice.doc: Standard price; illegal wares for the sector owner's race cost the maximum; ware 16/11 is fixed at 3000.

GetWareTypePrice.doc: Player docks use the stored price, other docks the normal price.

GetYourName.doc: Custom name or, for player docks, the 'Your ...' name from page 1706, otherwise the plain name.

InitialFill.doc: Fills the dock's stock at creation: fixed amounts for a few special wares, one unit for g46 flag 1 wares, and the best-store amount for the rest.

IsGateSetLocked.doc: True if the link slot of that direction is locked, either as an empty {-1} slot or by the lock flag of a link.

IsWareCategory.doc: True if the type code is a dock of the same gsubtype as this dock.

comments.text: -1 marks the link as established (no pending ready time)

LinkGates.doc: Task started by RealignGate. Waits until the link's ready time, restores the old link, switches the Hub gate subtypes to the new active ones and connects the Hub gates to the new gates.

LockGateSet.doc: Locks or unlocks the gate link of a direction.

comments.text: not forced: enforce cooldown and energy cell cost
pick the Hub's own gate subtypes for this direction (15..20 and 9..14)
link entry: [gate, destGate, now, now+delay(global 91, 300 s), ids..., hub gates, locked flag]
pay the energy cells (ware 11,0)

RealignGate.doc: Hub: redirects the gate pair of one direction to a new jumpable gate. Unless forced it needs the minimum time since the last realignment (global 92, default 7200 s) and energy cells (global 93, default 10000). Stores the new link entry and starts LinkGates in a fork. Returns 1 on success.

RemoveTradeable.doc: Removes a ware from the tradeables table and from stock when no longer traded.

SetImmediateRealignment.doc: Backdates the last realign time so the next realignment is allowed immediately.

SetOwner.doc: Changes the owner; if the dock newly becomes the player's the AI tasks are restarted.

comments.text: 5 s interval when the player is nearby, 300 s otherwise

SetUpdateFocus.doc: Switches between fast (focused) and normal update interval; wakes the trade task when focused.

SetWareTypePrice.doc: Player docks only: changes the price of an existing tradeable.

StartTasks.doc: Waits until the universe is built, then starts the AI loops: the player's docks run the idle script, others start Trade and (if no jobs exist) Control.

StopControlling.doc: Clears the control flag and kills the control task.

comments.text: task id stored so StopTrading can kill it
pass 1: for every tradeable that is out of stock, order an urgent delivery
pass 2 (only if nothing was urgent): top up wares that are below the target level
consume/produce stock; marine wares (16,106) create marines instead
waits; interrupted early when a ship arrives (SetUpdateFocus)

Trade.doc: AI trade loop. Every few seconds it requests wares the dock lacks (NeedWareType), then slowly consumes or produces its stock so that prices and stock levels move. It also trains/recruits marines. Runs until stopped.

2007.name: Dock

2008.doc: A sun in a sector (GType 3). Provides the sector light colour and the energy factor for solar power. Activated as an engine object with the sector.

0.doc: light colour 0xRRGGBB
0.name: colorRgb

1.doc: sun subtype used for the engine object
1.name: sunType

Activate.doc: Creates the engine object with the light colour and starts it in the sector.

AddTo.doc: Adds the sun to a sector and activates it if the sector is active.

Create.doc: Creates a sun; colour is packed from red/green/blue bytes.

Deactivate.doc: Frees the native sun object and clears its handle, when the sun is active.

Destruct.doc: Removes the sun from its sector's sun table, then runs the base destruct.

GetColor.doc: Returns the sun light colour packed as 0xRRGGBB (field 7).

GetColorBlue.doc: Returns the blue component of the sun colour (bits 0 to 7).

GetColorGreen.doc: Returns the green component of the sun colour (bits 8 to 15).

GetColorRed.doc: Returns the red component of the sun colour (bits 16 to 23).

GetEnergyFactor.doc: Energy output (volume) of the sun's type, used for solar power plants.

GetName.doc: Returns the constant name SUN.

comments.text: 196608 is 3 << 16. The same packing (type << 16 | subtype) is used for all ware and object keys

GetTypeCode.doc: Returns the sun type code: type 3 in bits 16 and up, subtype in the low 16 bits.

Remove.doc: Deactivates the sun if it is active, then removes it from its sector.

SelfDestruct.doc: Destroys the sun: kills its native object with the given arguments when active, then runs the destruct.

SetColor.doc: Sets the colour and updates the engine light.

SetRot.doc: Rotation is not stored for suns: the body is empty.

2008.name: Sun

201.doc: Loads the UI text files (addon/t/NNNN.xml) and opens the HUD and menu fonts from addon/types/fonts.txt. Called once from _Init and again from _Restart; probably owns no own state beyond the text table g2. Not a dobj-named class.

LoadText.doc: Imports text file addon/t/<id>.xml (id zero-padded to 4 digits) and remembers the path in g2[id] so RestoreTexts can reload it. Returns 1 when the file was read, 0 when missing.

comments.text: g0 = HUD font, g1 = large font; defaults Tahoma 13 and Zekton 26 used when fonts.txt is missing

OpenFonts.doc: Reads addon/types/fonts.txt: a LARGE line gives the large font (name, size, weight) and a HUD line gives the HUD font. Opens g0 (HUD font) and g1 (large font) and sets the text background to transparent.

RestoreTexts.doc: Reloads every text file that was loaded before (g2 keys 1..9999), e.g. after the graphics device was reset.

Set.doc: Initial setup: opens fonts, resets the fade value and loads UI text files 1, 3 and 4.

201.name: UiTextFonts

2011.doc: Orbital laser (page 2006 'Orbital Laser', GetClassCode 'OL'): a stationary defence turret that guards its owner station and fires at enemies in range. Created by station owners (C401) and by OrbitalLaserWare; the Terran laser tower (2149) is its subclass.

0.doc: task id of the defence loop, 0 when not running
0.name: defendTaskId

1.doc: 5-slot array allocated in Create2; its use is not seen in this batch
1.name: slotArray

2.doc: laser range from SA_GetLaserTypeRange(25)
2.name: laserRange

3.doc: object the laser is attacking, 0 when none
3.name: currentTarget

Activate.doc: Activates the laser: flags2 bit 16 on the native object and no safe position on activation.

AddTo.doc: Adds the laser to a container and starts its defence loop.

AllowRaceLogicControl.doc: Returns 0: race logic does not control the orbital laser.

comments.text: not the player and not an enemy: ignored
attacker becomes hostile (relation -10000)

AttackedByHandler.doc: When an enemy attacks the laser, the enemy becomes its target (unless it has a defended owner, which then takes the hit). Sets relation -10000 to the attacker.

CmdConsoleCommandExec.doc: Returns 0: no console command is executed.

CmdConsoleEntryExec.doc: Returns 0: no console entry is executed.

CollisionWarn.doc: Empty: the orbital laser does not react to a collision warning.

Create.doc: Creates an orbital laser with ship type 273 at the given position.

comments.text: owner race from g7 by index arg6
virtual call: equipment of the subclass
laser range from laser type 25
owner race 8 (Pirates): group relation with group 10 set to 0 (neutral)

Create2.doc: Creates an orbital laser of ship type arg1 in container arg2 at the position for owner race arg6. Sets the laser range, starts no defence task until added to a container. Owner race 8 (Pirates) is made neutral to the player group 10.

CreateCommMenu.doc: Creates the command menu (2278) for the player's own laser. Returns nothing for other races.

Destruct.doc: Stops the defence loop, then runs the base Destruct.

EquipOnEject.doc: Equips the laser: shield 1 and laser type 25 (level 1).

comments.text: command 4: defend the owner object

ExternalSetOwnerObject.doc: Sets the object this laser defends (its owner station) and restarts the defence loop with command 4 (defend).

GetAnswers.doc: Returns the default answer list unchanged.

comments.text: class code 'OL'

GetCmdConsoleCommands.doc: Returns the incoming count unchanged: no console commands.

comments.text: special console entry -1 (meaning not known)
special console entry -3 (meaning not known)

GetCmdConsoleEntries.doc: Adds two console entries with the special ids -1 and -3 (meaning not known) and returns the new count.

GetCommand.doc: Returns the current command (m57): 4 defend owner, 5 attack target, 16 idle.

comments.text: SA_GetGlobalParameter(10, 0): scanner range

GetWareTypeCode.doc: Returns 1048585, which is 16 << 16 | 9: the ware type code of an orbital laser.

HasCockpit.doc: Returns 0: the orbital laser has no cockpit.

comments.text: no owner on either side: base hit only
defended owner exists: base hit, then the owner is hit too
attacker becomes hostile (relation -10000)

Hit.doc: Hit handler. A hostile hit sets the attacker as the target when none is set, and forwards the hit to the defended owner if one exists.

IsAbleToLand.doc: Returns 0: the orbital laser cannot land.

IsAvailableForDefaultJob.doc: Returns 0: the orbital laser does not take a default job.

Remove.doc: Stops the defence loop, then removes the object from its container.

SendMessage.doc: Passes a message to the galaxy message handler (C150) when the laser belongs to the player.

StartAction.doc: No default action for orbital lasers.

___killDefendThread.doc: Stops the defence loop: resets the command fields and kills the task.

comments.text: command 4 (defend) when a defended owner exists, otherwise 16 (idle)
loop step: 1500 with a native object, else the galaxy flight step
hostile relation set (-10000) to the candidate
candidate within laser range plus 250000 becomes the target
no ship target: take the nearest missile aimed at the laser
command 5: attack the target
turn toward the target; not aligned (result other than 1): drop the target
target out of laser range: wait 200
fire on the target
target without native object: fire lasers at it in the galaxy simulation

___startDefendThread.doc: Defence loop: picks a target among enemy ships in the sector within laser range plus 250000 (or a missile aimed at the laser), turns the laser to it and fires. Uses a 1500-unit step with a native object and the galaxy flight step otherwise.

2011.name: OrbitalLaser

2012.doc: An asteroid (page 2006: Asteroid; GType 17). Holds a resource type and yield; also represents small mineable rocks split off from larger asteroids (flags 64+128). Can be scanned by the player, destroyed by missiles/mining and may leave debris.

0.doc: owner set by scripts, may be 0
0.name: ownerRace

1.doc: asteroid subtype (shape/size)
1.name: subType

2.doc: resource ware main type, default 15
2.name: resourceMainType

3.doc: resource ware sub type (mineral kind)
3.name: resourceSubType

4.doc: mineral yield
4.name: yield

5.doc: hits needed to destroy as a rock
5.name: rockHitPoints

6.doc: override text id for name, -1 for default
6.name: overrideNameId

7.doc: 1 unknown, 2 rebuild, 4 safe pos, 8 scanned, 16 invincible, 32 no find, 64 no mine, 128 rock
7.name: flags

Activate.doc: Activates the asteroid with the default safe-position mode (Activate2 with -1).

Activate2.doc: Activates in two phases: phase 0 only activates objects without the safe-position flag, phase >0 only those with it (safe position is resolved via the engine). -1 means both.

AddAsRock.doc: Turns the asteroid into a mineable rock attached to an existing engine object: sets flags 64+128 and picks rock hit points by subtype (2-4: 7-11, 5-7: 2-4).

AddTo.doc: Adds the asteroid to a sector and activates it when the sector has an object id.

Create.doc: Creates an asteroid with random rotation. arg order: position, subtype, resource sub type, yield. Rock hits are random (20-49 for sub type 2, else 10-29).

Deactivate.doc: Saves position and frees the engine object; rocks self-destruct afterwards.

Destruct.doc: Requests a rebuild via REBUILD (C303) and removes the asteroid from its sector.

FillContextMenu.doc: Adds a 'Scan' button (text 1904:81401) when the asteroid is not scanned.

GetDensity.doc: Returns the density of the asteroid's type from the asteroid tables.

GetDescriptionID.doc: Returns the description text id, which is the name id plus 1.

GetName.doc: Returns the asteroid name from the text page 17 by its name id.

GetNameID.doc: Name text id: override if set, else the ware name of the subtype.

GetNoFind.doc: True when the asteroid is excluded from object searches (flag bit 32).

GetNoMine.doc: True when the asteroid cannot be mined (flag bit 64).

GetOverrideNameID.doc: Returns the name text id override. A negative value means the default name is used.

GetOwner.doc: Returns the owner race object of the asteroid (field 7).

GetRebuild.doc: True when the asteroid must be rebuilt (flag bit 2).

GetResourceMainType.doc: Returns the main resource type the asteroid yields.

GetResourceName.doc: Resource name; sub type 1 is shown as 'Silicon'.

GetResourceSubType.doc: Returns the resource subtype that the asteroid yields (field 10).

GetScanned.doc: True when the asteroid has been scanned (flag bit 8). FindObject flag 0x10000 requires it.

GetSize.doc: Returns the total size of the native asteroid, or 200000 when it has no native object.

GetTypeCode.doc: Returns 1114112 | subtype: 17 << 16 is the asteroid type code.

GetUnknown.doc: True when flag bit 1 is set; purpose not known. FindObject skips asteroids with it when flag 0x200000 is given.

GetYield.doc: Returns the yield of the asteroid (field 11), the amount of resource left (probably).

IsCollectible.doc: Returns the native collectible flag of the asteroid, or nothing when it has no native object.

IsInvincible.doc: True when the asteroid cannot be destroyed (flag bit 16).

IsRock.doc: True when the object is a rock (flag bit 128).

IsSafePosOnActivate.doc: True when the asteroid is moved to a safe position when activated (flag bit 4).

comments.text: missile must do at least as much damage as missile type 4
flag 0x80000000 of engine flags2 forces destruction
bug: m3 was already set to 0 at 0x0900da, so the flags2 test reads the flags of object 0
dead branch: both arms empty

KilledBy.doc: Handles destruction. Cause 5 (missile) needs a strong enough missile on non-rocks; cause 2 (weapon) kills a non-rock only with weapon subtype 28, and counts down rock hit points otherwise (subtypes 7, 29, 35 ignored on rocks); cause 3 (collision) destroys rocks hit by bigger objects. Spawns debris and updates the player's kill stats.

OnContextMenuReturn.doc: Performs a scan when the scan button (603) is pressed: plays sample 966, marks the asteroid scanned and shows the resource and yield message.

OnContextMenuUpdate.doc: Disables the scan button if not in the same sector, no mineral scanner or out of range.

comments.text: equipment 12 = mineral scanner

OnContextMenuUpdateInfo.doc: Fills the info panel: resource and yield if scanned; otherwise '???' and either 'No mineral scanner' or the scanner range in km.

Remove.doc: Removes the asteroid from its sector's asteroid list and deactivates it.

RemoveRock.doc: Tells the parent asteroid that this rock is gone.

SelfDestruct.doc: Destroys the asteroid: kills its engine object, clears the object handle and frees the script object.

SetInvincible.doc: Toggles flag 16 and the engine's invincible bit.

SetKnown.doc: Marks the asteroid known (clears flag 1) or unknown and toggles the engine's hidden bit.

comments.text: flag bit 32: excluded from object searches

SetNoFind.doc: Sets or clears the search exclusion flag (bit 32).

SetNoMine.doc: Sets or clears the no-mining flag (bit 64).

SetOverrideNameID.doc: Sets the name text id override of the asteroid.

SetOwner.doc: Sets the owner of the asteroid (stored directly, no owner notification).

SetRebuild.doc: Sets or clears the rebuild flag (bit 2).

SetResourceType.doc: Sets the resource subtype the asteroid yields (field 10).

SetSafePosOnActivate.doc: Sets or clears the safe-position-on-activate flag (bit 4).

SetScanned.doc: Sets or clears the scanned flag (bit 8).

SetTargeted.doc: Sets the targeted state. When the object is targeted and has flag bit 1, it is also marked as known.

SetYield.doc: Sets the resource yield of the asteroid (used with the yield filter of FindObject).

2012.name: Asteroid

2014.doc: A warp gate or hub gate (page 2006: Warp Gate; GType 18). Subtypes encode direction (north/south/west/east) and kind (normal, Terran, hub). Connected pairs link two sectors; also manages warp-in slots so ships do not stack on exit. Registers itself in the galaxy map (GS_AddGate).

0.doc: gate subtype: direction and kind (see GetDirectionName)
0.name: subType

1.doc: gate id in this sector (0 N, 1 S, 2 W, 3 E), -1 if unconnected
1.name: gateId

10.doc: game age when the through-slot becomes free
10.name: warpThroughFreeTime

11.doc: side (1 controller, 0 other) that owns the through-slot, -1 none
11.name: warpThroughSide

12.doc: 1 if this gate controls slot arbitration for the pair
12.name: isWarpController

2.doc: destination sector X
2.name: destSectorX

3.doc: destination sector Y
3.name: destSectorY

4.doc: gate id of the gate at the destination
4.name: destGateId

5.doc: race object that owns the gate
5.name: ownerRace

6.doc: override name text id, -1 for default
6.name: overrideNameId

7.doc: 1 unknown, 2 safe pos on activate
7.name: flags

8.doc: 40 entries: 20 ships occupying warp-in slots + 20 release times
8.name: warpSlots

9.doc: ship currently warping through, 0 if free
9.name: warpThroughShip

Activate.doc: Activates the gate with the default safe-position mode (Activate2 with -1).

Activate2.doc: Two-phase activation (0 non-safe-pos, 1 safe-pos, -1 both). Creates the engine gate and fills it with 20 type-9 sub-objects (probably warp lights).

AddTo.doc: Adds the gate to a sector, registers it in the galaxy gate map and activates if the sector is active.

AttackedBy.doc: When attacked, also alerts a random dock of the sector.

Connect.doc: Connects this gate to another gate: disconnects old links, stores destination sector and gate ids and mirrors the connection on the other gate.

Create.doc: Creates a gate. Hub gates (subtypes 4, 15-20) have no gate id or destination id. Destination sector coordinates are given directly.

Deactivate.doc: Saves position and rotation into the object, then frees the engine object.

Destruct.doc: Removes the gate from its sector and from the galaxy gate map (re-adds the other gate with the same id if any).

DestructOther.doc: Destroys the gate on the other side when it is connected back to this one.

FillContextMenu.doc: Adds buttons: destination sector info (601) and, if different from the current sector, 'fly there' (302).

GetActiveSubtype.doc: Maps an inactive hub-gate subtype (15-20) to its active subtype (9-14), else -1.

GetDescriptionID.doc: Description text id, always the name id + 1.

GetDestinationGate.doc: The gate object on the other side, or nothing.

GetDestinationGateID.doc: Returns the id of the gate at the other end (field 11).

GetDestinationSector.doc: Destination sector object or nothing if unconnected.

GetDestinationX.doc: Returns the sector x coordinate of the destination (field 9).

GetDestinationY.doc: Returns the sector y coordinate of the destination (field 10).

GetDirectionFromSubtype.doc: Direction index 0 N, 1 S, 2 W, 3 E, 4/5 hub up/down, -1 unknown.

GetDirectionName.doc: Direction text 35:701-704 (North, South, West, East); hub gates use text 17:16291.

GetDirectionVector.doc: Forward axis (third matrix row) of the gate.

GetGType.doc: Returns the game type code 18 (warp gate).

GetGateID.doc: Returns the gate id (field 8), used to pair this gate with its destination.

GetName.doc: Gate name; normal gates are prefixed with the direction (North, South, West, East).

GetNameID.doc: Name text id: the override name if set, else the warp gate name for its subtype.

GetOppositeHubSubtype.doc: Subtype of the opposite hub gate (9<->10, 11<->12, ...), else -1.

GetOverrideNameID.doc: Returns the name text id override of the gate (field 13).

GetOwner.doc: Returns the owner race object of the gate (field 12).

GetRotAlpha.doc: Returns the rotation angle alpha of the gate (position field 3).

GetRotBeta.doc: Returns the rotation angle beta of the gate (position field 4).

GetRotGamma.doc: Returns the rotation angle gamma of the gate (position field 5).

GetSize.doc: Size of the engine object, or 200000 when inactive.

GetSubType.doc: Returns the gate subtype (field 7). The subtype encodes the gate direction.

GetType.doc: Returns the warp gate type code 18.

GetUnknown.doc: Flag bit 1 of m13: gate not yet known to the player.

GetWarpInPos.doc: Position where a ship arrives, behind the gate, spread over a grid by slot index (columns 0,1,-1,2,-2; row = slot/5; spacing 333000).

GetWarpOutPosGalaxy.doc: Random warp-out position in front of the gate for the galaxy-level warp effect.

HasDestination.doc: True if the gate has a link id (m7 >= 0).

IsJumpable.doc: True if the ship may use this gate: not unknown to the player, ship class can move through gates, and the gate kind allows jumping (normal, hub, active kinds).

IsSafePosOnActivate.doc: Flag bit 2 of m13: place the gate at its saved safe position on activate.

IsWarpController.doc: True if flag m18 marks this gate as a warp controller.

KilledBy.doc: Destroys the gate, credits the player kill stat and destroys the connected gate.

OnContextMenuReturn.doc: 601 opens the destination sector menu; 302 orders the player ship to fly to the destination (command 12).

comments.text: details button stays disabled if there is no destination sector or it is unknown

OnContextMenuUpdate.doc: Disables the details button (601) when the destination sector is missing or unknown.

ReleaseSlot.doc: Releases the ship's warp-in or through slot here and at the controller gate; slots become reusable after 60 s.

RequestWarpInSlot.doc: Reserves one of 20 warp-in slots for a ship, freeing stale entries. Returns the slot index or -1.

RequestWarpThroughSlot.doc: Requests the exclusive warp-through slot, arbitrated by whichever gate of the pair is the controller (this one becomes controller if neither is).

SelfDestruct.doc: Destroys the gate: base self-destruct, engine object, the destination link and the script object.

SetDefaultRot.doc: Sets rotation from the subtype's direction: north 0, south 32768, west 16384, east -16384.

SetKnown.doc: Marks known/unknown; when known, tells the player race that the gate's race is known.

SetOverrideNameID.doc: Sets the name text id override of the gate (field 13).

SetOwner.doc: Sets the owner race object of the gate (field 12).

SetPos.doc: Moves the gate and re-registers it in the galaxy gate map.

SetSafePosOnActivate.doc: Sets or clears flag bit 2 of m13 (safe position on activate).

comments.text: gate was unknown and is now targeted: reveal it

SetTargeted.doc: When the gate is targeted and still unknown, reveals it; then calls the base SetTargeted.

__Disconnect.doc: Disconnects this gate (and the matching gate at the other end), resetting ids and rebuilding the galaxy map entry.

__requestWarpThroughSlot.doc: Grants the through-slot if free (or if the same side re-requests); returns 0 on success, -1 otherwise.

2014.name: WarpGate

2016.doc: Station (page 2006: Station), base of Factory (2006), Dock (2007) and complex hubs. Created by the galaxy setup or by the player's build commands. Holds the station's dock slots, landed ships, marines, wares, shields, hull and relations to race groups. dobj: STATION. Its wrecks are class 1653.

0.doc: main object type id (SA type); returned by GetType()
0.name: stationType

1.doc: subtype of the station type; returned by GetSubType()
1.name: stationSubType

10.doc: number of owned fighters (class 2034)
10.name: ownedFighterCount

11.doc: number of owned ships that are not fighters
11.name: ownedFreighterCount

12.doc: hull value; refreshed from the engine object when active
12.name: hull

13.doc: script task id of the trade loop; 0 when not trading
13.name: tradeTaskId

14.doc: game time of the last hostile-action check; sets alert thresholds (probably)
14.name: lastThreatTime

15.doc: game time of the last attack warning sent to the player
15.name: lastMessageTime

16.doc: minimum seconds between attack notifications
16.name: notifyAttackInterval

17.doc: game time of the last attack notification
17.name: notifyAttackTime

18.doc: station credits (only used for player-owned stations)
18.name: money

19.doc: object that attacked the station last; 0 when none
19.name: attacker

2.doc: bit flags: 1 no-find, 4 trading, 32 no NPC docking, 64 invincible, 128 enemy-of, 256 rebuild, 512 safe pos, 1024 player fire inside, 2048 BBS off, 16384 highlighted, 32768 self-destructing, 65536 unknown, 0x80000000 destroyed
2.name: flags

20.doc: shield energy; refreshed from the engine object when active
20.name: shield

21.doc: bitmask of race groups the station is friendly to
21.name: friendGroupMask

22.doc: bitmask of race groups the station is hostile to
22.name: enemyGroupMask

23.doc: game time when the attacker was recorded
23.name: attackerTime

24.doc: max jumps used when searching trade partners
24.name: maxTradeJumps

25.doc: game time of the last call for help to the owner
25.name: lastCallForHelpTime

26.doc: number of named pilots (0..3) for questions; set from the owner
26.name: pilotCount

27.doc: array of speaker/pilot person objects (class 1700) at this station
27.name: speakerObjects

29.doc: array of training entries: {marine, skill code, start time, duration}
29.name: trainingQueue

3.doc: owning race/faction object; null if unowned
3.name: owner

30.doc: table: trained marines waiting for a ship to pick them up
30.name: pickupQueue

4.doc: table: ships landed at this station (ship -> ship)
4.name: landedShips

5.doc: array: ship occupying each dock port (0 = free)
5.name: dockSlots

6.doc: number of occupied dock slots
6.name: dockedShipCount

7.doc: array: installed shield generators per shield subtype
7.name: shieldBays

8.doc: table: packed ware key (type << 16 | ware) -> stock count
8.name: wares

9.doc: table: ships owned by this station (ship -> ship)
9.name: ownedShips

Activate.doc: Activates the station with the default safe-position mode (Activate2 with -1).

comments.text: mode 0 skips activation when the safe-position flag is set; mode above 0 skips it when not set
engine flags: keep the bits outside the mask, then set the bits below
station is under attack: engine flag 67108864
safe-position flag: store the current position as the safe position, then clear the flag
landed ships are activated too
re-create shield objects: one per installed generator of each subtype

Activate2.doc: Creates the engine object for the station in its sector and restores its ships, shields and relations. mode: -1 always, 0 only without the safe-position flag, above 0 only with it. Returns the engine object or 0.

comments.text: subtypes 2-3: larger shields than 4-5 at the same size

AddDefaultShields.doc: Installs the default shield generators for this station type and size. Size thresholds are scale factors 1x, 3x and 5x (65536, 196608, 327680 in 16.16 fixed point).

AddMoney.doc: Adds money to a player-owned station. The total is capped at 2000000000 and never goes below 0.

comments.text: positive delta: create shield objects in the engine
negative delta: free shield objects one by one until the count is reached
after an addition the shield is topped up to 100000000

AddShield.doc: Adds (or removes, if negative) shield generators of a subtype and updates the engine object. Returns the leftover delta.

AddShip.doc: Adds a landed ship to this station (no dock port request).

AddShip2.doc: Adds a ship that landed here; unless noDock is set and the ship has no slot, requests a dock port for it.

AddSpeaker.doc: Creates a speaker person (class 1700) with a name, race, voice and face, adds it to the station's speakers and returns it.

AddSpeakerObj.doc: Adds an existing speaker object to the station's speaker list.

comments.text: marine ware: the stock is the marine table, not m20
ware 107 creates trained marines, ware 106 untrained

AddWare.doc: Adds (positive) or removes (negative) a ware. Positive amounts are limited by free space. Marine wares (g46 flag 1024) create or destroy marine objects instead of stock. Returns the number applied.

comments.text: weapon type 35 is ignored
tractor-beam capture: the attacker is connected to the station, except hubs and one special type
weapon classification from the bullet type: v5 hits shields, v6 hits hull
player attacks: notoriety loss for the owner, at most once per 60 time units
shield below 80% makes the owner lose notoriety with the player
a non-player source with no weapon is ignored
player's ship attacks: timers are compared to the current time
enemy player: retaliation timer is set to 10000 ago
retaliation: relation to the attacker becomes -10000, owner notoriety -5, squad and help
player station: notify the player's comm of the attack

AttackedBy.doc: Handles an incoming attack. Ignores some weapons, lets a tractor beam capture the attacker, and updates the attacker, notoriety, relations, squad response and help calls.

CallForHelp.doc: Asks the owner to send help against the object. Unless urgent, at most one call per 15 time units.

CanBuyWareType.doc: Stub: 0 here; factories and docks override it.

CanPlayerFireInside.doc: Flag bit 1024: the player may fire inside the station area (returns the raw bit).

CanSellWareType.doc: Stub: 0 here; factories and docks override it.

CatchWare.doc: Stub: 0; ware catching is not implemented for stations.

CleanupSpeakerObjs.doc: Station is gone: invincible speakers are ejected from the station, others are destroyed. Clears the list.

CmdConsoleCommandExec.doc: Runs a console command: for the player, a preloaded value runs after a short delay; upgrade commands open the upgrade menu (2274); command 0 stops the running script.

CmdConsoleEntryExec.doc: Stub: no console entries to execute.

comments.text: base Create takes the sector and position; the station starts unrotated by a half turn (32768)
flag 65536: unknown to the player until scanned
no threat seen yet: last threat time far in the past
one shield bay array per shield subtype
dock slots are sized by the number of dock ports of this type
notify and attack timers start about 10000 time units in the past
owner race is taken from the race table g7 by index

Create.doc: Constructor: sets up the station's type, owner race, dock slots, shield bays and timers, then sets the owner.

comments.text: no free marine slot: ware 107 (trained) if the station trades it, else 106
marine without a race mask: random race
race 1: about 40% chance of a female name
trained marine gets a random 20-49 point skill boost

CreateAddMarine.doc: Creates a marine with a random race and name and stores it. trained: adds a random 20-49 point boost to one skill. Returns 1 on success.

CreateCommMenu.doc: Creates the station's communication menu (class 2225), chained to the parent menu when given.

comments.text: rejected when the player lacks equipment 19 and cannot accept commands: voice 13:135 'Command rejected' and text 35:4602 'Too close to station for autopilot command'
docking denied: voice 13:1284 'Docking denied'
equipment 19 with a valid docking controller: hand over to controller C5003 instead of the command
command 7 = dock at this station
voice 13:1283 'Docking granted' then 13:1264 'Autopilot activated'

CurrentShipDockHere.doc: Docking request for the player's current ship. Rejects it with a voice line when command is refused or docking is not possible, and otherwise sends the ship a dock command (command 7) or uses the docking-controller path when equipped.

Deactivate.doc: Deactivates the station: saves position, shield and hull, deactivates landed ships, frees the engine object and re-registers the station in the regeneration list (C304).

Destruct.doc: Destroys the station: marks it destroyed, removes it from the station list, destroys its marines and training entries, then runs the base destructor.

comments.text: factories (2006) expose products, resources and sresources; docks (2007) expose tradeables

DiscoverWares.doc: Marks every ware offered by this station as known to the player: products, resources and sresources for factories, tradeables for docks.

DoSignalTrade.doc: Routes a trade with an object: own trade (object owned by this station's owner) loads or unloads, others buy or sell.

comments.text: skipped: empty stock, marine table, flagged wares, and ware types 5, 6 and 7
the drop chance is fixed at 100 percent; the dropped amount is a random 1 to count/4+1
freight container created at the station position

DropFreight.doc: Ejects ware stock as freight containers (class 2084) into space. Marines, wares with flag 256, and ware types 5, 6, 7 are skipped. Returns 1 if anything was dropped.

comments.text: gain is 5-9 points per level, one roll per level
progress is the share of the training time already elapsed

EndTrainingEarly.doc: Stops training for one marine early: grants a partial upgrade scaled by elapsed time, then removes the entry.

comments.text: details button 601 (text 35:812 'Info')
production submenu only for factory-type stations (class 2006) that are not shipyards (2037), complexes (2044) and have products
type code 327723 gets the gate realignment button (35:1104050)
complex hub (2044): 'Connected Stations' button shows the factory count
landed ships (35:685) and owned ships (35:686) list buttons show counts

FillContextMenu.doc: Adds the station context-menu buttons: details, comms, production toggle, graphs, rename, connected factories, and the docked-ship trade options. Buttons depend on owner and on whether the player ship is docked.

FindFactoryWithWareType.doc: Finds a station (class 300 search) that sells the ware, within the trade jump limit. Flags select own stations (8) or any station (4 and 32).

comments.text: the player's ship has priority if it is landed here

FindMarineCapableShip.doc: Returns a ship that can carry marines: the player's ship if landed here and capable, else a landed player-owned capable ship; otherwise nothing.

FindNearestMissileAimingAtMe.doc: Returns the owner object of the nearest missile aimed at this station, or 0.

comments.text: gain is 5-9 points per level (skillCode / 10)
marine is on a ship: text 35:1104044 'He has boarded your ship'; otherwise 35:1104043 'Please return to ... to pick up your marine'
message text 35:1104042 with the marine name, marine's pilot name and skill name

FinishedTraining.doc: Completes a training entry: applies the full gain and sends a player message (marine boarded, or return to the station to pick him up).

comments.text: answer 10010 'dock' when docking is possible
answer 10002 'police' when the target or the player is under attack
pilot list capped by the answer array size
sort names alphabetically

GetAnswers.doc: Fills the answer list for a question. For the greeting it adds the dock, police and 'pilots' answers; for the pilot list it adds the names of this station's pilots, landed ships and speakers, sorted and deduplicated.

GetAttacker.doc: Returns the recent attacker (within 600 time units, not the owner); clears it otherwise and updates engine flag 67108864.

comments.text: upgrade ids 1100 to 1163: one entry per owned upgrade

GetCmdConsoleCommands.doc: Adds the console commands for the station: upgrade 68 and the 64 upgrade slots 1100-1163, when owned.

GetCmdConsoleEntries.doc: Adds the station's console entry (type -3) to the list.

GetCommandPreload.doc: Preloaded value of a command (delegates to C703).

comments.text: stop after the base class of this hierarchy

GetCommandScript.doc: Finds a script for a station command by walking up the script class chain from this class to 2016.

GetComplexHangar.doc: Stub: 0 for a plain station; complex hubs (2044) return their hangar object.

GetDirectionVector.doc: Returns the forward vector: from the engine object when active, else computed from the stored rotation.

GetDockBaySize.doc: Number of dock ports for this station type and subtype.

GetGSubType.doc: G subtype from the type table (SA_GetTypeGSubType).

GetGType.doc: G type (same as main type m12).

GetGroupRelation.doc: Relation to a race group: 1 friend, -1 enemy, nothing for neutral.

GetHull.doc: Hull value; reads it from the engine object when active.

GetHullPercent.doc: Hull as a percentage of max hull, 0 when max is 0.

comments.text: 1 hacking (35:1104021), 2 mechanical (35:1104023), 3 engineering (35:1104022), 4 all skills (35:1104032)

GetMarineTrainingSkillName.doc: Returns the localized skill name for a skill code 1-4 (hacking, mechanical, engineering, all skills), nothing otherwise.

GetMarineTrainingTable.doc: Returns a table keyed by marine object with its training entry as value; nothing when no training is queued.

GetMaxHull.doc: Max hull of the station type (SA_GetTypeMaxHull).

GetMaxShield.doc: Max shield: the engine value when active, else the energy of the installed generators.

GetMaxShieldType.doc: Highest shield subtype the station can use (3).

GetMaxTradeJumps.doc: Max jumps used when searching trade partners (m36).

GetMissileArrayAimingAtMe.doc: Returns the table of event objects whose missiles are aimed at this station.

GetMoney.doc: Station money for player stations; 2000000000 for other stations (unlimited).

GetName.doc: Placeholder name 'unknown'; subclasses override it.

GetNoFind.doc: Flag bit 1: the station cannot be found by the finder.

GetNotifyAttackTime.doc: Game time of the last attack notification (m29).

GetNumInstalledShields.doc: Sum of installed shield generators over all subtypes.

GetNumOfLandedShips.doc: Number of ships landed here (size of landedShips).

GetOwnedShips.doc: Returns the table of owned ships.

GetProductObjects.doc: Returns the table of marines stored at this station.

comments.text: named question: first try speakers, then landed ships, then pilots of this station
text 35:1102561 'Information station': a fixed info speaker (voice 946, face 131)
fixed questions: 0 greeting (not when the owner mask has bits 16576), 10010 dock, 10002 police, 10011 end
docking: the request is refused when the ship cannot dock here or there is no free port
police request: the owner loses notoriety with the player; support is sent in a fork

GetQuestion.doc: Dialog question handler. With a name it opens a conversation with that pilot, marine or speaker (a temporary speaker is made for pilots of this station and is removed later). Without a name it answers the fixed question ids: 0 greeting, 10010 docking, 10011 end, 10002 police or help request.

comments.text: dialog ids are race * 100000 + 2000 offset
102000: the greeting of the automated interaction system
102340-102347: marine questions, using the race base plus 330
102999: no question

GetQuestionArray.doc: Maps a dialog question id to the text and voice array for the station's race. Ids below 100000 are offsets from the race base.

GetRebuild.doc: Flag bit 256: the station is rebuilt by the galaxy after destruction.

GetRelation.doc: Relation to the race owning the object: above 0 friend, below 0 enemy, 0 neutral. Returns nothing for an invalid object.

GetRelationEnemyOf.doc: Relation used for targeting: -1 when the object is hostile to this station and enemy-of is enabled, else the plain relation.

GetShield.doc: Shield energy; reads it from the engine object when active.

GetShieldPercent.doc: Shield as a percentage of max shield, 0 when max is 0.

GetShieldPowerGenerator.doc: Shield power generation of the station type (SA_GetTypeShieldPowerGeneration).

GetShieldRating.doc: Shield rating as a percentage of the best generator energy times the number of bays.

GetShips.doc: Returns the table of landed ships.

comments.text: sub-hangar objects (class 2033) contribute their own ships

GetShipsIncludingDocked.doc: Returns the landed ships plus the ships docked in sub-hangars (class 2033).

GetSize.doc: Size of the engine object, or 200000 when inactive.

GetSourceFactories.doc: Returns the galaxy-wide list of product sources (class 300).

GetSpeakerByName.doc: Returns the speaker whose pilot name matches, or 0.

GetTypeCode.doc: Type code: main type in the high 16 bits, subtype in the low 16 bits.

GetUnknown.doc: Flag bit 65536: the station is not yet known to the player.

GetWaitingPickup.doc: Returns the table of trained marines waiting for a ship.

GetWareTypeBestStore.doc: Best stock level for the ware (WareTypeBestStore).

GetWareTypeContainerSize.doc: Container size for the ware: same as max stock.

comments.text: marine ware: count = size of the marine table

GetWareTypeCount.doc: Stock of a ware. For marine wares (g46 flag 1024) the count is the number of marines in the marine table.

GetWareTypeCountVolume.doc: Stock of a ware times its volume.

GetWareTypeFree.doc: Free stock space: max stock minus the current count, never negative.

GetWareTypeMaxStore.doc: Max stock: twice the best stock level.

GetWareTypePrice.doc: Price of a ware. Marine upgrade ware 16/11 costs 3000; wares with g46 flag 8 use the upgrade price of the player's station.

GetYourName.doc: Name shown to the player: the station's GetName().

GiveSupportShip.doc: Orders the first owned fighter of the given G subtype to escort the player (command 5). Returns the last entry examined.

HasCommandPreload.doc: Whether a command has a preloaded value (delegates to C703).

HasCommandUpgrade.doc: Whether the station has the given command upgrade (delegates to C703).

HasFreeDockPort.doc: True if a dock port is free for this ship; does not assign it.

HasFreeDockPortGSubType.doc: True if a dock port is free for ships of the given G subtype.

HasFreeDockPortSubType.doc: True if a dock port is free for ships of the given ship subtype.

HasPolice.doc: True if a fighter owned by this station (class 2034) is landed here.

comments.text: hitter from another owner: the hitter's owner loses notoriety with the player, at most once per 60 time units

negative hull damage means: use the damage that the shield did not absorb

Hit.doc: Applies damage: shields absorb first, the rest goes to hull. Records the hitter, changes relations and alerts the owner. At zero hull the station is marked destroyed and killed in the galaxy after a delay.

InstallWare.doc: Installs a ware: ware type 9 is a shield generator (goes to AddShield), anything else is added as ware stock.

IsBBSDisabled.doc: Flag bit 2048: BBS access is disabled (returns the raw bit).

comments.text: player ship: allowed only when the client state has no bit 512
owner's core sector: stricter notoriety limit (-10)

IsDockingAllowedForShip.doc: Whether the ship may dock: not for enemies, complex hubs or unowned stations; always for the owner race 7[8]; for the player ship by its client state; otherwise by notoriety threshold.

IsDockingNotAllowedForNPCs.doc: Flag bit 32: NPC ships may not dock here.

comments.text: stations with a complex hangar (hubs, 2044) are never docked this way

IsDockingPossibleOf.doc: True if the station type accepts docking of this ship's G subtype. Stations with a complex hangar and a player shipyard (2037) vs ship class 2073 combination are refused.

IsEnemy.doc: True if the object's race is an enemy, or if enemy-of is enabled and the object is hostile to this station.

IsEnemyOfEnabled.doc: Flag bit 128: the station attacks objects that are hostile to it.

IsFriend.doc: True if the object's race is friendly.

IsHighlighted.doc: Flag bit 16384: station is highlighted (returns the raw bit).

IsInvincible.doc: Flag bit 64: the station cannot be destroyed.

IsMarineTraining.doc: True if the marine has a training entry in the queue.

IsNeutral.doc: True if the object's race is neutral.

IsProposedStation.doc: True when the station is only a proposal (bit 2 of field 6).

IsSafePosOnActivate.doc: Flag bit 512: place the station at its saved safe position on activate.

IsSelfDestructing.doc: Flag bit 32768: the station is in its self-destruct sequence.

IsWareCategory.doc: Stub: always 0 here; factory and dock classes override it.

comments.text: invincible (bit 6) stations are never killed
player kills are recorded; killing a solar-shockwave station unlocks an achievement
request a rebuild from the galaxy
each landed ship self-destructs with reason 14
types that leave wrecks create a class 1653 wreck

KilledBy.doc: Destruction by a space object: unless invincible, updates the killer's notoriety and player kill records, creates a wreck for wreck-making types, destroys landed ships and fighters, and frees the station.

LoadMarine.doc: Adds an existing marine to the station's marine table if untrained marine capacity is free. Returns 1 on success.

comments.text: text 35:1100051 'Your station %s was destroyed'

LogDestroyed.doc: For player-owned stations, writes a destruction message to the player log, naming the sector and the killer when known.

comments.text: ware flag 1: never requested
freighter in this station unloads if the amount is over half of the cargo, or with 30% chance
already requested: only raise the wanted count
find a factory with the ware: first among our stations, then any
buy price is raised by half

NeedWareType.doc: Asks the owner's freighters to bring a ware: a nearby freighter unloads its own cargo, or an idle freighter is sent to buy at the best factory. Gives up when there is no source.

NoResources.doc: Stub: 0; subclasses with resources override it.

comments.text: client state bit 512 blocks self-destruct

NotifyMsgBoxReturn.doc: Message-box callback. Confirmed self-destruct (box 32, answer 1) starts the self-destruct sequence if the player docked here and owns the station.

comments.text: menu 620 (connected or own products): uses the complex hangar when the station is a complex member
self-destruct (636): confirm box 32 with text 35:1100063 and title 1904:21001 'Self Destruct'
production toggle (657): text 35:1102474 'Stop Production' or 35:1102473 'Resume Production'
menu 2325 for the connected stations list (button 656)

OnContextMenuReturn.doc: Handles a context-menu button press by id: opens the matching menu or runs the action.

comments.text: autopilot docking (302): needs equipment 19 or command acceptance, and docking must be possible for the player ship
stock exchange (667): needs CanSeeObject and equipment 14 of the owner, and the stock exchange must be unlocked
comms (602): disabled when not docked and no comm contact is possible; also disabled by mask 192 on the owner
self-destruct (636) disabled while self-destructing or invincible
graphs (668) disabled when no graphs exist for this object

OnContextMenuUpdate.doc: Enables or disables context-menu buttons by id. Rules for docking, stock exchange, trade, self-destruct and graphs are checked here.

Patch16_CheckDockSlots.doc: Repair pass (patch 16): drops dock slots whose ship is gone or no longer points here, then recounts docked ships.

comments.text: age limit 28800 time units (8 hours)

PurgeOldMarines.doc: Removes marines older than 8 hours while the marine table is larger than half the marine container size.

ReleaseSlot.doc: Frees the dock port held by the given ship.

RemoveMarine.doc: Removes a marine from the marine table; clears the table when it becomes empty.

RemoveShip.doc: Removes a ship from the landed list and clears its environment.

RemoveSpeakerObj.doc: Removes a speaker from the speaker list. Returns 1 if it was there.

Repair.doc: Adds hull repair when the amount is positive.

RequestDockPort.doc: Requests a dock port for a ship; returns the port index or -1.

comments.text: fork: greeting and autosave run in parallel with the menu setup
voice 13:1502 = 'Successfully docked'
greeting picks: 102037 own factory (welcome back), 102038 pirate station, else owner name id, else race dialog
race dialog ids: 102060+race when notoriety > 33333, 102040+race when > 100, else 102010+race
pause before the second greeting (13:1501 'Connection to local trading network established')
while docked, keep the trade button 106 active when no menu or input lock blocks it
undocked and autopilot off: close menus and stop; autopilot on: continue to StartPlayerShip

RunPlayerTrade.doc: Docked-trade flow for the player ship: optional autosave, a spoken greeting from the station owner, then waits while the ship stays docked and the trade menu is idle. Restores steering and sector music on exit.

comments.text: poll every 100 ticks
entry is finished when elapsed time exceeds its duration

RunTraining.doc: Training loop: every 100 ticks completes queue entries whose duration has passed; clears the queue when empty.

comments.text: reason 22 (self-destruct) or 11 inside a core sector: wreck when the type makes one

SelfDestruct.doc: Destroys the station without a killer. A wreck is made only for reason 22 or 11 in a core sector.

SendMessage.doc: Sends a message to the player's comm unless a comm is already playing or the owner mask is 192. Runs in a fork.

comments.text: signal id switch: 1000 attacked, 1010 damaged, 1013 buy ware, 1014 sell ware, 1015 load ware, 1016 unload ware, 1019 transfer
buy/sell filter: sender kind 65542/65543, tag 9 = object, tag 4 = number
transfer (1019): sender kind 4 and tag 4 or 0; the last argument is a boolean flag

SendSignalFromScript.doc: Entry point for MSCI scripts to raise trade signals on a station. Switch maps signal ids 1000, 1010, 1013-1016 and 1019 to handlers; sender kind 65542 (ship) or 65543 (station) is checked for trade signals.

SendSquad.doc: Sends a squad against the object's event object.

comments.text: first fighter: an armed fighter of class 2023 not busy
if none: an armed fighter of class 2024
remaining fighters of this station (class 2034) join, up to four
non-leaders join the leader's formation and follow it

SendSquadG.doc: Sends a squad of up to four fighters after the attacker. The first fighter attacks, the others join its formation.

SendSupport.doc: Sends up to three owned fighters to support the station, setting their relation to race group 8 hostile.

SetAttacker.doc: Records an attacker and the time of the attack, unless the attacker belongs to the station's owner. Returns the attacker.

SetBBSDisabled.doc: Sets or clears flag bit 2048 (BBS disabled).

SetCommandScript.doc: Stub: command scripts are not stored here.

SetDisowned.doc: Unregisters an owned ship. A rebuildable ship (flag) is replaced: race 9 freighters are respawned for their owner, others are built at the owner's nearest shipyard.

SetDockingNotAllowedForNPCs.doc: Sets or clears flag bit 32 (no NPC docking).

SetEnemyOfEnabled.doc: Sets or clears flag bit 128 and passes it to the engine object.

comments.text: C400 may clamp the requested relation
friendly or the group is the station's own race: friend bit

SetGroupRelation.doc: Sets the relation to a race group: friend bit in friendGroupMask, enemy bit in enemyGroupMask, neutral clears both. Pushes the value to the engine object when active.

SetHighlighted.doc: Sets or clears highlight (flag 16384); also sets engine flag 8192 while active.

SetHull.doc: Sets hull, clamped to 0 and max hull. Invincible stations never drop below 92% of max. Writes to the engine object when active.

SetHullPercent.doc: Sets hull from a percentage of max hull.

SetInvincible.doc: Sets or clears invincibility; also sets engine flag 8388608 while active.

SetKnown.doc: Marks the station known to the player (clears bit 65536 and the engine unknown flag, and marks the race known) or unknown again.

SetMaxTradeJumps.doc: Sets the max jumps used when searching trade partners.

SetNotifyAttackInterval.doc: Sets the minimum seconds between attack notifications.

SetNotifyAttackTime.doc: Sets the game time of the last attack notification.

SetOwned.doc: Registers a ship as owned by this station (ships of class 2004, not marines 1700). Fighters (2034) and other ships are counted separately.

comments.text: relations to each race come from the new owner's notoriety
owner mask 393790: station gets 1-3 named pilots (pilotCount)

SetOwner.doc: Changes the owner: detaches from the old owner (player comm messages are removed), attaches to the new one, sets relations from notoriety and starts the station graph script when needed.

SetPlayerCanFireInside.doc: Sets or clears flag bit 1024 (player may fire inside).

comments.text: alpha override 255 for a proposal, 0 otherwise. Check how the renderer reads this value before relying on it: the meaning may be inverted

SetProposedStation.doc: Sets or clears the proposal flag (bit 2 of field 6). The 3D instance alpha override is set to 255 for a proposal and to 0 otherwise.

SetRebuild.doc: Sets or clears flag bit 256 (rebuild after destruction).

SetRelation.doc: Sets the relation to the race that owns the given object.

comments.text: notoriety <= -10000: enemy; > 10000: friend; otherwise neutral

SetRelationsFromNotoriety.doc: Sets the relation to each race group from the owner's notoriety: at or below -10000 enemy, above 10000 friend, else neutral. Group 10 is skipped unless forced.

SetRelationsToAll.doc: Sets the relation to every race group except the owner.

SetSafePosOnActivate.doc: Sets or clears flag bit 512 (safe position on activate).

SetSectorRelations.doc: Pushes the friend and enemy group masks to the engine object, one group at a time.

comments.text: shield changed: take the station out of the regeneration list first, then add it back below max

SetShield.doc: Sets shield energy, clamped to 0 and to the max when inactive. Writes to the engine object when active. Keeps the station in the regeneration list (C304) while below max.

SetShieldPercent.doc: Sets shield from a percentage of max shield.

SetTargeted.doc: When the station is targeted while unknown, marks it known; then calls the base SetTargeted.

SetWareTypePrice.doc: Stub: prices are not stored here.

ShipAttackedBy.doc: A ship attacked the station: at level 2 or more, the attacker becomes hostile and a squad is sent.

comments.text: attacker kind: ship (2004) 65542, station (2016) 65543

Signal_Attacked.doc: Signals 'attacked' (script command 1000) with the attacker, and 'damaged' when shields are gone.

comments.text: payload: buyer kind and object, ware type and subtype, count, price, seller kind and object

Signal_BuyWare.doc: Signals a purchase (script command 1013): buyer, ware, count, price and seller.

Signal_Damaged.doc: Signals 'damaged' (script command 1010) when shields are down.

comments.text: payload kind by class: sector 65544, marine (1700) 65562, ship 65542, station 65543, class 9001 65559, otherwise 65553; 0 for no killer

Signal_Killed.doc: Signals 'killed' (script command 1001) to the scripts with the killer's kind code.

Signal_LoadWare.doc: Signals a load of wares into the station (script command 1015).

Signal_SellWare.doc: Signals a sale (script command 1014): same payload as Signal_BuyWare.

comments.text: payload: two typed pairs (sender kind, sender; amount kind, amount)

Signal_Transfer.doc: Signals a money transfer to the station: runs script command 1019, or the default 'transfermoney' script.

comments.text: no-op unless both the source object and the ware are given
event tuple: kind code by sender class (65542 ship, 65543 station, 65544 sector-like, 65559/65562 for classes 9001/1700, 65553 otherwise), then tagged object and amount slots
script 23 is the trade handler; interrupt it if already running, else start it

Signal_UnloadWare.doc: Raises secondary signal 1016 (ware unload) for a trader docked at this station, then starts or interrupts trade script 23 with that signal. Does nothing unless both extra arguments are set.

SmallAttack.doc: Sends one armed owned fighter (class 2034, not busy) to kill and land the attacker, then sets the attacker hostile.

StartGraphData.doc: For player-owned stations, starts the 'Graph.pl.station.data' script with an update flag.

comments.text: player ship (g9) is still docked here: zero speed and desired speed, then start it in the hangar
voice 0,0 with priority -50 (silent placeholder line)
players with fight ranking above 50 get a 5 percent chance of a movie
MOV_PlayMovieFrom: fixed movie handle, plays after a random delay

StartPlayerShip.doc: Puts the player ship back into flight after a dock or trade: stops the ship inside the hangar, sets the music to combat or sector track, plays a short voice line, and sometimes a movie for players with high fight ranking.

StartPlayerTrade.doc: Starts RunPlayerTrade as a separate fork when the player starts trading with this station.

comments.text: warning sound every 900 ticks while the player is docked here
text 13:1100026 'Self destruct sequence initiated'
countdown voice lines 1951:340106 onward (nine steps, one per second)
player docked here: undock the player ship before the blast

StartSelfDestructSequence.doc: Player-initiated self-destruct: sets the self-destructing flag, plays the alarm and a nine-step spoken countdown, then detaches the player ship and destroys the station.

StartStationIdleScript.doc: Starts the station idle command script ('!station.cmd.idle.pl') on script 1.

comments.text: marine status while training: 1 + skill

StartTraining.doc: Queues a marine for training at this station; the first entry starts RunTraining in a fork. skillCode = level * 10 + skill (1 hacking, 2 mechanical, 3 engineering, 4 all).

StopTrading.doc: Clears the trading flag and kills the trade task.

TradesWithWareType.doc: Stub: 0 here; factories and docks override it.

UpdateRelations.doc: Recomputes group relations from the owner's notoriety when forced or when the owner mask has bits 192, then pushes the sector relations.

comments.text: skill 1 hacking, 2 mechanical, 3 engineering; 4 raises all three
marine skill check and statistic 8070 (probably a training counter)

UpgradeMarineTraining.doc: Adds the training gain to the marine's skills, hands the marine to a capable ship or the pickup queue, and updates marine statistics. Returns the ship, or 0 for an unknown skill code.

comments.text: slot holds a ship that no longer exists: free it
request flag 2097152: only ports that carry this port flag
port flag 1048576 marks a preferred port
player ship in the same sector: prefer its nearest port
no usable port, no owned ship and no support request: refuse
no port left and no requester flag: sometimes ask an idle ship to leave a port (50% roll)
a ship that landed more than 360 time units ago is asked to undock

__requestDockPort.doc: Core dock-port allocator. Frees slots of dead ships, finds ports usable by the requesting ship, prefers the nearest one, and if checkOnly is 0 assigns the ship to it. Returns the port index or -1.

2016.name: Station

2019.doc: Common base of the carrier-type ships: M1, M2, M6, the CarrierSquad twin and TL derive from it. Sets a marine capacity floor of 20. Name derived from its role (no page 2006 name).

GetMaxMarines.doc: Marine capacity: the Big Ship value, but at least 20.

2019.name: CarrierBase

202.doc: Savegame patch manager. m0 holds the version of the loaded savegame, 32 being the current one. CheckPatch runs every PatchN step from the saved version up to Patch32 (switch fall-through), then rebuilds context data and the database. Patch steps repair or extend old savegames (stations, wares, ships, music).

0.doc: patch level of the loaded savegame; 32 = up to date
0.name: currentVersion

1.doc: patch level when the game was first created
1.name: firstVersion

GetCurrentVersion.doc: Returns the savegame's current patch level.

GetFirstVersion.doc: Returns the patch level the game started with.

Set.doc: Empty stub.

202.name: Patch

2021.doc: M1 carrier-type warship (page 2006), a CarrierBase subclass. Runs patrol and attack squads of fighters, responds to attacks on its ships and escalates against the player in steps stored in m48.

comments.text: No reaction to an attacker without an owner.
Notoriety below -10: relation with the attacker's owner is lowered.
Escalation step at most every 10 time units.
g8.LoseLicense: the player loses the license at step 3.
Attackers that are enemies send up to three fighters (SendSquad).

AttackedByHandler.doc: Attack handler. Attacks by the player ship escalate through steps in m48 (1 first attack, 2 warned, 3 license withdrawn, 4 hostile) with 10 time units between steps. Other attackers are attacked back and called for help.

comments.text: Mode 10 = player-owned ship: no crew list is built.
Text 18:10014 'Navigation officer' is the first crew entry.

Create.doc: Initializes the ship through the carrier base. Unless it is created player-owned (mode 10), fills the crew list m112: the first entry is the navigation officer (10014), the rest are crew members (10013).

CreatePlayerOwned.doc: Creates the ship as player-owned (creation mode 10) and adds it to sector when one is given.

comments.text: Text 18:10021 'Surrender!'.
Text 18:10022 'Sorry, weapons fire was in error. Standing down.'.

GetAnswers.doc: Adds dialog answers to question list arg2 and returns the new count. Player-owned ships get none. For questions 20 and 30 adds 'Surrender!' (10021), and 'Sorry, weapons fire was in error. Standing down.' (10022) if m13 bit 4 is set and the player is not an enemy here.

comments.text: Follower limit: 2 + average of four rolls of SE_Random(5), range 2 to 6.
Fallback order when no M3 is idle: M4, then M5.
Followers leave their formation and follow the leader (command 8, ATTACK_SAME).

GetNewSquadLeader.doc: Picks a squad leader from idle fighters of this owner: an M3 first, then M4, then M5. Up to a random limit of idle fighters (2 to 6) follow the leader. Returns the leader or 0.

comments.text: Only attacks within three jumps are answered.
Strength of the enemy within range 3750000 of the attacked ship.
Enemy fleets already heading for the sector reduce the strength to cover.
Enemies remain: squads are sent in a fork.
Attacked ship is in the carrier's sector: attack the attacker, else patrol that sector.

ShipAttackedBy.doc: Reaction when one of the carrier's ships (attackedShip) is attacked. Scrambles a squad of fighters against attacker when the enemy strength in range is too high, otherwise attacks the attacker or starts a patrol. Reacts at most once per 120 time units.

comments.text: Initial wait of 20 +/- 5 s, until m1 is set.
Stops for good once the carrier is player-owned.

StartControlTask.doc: Starts a background task once. After about 20 s and then every 60 s it gives idle AI-controlled ships in the table m108 a job, until the carrier becomes player-owned.

StartPatrolSquad.doc: Picks a new squad leader and sends it to patrol the sector. Returns the leader or 0.

2021.name: M1

2022.doc: M2 carrier-type warship (page 2006), a CarrierBase subclass. Like M1 with a crew list sized by turret count and a faster escalation ladder (5 time units per step).

comments.text: Step 2 sends message 11 again.
Message 6 is repeated every 30 time units while the attack goes on.

AttackedByHandler.doc: Attack handler with the same escalation as M1 (steps in m48) but with 5 time units between steps, and a notoriety test below -10. Non-player attackers are attacked back.

Create.doc: Initializes the ship through the carrier base. Unless it is created player-owned (mode 10), fills the crew list m112 with one crew member entry (10013) per turret.

CreatePlayerOwned.doc: Creates the ship as player-owned (creation mode 10) and adds it to sector when one is given.

GetAnswers.doc: Dialog answers as in M1: for questions 20 and 30 adds 'Surrender!' (10021), and 10022 when m13 bit 4 is set and the player is not an enemy here. Player-owned ships get none.

GetDockBaySize.doc: Returns the dock bay size of the carrier base.

2022.name: M2

2023.doc: M3 fighter (page 2006), the first choice of squad leader in CarrierBase.GetNewSquadLeader. Has no methods of its own; behaviour comes from Fighter (2034).
2023.name: M3

2024.doc: M4 fighter (page 2006), the second choice of squad leader after M3 in CarrierBase.GetNewSquadLeader. Has no methods of its own; behaviour comes from Fighter (2034).
2024.name: M4

2025.doc: M5 fighter (page 2006), the third choice of squad leader after M3 and M4 in CarrierBase.GetNewSquadLeader. Has no methods of its own; behaviour comes from Fighter (2034).
2025.name: M5

2026.doc: M6 carrier-type ship (page 2006), a Carrier subclass with fixed group size 30000, at least 8 marine seats, and a formation distance based on its model size.

comments.text: First non-enemy attack: message 11 sent right away.

AttackedByHandler.doc: Attack handler with the same escalation as M1 (steps in m48) but with 5 time units between steps. The first non-enemy attack sends message 11 at once. Notoriety below 0 counts as a reason to lower relations.

Create.doc: Initializes the ship through the carrier base. Unless it is created player-owned (mode 10), fills the crew list m112 with one or two crew member entries (10013).

CreatePlayerOwned.doc: Creates the ship as player-owned (creation mode 10) and adds it to sector when one is given.

comments.text: Text 18:10021 'Surrender!'.

GetAnswers.doc: Dialog answers: for questions 20 and 30 adds 'Surrender!' (10021). Player-owned ships get none.

GetDockBaySize.doc: Returns the dock bay size of the carrier base.

comments.text: SE_MulFix with 90112: 90112 / 65536 = 1.375 (16.16 fixed point, probably).

GetFormationDist.doc: Formation distance: the ship size times 1.375.

GetGSize.doc: Fixed size value 30000 (probably the group size used by the formation code).
