666.doc: Value node that adds two value nodes element by element. Used to combine offsets, for example a base position with a relative one.

0.doc: first value node
0.name: firstValue

1.doc: second value node
1.name: secondValue

Create.doc: Stores both nodes; returns this, or nothing when either is not a value node.

Destruct.doc: Frees both nodes.

PeekRefString.doc: Returns the first reference name that is set, else the second's.

QueryEffectiveValue.doc: Returns the element-wise sum; 0 when the two lengths differ.

666.name: CutSumValue

667.doc: Value node for a fixed point on the screen (9 anchors: top-left to bottom-right, centre). Returns the pixel position in the current screen size.

0.doc: owning Cutscene object (C624)
0.name: cutscene

1.doc: anchor index 0..8 (0 top-left, 4 centre, 8 bottom-right)
1.name: screenAnchor

Create.doc: Maps an anchor name such as screen_center to its index 0..8. Returns this, or 0 for an unknown name.

QueryEffectiveValue.doc: Returns the screen pixel position of the anchor.

102 / 104 end with an array parameter (5 or 30) of (type, value) pairs

CmdToParStringArray.doc: Converts the parameters of a command into display strings (editor form): typed pairs, variables with a '$name', labels, strings and numbers; unknown parameters ('?') appear as <?>. Used by CmdToString.

CmdToString.doc: Formats one command as readable text from its template and parameters.

ConstReturnsObject.doc: True for constant ids that yield an object (this, player ship, owner, environment, sector, docked-at).

ConvertArrayToScriptArray.doc: Turns a plain array into script array form: alternating (type, value) cells.

ConvertScriptArrayToArray.doc: Turns a script (type, value) array back into a plain array, recursively for sub-arrays (type 21).

CopyScript.doc: Copies a script under a new name (must not exist, case-insensitively) and saves it.

CustomCommandExists.doc: True if the id is a registered custom command.

DataTypeToEditorString.doc: Like DataTypeToString, but variables (131074) are shown as '$name' and strings (5) in quotes.

comments.text: type 0 = null
131075 = constant, text from page 2002 (THIS, PLAYERSHIP, ...)
65542 ship, 65544 sector, 65562 etc. => object name
type 10 = race id; 10 is the player
type 21 = array, stored as (type, value) pairs

DataTypeToString.doc: Formats a typed script value as text: numbers, strings, object names, wares, races, sectors, constants and arrays ('ARRAY ( ... )', max 8 entries).

DecTaskCounter.doc: Reverse of IncTaskCounter when a script ends.

comments.text: task[5] holds call frames of 9 cells each; cell 0 is the script

DecTaskCounterFromTask.doc: Decrements the counters for every script frame of a task, from the current call depth down to the base frame.

DeleteScript.doc: Removes a script from the table and deletes its file.

DoesScriptExist.doc: True if a script of that name is currently loaded.

EncodeDataType.doc: Adds the type flag bits for a base data type id from the data type list.

ExecuteSetupScripts.doc: Runs all 'setup.*' and '!setup.*' scripts (new game setup).

FindScript.doc: Returns a loaded script or tries to load it from disk.

GetCmdArrIdxFromParIdx.doc: Index inside the command array of the given parameter index.

GetCmdDefFlags.doc: Returns the flags of a command (e.g. 131072 = does not take an editor line), or 0.

GetCmdDefPars.doc: Returns the parameter type list of a command, or 0.

GetCmdDefs.doc: Returns the command definition table entry for a command index (from the MSCI script definitions).

GetCmdMenuDefs.doc: Table of MSCI command menu definitions.

GetCmdSize.doc: Total cell size of a command including its id.

GetCustomCommands.doc: Returns the table of custom script commands registered by mods or addons.

GetDataTypes.doc: Table of MSCI data type definitions.

GetEditorLineFromCodeIndex.doc: Converts a code index into an editor line number: skips commands that do not take a line (flag 131072) and adds one for each comment line positioned before it.

GetFormatIndex.doc: Maps a placeholder position of a command's format to its parameter index.

GetObjClassDefs.doc: Table of MSCI object class definitions.

GetObjCmds.doc: Table of MSCI object commands (page 2008 commands).

GetParDefFlags.doc: Flags of a parameter type: 65536 = typed value pair, 131072 = variable/label.

GetParDefSize.doc: Number of cells a parameter occupies in command code: 2 for typed pairs and RefObj (4), else 1.

GetParDefs.doc: Table of MSCI parameter definitions (page 2003 syntax).

GetParSize.doc: Cell size of the parameter at the given index of a command (arrays count 2).

GetPartOfFormat.doc: Returns a literal text piece of a command's format string (editor), or empty.

GetScripts.doc: Returns the table of loaded scripts.

GetTaskCounter.doc: Counter of script tasks, probably used to give each task a new id.

GetTaskScriptsCounter.doc: Counter of task scripts, probably used to give each task script a new id.

GetVarIdxDefs.doc: Table of MSCI variable index definitions.

GetWingObjCmds.doc: Returns the object command table for wing (squadron) objects.

IncTaskCounter.doc: Counts a started script: updates the global task count and the per-script counters (running, active, total).

Init.doc: Initialises counters and the script table, builds the database and loads all scripts.

InitDatabase.doc: Fills all static definition tables (commands, parameter flags, constants, classes, operators, data types, menus).

IsDebugInformation.doc: True when debug information is kept for compiled scripts (probably).

LoadAllScripts.doc: Scans addon/scripts for .xml / .pck files and loads each script.

script[4] flags: 1 = invalid/disabled, 2 = has sector coordinates, 4 = signature verified

LoadScript.doc: Loads addon/scripts/<name>.xml: checks tags and signature, imports the code array, decodes sector data types and sets flags (bit 4 = signed). Missing/bad required scripts (name starts with '!') mark the game as modified.

comments.text: 102 = call script (args shown as name=value); 104 = other call with a plain array

MakeCmdString.doc: Expands a command text template (%0..%9) with parameter strings. For call script (102) and call function (104) arrays the remaining parameters are appended as name=value pairs. With color flag, each parameter is wrapped in escape codes.

ReInit.doc: Rebuilds structures, reloads all scripts and re-runs init scripts.

RegExpRunScripts.doc: Runs (or starts as tasks if startAsTask is set) every loaded script whose name matches the regular expression.

comments.text: 37 = '%': followed by a digit is a parameter placeholder

ReinitEditorStructs.doc: Parses every command's text template (with %0..%9 placeholders) into literal text pieces and parameter indexes for the script editor.

ReinitScriptCaches.doc: Resets the command-upgrade caches and runs all 'init.*' and '!init.plugin.*' scripts.

ReinitStructs.doc: Allocates global array g47 indexed by command id (holding each command's flags/size) and clears editor tables; rebuilds editor structs if the script editor or cheats are active.

RemoveCustomCommand.doc: Removes a custom command and clears its command upgrade mapping.

RunNamedScript.doc: Finds a script by name and runs it to completion in the caller's task.

RunScript.doc: Runs a script synchronously as a global script.

comments.text: HideScriptSource registry: bit 1 hides plain source, bit 2 hides editor source

SaveScript.doc: Writes a script back to addon/scripts/<name>.xml with plaintext source (CDATA), editor source text, the exported code array, argument list, and a random dummy 'nosignature' tag. Source sections are omitted depending on the HideScriptSource registry value.

ScriptInvalidArgs.doc: Base no-op hook called when a script command receives invalid arguments.

SetDebugInformation.doc: Enables or disables keeping debug information for compiled scripts (probably).

StartNamedScript.doc: Finds a script by name and starts it with StartScript.

StartNamedScriptCallback.doc: Finds a script by name and starts it with StartScriptCallback.

StartScript.doc: Starts a script as a task on an owner object: ships/stations (types 65542, 65562, 65543) get their own task slot via StartThisScript; otherwise a free global task is forked.

StartScriptCallback.doc: Forks a global script task that first stops the owner's current command, then runs the script and reports back to the owner.

comments.text: 65544 = sector data type

__decodeSectorDataType.doc: After loading, converts sector references stored as (x<<16|y) into sector objects via the global sector map g6, in commands or in the script's data tables. Returns 1 if anything was converted.

__encodeSectorDataType.doc: Inverse of __decodeSectorDataType before saving: turns sector objects back into (x<<16|y) integers in a cloned copy.

700.name: ScriptDatabase

701.doc: An editable MSCI script (the in-game command-list script format, page 2003 command syntax). Holds name, description, version, the argument list and the list of commands, and can compile itself (Resolve) into the flat script record that class 700 stores and class 702 runs. Also renders itself as plain text/XML or in the script editor window (TransformSourceTextForOutput). dobj: SCRIPT-related, listed together with 702.

0.doc: script name (record index 0)
0.name: scriptName

1.doc: script description text (record index 2)
1.name: description

2.doc: script version number (record index 3)
2.name: version

3.doc: ordering/object command the script is bound to (record index 9)
3.name: objectCmd

4.doc: array of {cmdArray, paramFlagArray}; paramFlag bit 0 = parameter not set
4.name: commands

5.doc: array of {name, type, description} script arguments
5.name: arguments

ChangeArg.doc: Replaces the argument at an index.

ChangeCmd.doc: Replaces the command at an index.

CommentCmd.doc: Turns a command into a disabled 'cmd comment' (id 3 prepended). Returns 0 for comment/NOP/already-disabled commands, else 1.

CompileExpression.doc: Compiles the expression-list parameter that starts at index 'pos' of 'cmd' into a prefix block {operandCount, (type,value)*, opCount, ops*} (reverse-polish style). Returns the new command array, or 0 on syntax error.

comments.text: record layout: [0] name, [2] description, [3] version, [5] variable names, [6] commands, [7] arguments, [8] comment/disabled lines, [9] object command
walks the stored commands; before each command the pending extra lines (comments, disabled commands) of that line are inserted
command flag 0x20000: stored entry is skipped here
flag 0x20000 parameter: variable reference. Negative values are literal-encoded, non-negative ones index the variable name table
parameter type 30 = expression list: the compiled RPN form is expanded back into (type,value) pairs
command 102 (call script) gets parameter flag slot 0 = 2, command 104 gets the last slot = 4

Create.doc: Builds the editor object from a stored script record: copies name/description/version/object command, expands the argument list and rebuilds the command list (including comment lines and per-parameter 'unset' flags). Returns this.

Destruct.doc: Clears the name, description, command list and argument list. Returns this.

GetArgNames.doc: Returns the names of all script arguments.

GetCmd.doc: Returns command number index as {cmdArray, paramFlagArray}.

GetCmdNumOfPars.doc: Number of parameter flags of the command, 0 if it has none.

GetLabels.doc: Returns a table {commandNumber: labelName} of the labels (parameter type 6) defined by the commands, skipping commands with id <= 10.

GetName.doc: Returns the script name.

GetNumberOfArgs.doc: Returns the number of arguments of the script (size of its argument array).

GetNumberOfCmds.doc: Returns the number of commands of the script (size of its command array).

GetScriptObjectCmd.doc: Returns the object command id that runs this script (probably the page 2008 command that starts it).

comments.text: expression types 2 and 11 are strings (variable names)
typed-value parameter (flag 0x10000): a (type, value) pair; type 131074 = variable name string
parameter type 5/30 = list: count followed by (type, value) pairs

GetVarNames.doc: Returns all variable names of the script: the argument names followed by every variable-name parameter used by commands (set parameters only, no duplicates).

HasCmdUnsetPars.doc: True if any parameter of the command still has the 'not set' flag (bit 0).

InsertArg.doc: Inserts an argument definition at an index.

InsertCmd.doc: Inserts a command at an index.

NewParFlagArray.doc: Allocates a parameter-flag array of the given size: every slot is 1 (not set) unless 'allSet' is true.

RemoveArg.doc: Removes the argument at an index.

RemoveCmd.doc: Removes the command at an index.

comments.text: 1265:105 'Parameter not set in line %d'
commands 6/7 = continue/break: find the enclosing loop on the block stack and emit a jump (112)
commands 4/5 = end conditional / else: close or split the open block, patch the jump target into the opening instruction
1265:107 'Lost statement in line %d'
ids <= 10 (comment, NOP, cmd comment, end, else, continue, break) become a line-info entry only, no code is emitted
flag 0x20000 parameter = variable name: replaced by its index in the variable table
parameter type 1: label reference, resolved after the main loop
typed value: type 131074 = variable (name to index); 65544 sets usage flag 2; types with bit 0x10000 set usage flag 1
parameter type 30: compile the expression list to RPN (CompileExpression)
1265:106 'Syntax error in expression in line %d'
1265:108 'Conditional statement without end statement in line %d'
1265:100 "Label '%s' not found in line %d"
an empty script gets a single return instruction (103)
output record: [0] name, [1] format version 54, [2] description, [3] version, [4] usage flags, [5] variable names, [6] code, [7] arguments, [8] line info, [9] object command

Resolve.doc: Compiles the editor script into the stored script record. Resolves labels and the if/else/while/end block structure into jump instructions (id 112), converts variable names to indices, compiles expressions, and checks parameters. On success stores the record in result[0] and returns 1; on error stores the localized message (page 1265) in result[1] and returns 0.

SetScriptObjectCmd.doc: Binds the script to an object command id.

comments.text: command flag 0x10000 = interruptable, printed as '@'
ids 101 (label), 1 (comment), 3 (disabled) are not indented
text of 2003:3 'cmd comment'
for command 102 (call script) the callee's argument names are looked up so they print as ' name='
command 104 with a list parameter ends with an ellipsis

TransformSourceTextForOutput.doc: Formats the script as text. With window=0 it returns {plainText, xmlText} (one <line> per command with indent, <comment>, <text>, <var>, <call> markup). With an editor window it draws the lines (line numbers, interrupt marker, coloured parameters, click areas) and returns 0.

UncommentCmd.doc: Reverts CommentCmd: strips the leading id 3 and rebuilds the parameter flags. Returns 1 on success, 0 if the command was not disabled.

__expr_brace.doc: Parses an operand or a parenthesised sub-expression (operators 16 = '(' and 17 = ')'). A plain operand is added to the operand list and referenced by a negative index (-1 - n) in the operator list.

__expr_equal_notequal.doc: Precedence level: equality operators 0 and 1 over __expr_comp.

__expr_mul_div_mod.doc: Precedence level: operators 13, 14, 15 (multiply, divide, modulo) over __expr_oneop.

comments.text: minus (12) is stored as unary operator 65555

__expr_oneop.doc: Unary operators: collects prefix operators (65554, 65555, 65556, minus 12 mapped to 65555, unary plus 11 dropped), parses a bracket/operand and then emits the collected operators in reverse order.

__exprtree.doc: Expression parser, lowest precedence level: boolean OR (operator token 10) over __expr_bool_and. All __expr_* functions share one signature: they parse tokens (pairs type,value; type 15 = operator) from 'pos' and append operands/operators to the output lists. They return the next position, -1 when all input was consumed, -2 on a syntax error.

701.name: MsciScript

702.doc: Base class of every object that can run MSCI scripts (ships, stations, players etc.; parent GBODY). Holds the object's script tasks, script variables and secondary-signal handlers, and has the entry points to start, run, stop, freeze and interrupt scripts. The interpreter itself is __runScript (dobj: SCRIPT).

0.doc: slot+1 -> script task record of 13 cells
0.name: scriptTasks

1.doc: script debug switch / level
1.name: scriptDebug

2.doc: collected script debug message list
2.name: scriptDebugMessages

3.name: secondarySignals

4.doc: (race<<16 | class) -> signal id -> handlers
4.name: globalSecondarySignals

5.doc: variable name -> typed value cells
5.name: scriptVariables

AddGlobalSecondarySignal.doc: Registers (or, with script 0, removes) a global handler for a class, optionally restricted to an owner race, cleaning up empty tables.

AddSecondarySignal.doc: Registers a handler script for a signal id under a slot key on this object.

CallbackBeginRunThisScript.doc: Base no-op hook called before a script runs a step, with the script.

CallbackBeginStartThisScript.doc: Base no-op hook called before a script is started, with the script.

CallbackEndRunThisScript.doc: Base no-op hook called after a script runs a step, with the script.

CallbackEndStartThisScript.doc: Base no-op hook called after a script is started, with the script.

CallbackInterruptThisScript.doc: Base no-op hook called when a script is interrupted, with the script and the reason.

CallbackStartFreezedThisScript.doc: Base no-op hook called when a script is started in the frozen state, with the script and two more arguments.

CallbackStopThisScript.doc: Base no-op hook called when a script stops, with the script.

ClearScriptDebugMessages.doc: Clears the messages and switches debug off.

CopyScriptVariablesFrom.doc: Replaces this object's variables with a copy of another object's.

Destruct.doc: Kills all script tasks of the object, fixes the counters, removes patch values and runs GBODY's destructor.

FreezeThisScriptID.doc: Stops the running task of a slot but keeps its record so it can be started again later: resets to the base frame's script and priority. Returns 1 if frozen.

GetGlobalScriptTasks.doc: Returns the table of running global script tasks (patch value 702/1).

GetScriptDebug.doc: Returns this object's script debug flag (probably enables step or trace output for its scripts).

GetScriptObjectCmd.doc: Returns the object command id of the task in a slot.

GetScriptObjectCmdTarget.doc: Returns the {target, target arg} of the object command in a slot.

GetScriptTask.doc: Returns the task record in a slot (key is slot+1).

GetScriptTaskScript.doc: Returns the script of a slot's task (the base frame's script if running).

GetScriptVariable.doc: Returns a script variable's typed value cells.

GetScriptVariables.doc: Returns the table of script variables of this object (probably).

GetScriptVariablesByPrefix.doc: Returns the names of obj's script variables starting with the prefix.

GetScriptVariablesByRegEx.doc: Returns the names of obj's script variables matching the regular expression.

InterruptThisScriptID.doc: Posts an interrupt (script, priority, args) into the task and wakes the task with TI_Interrupt. Fails if the running priority is higher or equal.

IsScriptDebugEnabled.doc: True if script debugging is switched on (the debug flag is nonzero).

IsScriptTaskFreezed.doc: True if the slot holds a frozen (no VM task) script.

IsScriptTaskRunning.doc: True if the slot has a live VM task.

IsThisInterruptable.doc: Checks interruptibility of slot 0 for the given priority.

IsThisScriptInterruptableID.doc: True if the slot's script has lower priority than the given one, is not flagged, and has interrupt storage.

ProcessGlobalSecondarySignals.doc: Runs the global handlers for this object's class and its superclasses up to Ship (2004).

comments.text: second call of the same per-object processing: possible duplicate handler execution

ProcessSecondarySignal.doc: Runs the handlers registered for a secondary signal: per-object, again per-object via the singleton, and then the global ones by class. The per-object table is processed twice (once through 'this', once through C702.), so handlers probably fire twice.

ProcessSecondarySignalsForObject.doc: Runs the handlers this object registered for the signal id.

RemoveSecondarySignal.doc: Removes a handler for a signal id and slot key.

RunNamedScript.doc: Runs a global script by name; does nothing if it does not exist.

RunScript.doc: Runs a script as a global (object-less) task in the caller's VM task and registers it in the global task table while it runs.

RunScriptGlobalCallback.doc: Like RunScript, but tells the callback owner its global task id (SetScriptGlobalTask) before and after, and calls CallbackEndRunScript when done.

comments.text: dead code below: mode-dependent dispatch is never reached

RunSecondarySignal.doc: Runs each handler script of a signal on obj in slot 18 (synchronously). Code after the unconditional 'continue' is dead; it was an older dispatch by mode (-1 run in slot 0, < -1 run in slot -1-mode, else start).

RunThisScript.doc: Runs a script in slot 0 to completion.

RunThisScriptCall.doc: Like RunThisScriptID but passes a call-parameter (arg4) to the interpreter, used for script calls with a return value.

RunThisScriptID.doc: Runs a script in a slot in the caller's task (synchronous). The task record is flagged non-stoppable (cell 12 = 1).

ScriptGetConst.doc: Evaluates a script constant (page 2002) for the interpreter: returns the value and stores its data type in global g48. Handles THIS, PLAYERSHIP, HOMEBASE (owner object), ENVIRONMENT, SECTOR, OWNER, DOCKEDAT, TRUE/FALSE, MAX and constants from the database.

SetScriptDebug.doc: Sets this object's script debug flag.

SetScriptObjectCmd.doc: Sets the object command id of the task in a slot.

SetScriptObjectCmdTarget.doc: Sets the object command target of the task in a slot.

SetScriptVariable.doc: Stores a script variable; a null value (type 0) deletes it.

Signal_ScriptAborted.doc: Interrupts the script that handles command 1007 (abort) with priority 9, if there is one.

comments.text: owner type: 65559 player, 65562 ?, 65542 ship, 65543 station, 65544 sector, 65553 other; only 65542/65543/65562 may run slot scripts

task record (13 cells): 0 task id, 1 priority, 2 call depth, 3 frame count, 4 interrupt info, 5 frames (9 cells each, 36 total), 6 flag, 7 slot, 8 args, 9 object command, 10-11 command target, 12 flags

StartFreezedThisScriptID.doc: Creates a frozen task record (no VM task, id 0) in a slot for a script, so UnfreezeThisScriptID can run it later. Only for ship-like owners.

StartThisNamedScriptID.doc: Starts a script by name in a slot; returns 0 if it does not exist.

StartThisScriptID.doc: Starts a script in a slot of this object as a new forked task: stops any old one, builds the 13-cell task record, runs the interpreter and cleans up afterwards. Only ships, stations and similar owners may do it.

StopGlobalScript.doc: Kills a global script task by task id and removes it from the global table.

comments.text: task[12] bit 0: started via RunThisScript, cannot be stopped

StopThisScriptID.doc: Kills the task in a slot and removes its record. Tasks with flag 1 (non-stoppable, i.e. synchronous runs) are left alone. Returns 1 if a running task was killed.

UnfreezeThisScriptID.doc: Forks a task for a frozen slot record and runs its script in the interpreter.

__gcc.doc: For one class id, runs the signal handlers registered for the object's owner race and class, then the ones for any race.

__runScript.doc: The MSCI script interpreter (part 1 of 8). Runs one task of a compiled player/mod script (arg2) on a script instance (arg1): fetches instructions [cmdId, operands...] and dispatches on the command id in a big switch. Handles the script frame stack, gosub, interrupts and signals, the watchdog against endless loops, debug tracing, arrays and the ship command wrappers. A command stores its result through the result variable id v25 and the typed result pair v26/v27 in the common code after the switch (parts 2+).

__scriptOpAddString.doc: Script operator for adding strings: formats both operands as text and concatenates them; 0 if either fails.

SendVoiceMessage.doc: Sends a message from this pilot to the player through C1700 and C150.ReceiveMessageWithPriority, using a random voice line of the pilot. The kind arg1 is a page 1375 gang text id (30001-30003); other values use the default line set.

Spawn.doc: Marks the pilot as spawned and stores its pilot id, race and name, and allocates an empty fleet. Returns the pilot id on the first call, nothing if it was already spawned.

comments.text: The fight rank is converted to a title level first.
Fleet table per pilot: each title level lists the ship groups it gets; the first matching case returns.

SpawnFleet.doc: Spawns the fleet for this pilot. The rank value is first turned into a fight title (GetTitleFromFightRanking); the switch on pilot id and title then calls SpawnM3-SpawnM6 with fixed counts and subtypes.

comments.text: Ship name text: page 1375 with id pilot id + 20000 (the gang name), plus a random number.

SpawnM3.doc: Spawns count M3 ships (class 2023) of the given subtype, named and equipped with default items, and adds them to the fleet.

SpawnM4.doc: Spawns count M4 ships (class 2024) of the given subtype into the fleet, like SpawnM3.

SpawnM5.doc: Spawns count M5 ships (class 2025) of the given subtype into the fleet, like SpawnM3.

SpawnM6.doc: Spawns count M6 ships (class 2026) of the given subtype into the fleet, like SpawnM3.

comments.text: Ship class is picked by rank thresholds (for example below 70, 2000, 60000 for pilot 10001).
Voice and face ids depend on language 49 (alternate voice set).
Probable bug: the switch has no default case. For a pilot id outside 10001-10006 the ship is 0 here and AddDefaultMissiles fails.

SpawnPersonalShip.doc: Creates the pilot's own ship for its pilot id, picking the ship class from the rank value arg1 (larger means a stronger ship). Adds shields and lasers, sets name and voice, installs wares, makes it invincible and not capturable. Returns the ship and stores it in m4.

comments.text: Bail out only when shield percent is below v1 and hull percent is below v2 (per pilot id).

WantsToBail.doc: True when the personal ship is below the pilot's shield and hull limits (both must be low). Returns 0 otherwise or if there is no ship.

8048.name: EvilNpc

9000.doc: Global registry of command wings (class 9001, 'wing' = a group of player ships with shared commands). Owners map to their wings; wing ids 1-8 are predefined for the player object g8 and created in Init. Also keeps the ids of custom commands (1000 and up). Probably the 'Group Commands' system (texts page 2030). Not named by dobj.

0.doc: owner object -> {wing id or wing object -> wing (class 9001)}
0.name: wingsByOwner

1.doc: custom command ids (1000 and up) registered with AddCustomCommand
1.name: customCommandIds

AddCustomCommand.doc: Registers a custom command id. Ids below 1000 are ignored.

comments.text: Wings without an id are keyed by the wing object itself

AddWing.doc: Returns the existing wing (owner, wingId) or creates a new wing (class 9001) and registers it. The third parameter is passed to the wing constructor.

CheckRunningPID.doc: True if any wing of any owner runs a script with this task id.

CustomCommandExists.doc: True if the custom command id is registered.

Disband.doc: Deletes a non-predefined wing and removes it from the registry. Predefined wings are kept.

FindWing.doc: Returns the wing with the given id of an owner, or nothing.

FindWingByName.doc: Returns the first wing of an owner whose GetName() equals the given name, or nothing.

GetCustomCommands.doc: Returns the table of registered custom command ids.

GetNumActiveWings.doc: Counts the wings of an owner that have at least one ship.

GetNumWings.doc: Returns the number of wings of an owner, or nothing if the owner has no table.

GetWings.doc: Returns the wing table of an owner.

Init.doc: Resets the registry and creates the eight predefined wings (ids 1-8) for the player object g8.

RemoveCustomCommand.doc: Unregisters a custom command and clears its upgrade wing and its global script binding (class 9001, script type 10).

RemoveFromWings.doc: Removes a ship from every wing of every owner. Returns 1 if it was removed from any wing.

9000.name: WingManager

9001.doc: A wing: a group of ships (player or NPC) that share one command, owner faction, relation table and wing orders. Page 2006 has no name for this class and no dobj name is known. Created as new C9001(owner, wingId, customName) by a wing lookup (FindWing); predefined wings (wingId > 0) take their colour name from page 13 (text 20000 + id). Player wing orders (Follow Me, Protect Me, Attack All Enemies, Stop) come from the wing context menu.

0.doc: member ships as keys, value 1

1.doc: custom wing name from Create, or 0 to use the predefined name
1.name: customName

10.name: tempRemovedShips

11.doc: ship command table, entries [commandId, value1..value4]
11.name: shipCommands

12.doc: global script task id of the wing, -1 when none

AddOrdersForContextMenu.doc: Adds the wing order buttons to a submenu. Only for the player's wing.

the homebase becomes the ship's owner object if it can dock the ship
the player's own ship (g9) does not get the player-wingmen flag
suspicious: compares the group index with the owner object m3, not m3.GetID(); the owner's own group is not skipped

AddShip.doc: Adds a ship to the wing: removes it from its previous wing and copies the wing's flags, relations, fire, fuel and autojump settings to it.

comments.text: new entry: 5 slots, slot 0 holds the command id

AddShipCommand.doc: Adds or updates an entry in the command table: [commandId, value1..value4].

AllShipsHaveWare.doc: True if every member (of the given ship class, if one is set) has the ware.

AnyShipsHaveWare.doc: True if at least one member (of the given ship class, if one is set) has the ware.

comments.text: Only missile subtypes in the source mask are copied
Resupply is copied per subtype index, the same index used by the mask test

ApplyMissileResupply.doc: Copies missile resupply levels from sourceShip to the other ships of this wing, for the missile subtypes in sourceShip's mask.

CallbackEndRunScript.doc: Called when the wing's script ends. Sends the 'no command' notification if flag 8 is set, then stops the command.

CanShipBeAdded.doc: True if the object is a class 2134 object (probably a ship) and not class 2061.

comments.text: upgrade 3: every ship must have the ware; others: one ship is enough
unreachable: both switch branches return

CheckCommandUpgrade.doc: Checks a command upgrade's ware requirement: upgrade 3 needs every member to have the ware, other upgrades need one ship.

comments.text: ids 100..108: ship-level upgrade table
-1: no ware requirement, always met
packed requirement: bits 16-23 = ware type, bits 0-15 = ware subtype

CheckHasCommandUpgrade.doc: True if the wing meets the command upgrade. Ids 100..108 are ship upgrades (C703.GetCommandUpgrade), other ids are wing upgrades (C703.GetCommandUpgradeWing).

CheckRunningPID.doc: True if this wing's running script has the given task id.

comments.text: Pardef ids 3, 10, 63, 64 expect tag 4; ids 2, 11 expect tag 5 (probably number and string types)
Pardef 54 needs a class 2012 object
Pardef 55 needs a class 2084 object
Pardef 14 and 69 need the sector tag 65544
Unknown pardef ids are accepted

CheckValidPardef.doc: Checks one argument against a script parameter definition (pardef id). Most pardefs need a matching type tag and a non-empty object. Unknown pardef ids are accepted.

Upgrade flag 1024 clears menu flag 16
Command 0 stops the wing and plays speech 13:131 'Command accepted'
For the player wing (m3 == g8) with no explicit argument, a preloaded entry is reopened after 10 ms
preloaded[0] == 21 means preloaded[1] is an argument list; otherwise it is one argument
Commands 2, 6, 7, 8, 12, 14, 15 and 16 clear menu flag 16
Opens the argument menu (class 2274) for the command's upgrade entry
Blocks 200..263, 300..363, 400..463, 500..563, 600..663, 800..863 and custom ids 1000 and up open their upgrade menu
No command could be opened: fail sample

CmdConsoleCommandExec.doc: Executes a console menu command for this wing: stops the wing for command 0, otherwise opens the command's argument menu. Returns 1 when stopped, 2 when a menu was opened, 0 when nothing could be done.

comments.text: predefined wings keep their id, ad-hoc wings get -1
defaults: 5% missile fire, autojump range 2
no global script task yet (-1)
race groups 6 and 7 start at -1 (enemy by default, probably)
the owner's own relation group is friendly

Create.doc: Initialises a new wing for an owner: wing id (predefined or -1), custom name and default flags and settings. Returns the wing itself.

comments.text: menu 2309: the wing command menu

CreateCommMenu.doc: Creates the wing command menu (class 2309). With a previous menu it is created as its next menu.

comments.text: details screen follows the given menu; g9 (player ship) is passed in

CreateDetailsMenu.doc: Creates the wing details menu (class 2308). With a menu argument it is created as the next menu of that one.

Destruct.doc: Stops the wing's script, removes all member ships and returns the wing.

comments.text: 660 Follow Me: command 6 with the player ship (g9) as target
voice 13:131 'Command accepted' after each order
661 Protect Me: command 7 with the player ship (g9) as target
662 Attack All Enemies: command 4, no target
663 Stop: stops the wing command
664: command 20, no target; no menu button uses 664

DoContextMenuReturnOrders.doc: Starts the wing order chosen by a button and returns 1 for the order ids 660..664.

comments.text: Attack All Enemies needs command upgrade 4, otherwise the button is disabled

DoContextMenuUpdateOrders.doc: Disables the wing order buttons the wing cannot use. Returns 1 for the order button ids 660..664.

comments.text: info line 'Command:' (text 2020:2) with the command text

DoContextMenuUpdateOrdersInfo.doc: Fills the info line with the current wing command and its target name.

comments.text: 620 'Wing Commands' (text 1904:1014)

FillContextMenu.doc: Adds the wing buttons to the player's context menu: Info (601), Wing Commands (620) and the order list.

FindShip.doc: Returns 1 if the ship is a member of this wing, otherwise nothing.

GetAllExceptTempShips.doc: Returns an array of the member ships that are not temporarily detached.

GetAutojumpMinRange.doc: Minimum range for autojump (field m8, units not verified).

comments.text: Root menu -100 lists the submenus -101 to -107, one per command group. Ids -101..-107 are menu ids, not commands
Command 20 gets flag 1 when the wing's object (m13) does not exist
Upgrade ids are scanned in 64-id blocks: 200..263 here, and 300, 400, 500, 600, 800 in the other submenus
Submenu -105 lists custom commands (ids 1000 and up) from C9000 with SE_TableNext
Checks other than mode 0 build only the root menu: commands 100..107 and the 900..963 block

GetCmdConsoleCommands.doc: Fills outList with the commands shown in menu menuId as flat {commandId, flags} pairs (-99 = separator) and returns the new outIndex. checkMode 0 reads this wing's own upgrades; any other value checks upgrades against the given ship.

GetCommandPreload.doc: Returns the preloaded menu entry for a command, or nothing.

comments.text: -1 is a 'no script' marker: the command is treated as absent

GetCommandScript.doc: Returns the script entry for a command id: the per-wing override table m14 first, then the global command table (C703). Returns nothing for the -1 marker.

GetCommandTarget2Name.doc: Always returns nothing: the secondary target has no name.

comments.text: Commands 11 and 13 show no target name

GetCommandTargetName.doc: Name of the primary command target if it still exists. Nothing for commands 11 and 13.

comments.text: homebase destroyed: forget it

GetDefaultHomebase.doc: Returns the default homebase; forgets it and returns nothing if the object no longer exists.

comments.text: details menu class 2308

GetDetailsMenu.doc: Returns the class id of the wing details menu, 2308.

comments.text: dead store: the environment is computed but not used

GetDistance.doc: Returns the distance between the wing's average position and another object.

GetEnvironment.doc: Returns the environment that the most member ships are in.

GetFireMissileProb.doc: Probability of firing a missile (field m7, units not verified).

comments.text: a ship with formation followers counts as a leader

GetFormationLeaders.doc: Returns an array of member ships that lead formations, or 0 if there are none.

GetFuelResupply.doc: Fuel resupply setting (field m9, units not verified).

comments.text: energy cells per unit of jump energy; no jump energy needed gives the maximum

GetMinimumJumpShip.doc: Returns the member ship with the lowest ratio of energy cells (ware 11) to the energy its jump needs, or 0 if no ships.

GetName.doc: Returns the custom name if set, else the predefined colour name (page 13, text 20000 + wing id), else nothing.

GetPos.doc: Returns the average position of the members in the wing's sector.

GetPosIn.doc: Returns the average position of the member ships located in the given sector; {0, 0, 0} if none.

GetRelation.doc: Returns the wing's relation to a race group (1..19), or nothing outside that range.

GetScriptVariable.doc: Returns one per-wing script variable, or nothing.

GetScriptVariables.doc: Returns the per-wing script variable table (m15).

GetSector.doc: Returns the sector that holds the most member ships; on a tie the first one found wins.

comments.text: requirement -1: every ship qualifies

GetShipArrayForCommandUpgrade.doc: Returns the members that meet the wing-level upgrade requirement, or 0 if the upgrade has no entry.

GetTextID.doc: Name text id: 20000 + wing id for predefined wings, nothing otherwise.

GetWareTypeCountWithPredefined.doc: Sum of the ware count over all member ships.

GetWingID.doc: Predefined wing id (> 0), or -1 for an ad-hoc wing.

HasCommandPreload.doc: True if a preloaded menu entry exists for the command.

comments.text: ids 100..108 are ship upgrades, others wing upgrades

HasCommandUpgrade.doc: Checks a command upgrade for this wing: ids 100..108 go to the ship-level check, others to the wing-level check in C703.

HasShipTempLeft.doc: Returns the detached mark of a ship (1 if temporarily detached).

IsDefaultNotify.doc: Flag bit 1 (IsFlag(1)): default notify setting of the formation (probably).

IsFlag.doc: True if the given flag bit is set in flags.

IsPlayerWingMen.doc: Flag bit 4 (IsFlag(4)): the followers are the player's wingmen (probably).

IsPredefined.doc: True for predefined wings, which have a wing id above 0.

comments.text: player wings only (owner is the player faction g8)
text 35:1104045: 'Your wing, %s, has finished its job and is waiting for new orders!'

NotifyCommandNone.doc: Tells the player that the wing has finished its job and waits for orders. Only for the player's own wing.

comments.text: 601 opens the wing details (class 2308)
620 opens the wing command menu (page 2309, class 2309)

OnContextMenuReturn.doc: Handles the wing buttons on return: 601 opens the wing details menu, 620 opens the wing command menu.

OnContextMenuUpdate.doc: Refreshes the state of wing order buttons; forwards to DoContextMenuUpdateOrders.

OnContextMenuUpdateInfo.doc: Refreshes the info line when the info panel is shown (buttonId 0).

RemoveAll.doc: Removes all member ships and clears their wing links.

comments.text: the removed ship stops its command
last ship gone: the wing stops its own command

RemoveShip.doc: Removes a ship from the wing, clears its wing link and stops its command. The wing stops its own command when it becomes empty.

RemoveShipCommand.doc: Removes the command table entry with the given id.

ReturnTempShip.doc: Re-attaches a temporarily detached ship. Returns 1 if it was detached.

SetAutojumpActivated.doc: Sets the autojump flag and passes it to every member ship.

SetCommandFromScript.doc: Sets the command id and both targets at once; used by scripts.

SetCommandTarget.doc: Sets the primary command target and its script data type.

SetCommandTarget2.doc: Sets the secondary command target and its script data type.

SetDefaultHomebase.doc: Stores the default homebase and applies it to the members.

SetDefaultNotify.doc: Sets the default notify flag and passes it to every member's command-none notification.

SetFireMissileProb.doc: Sets the missile fire probability (percent) and passes it to members; values outside 0..100 are ignored.

SetFlag.doc: Sets or clears one bit in flags.

SetFormationType.doc: Sets the formation type (0..7); other values are ignored.

SetFuelResupply.doc: Stores the fuel resupply setting and passes it to every member ship.

comments.text: no station, the member itself, or a missing station: the member gets no owner object

SetHomebase.doc: Makes the station the owner object of each member that it can dock; members get no owner object otherwise.

comments.text: skip the player's own ship (g9)

SetPlayerWingMen.doc: Sets the player-wingmen flag and passes it to every member except the player's own ship.

SetRelation.doc: Sets the relation to a race group and passes it to every member. Relation: -1 enemy, 0 neutral, 1 friendly (probably).

comments.text: index 10 is the player faction (g8 = g7[10])
notoriety <= -10000 gives -1, > 10000 gives 1, otherwise 0

SetRelationsFromNotoriety.doc: Derives the relation to every race group from the owner's notoriety. Race index 10 (the player) is skipped unless includePlayer is set.

SetScriptGlobalTask.doc: Stores the global script task id of the wing (-1 when none).

SetScriptVariable.doc: Sets a per-wing script variable. A value whose type [0] is 0 removes the variable; the table is dropped when it is empty.

ShipCommandExists.doc: True if the command table has an entry with the given id.

StartExecuteCommand.doc: Starts a command with one target. See StartExecuteCommand8.

StartExecuteCommand2.doc: Starts a command with one target and one extra argument. See StartExecuteCommand8.

StartExecuteCommand4.doc: Starts a command with up to three arguments. See StartExecuteCommand8.

comments.text: Command id 0 stops, 1 takes a ship (2004) or station (2016) target, 12 takes a sector (2001)
Any other target for command 1 is dropped
Type tags for script arguments: 65542 ship (2004), 65543 station (2016), 65544 sector (2001), 65559 wing (9001), 65562 class 1700 (probably), 65553 other

StartExecuteCommand8.doc: Starts a wing command. Command 0 stops; command 1 takes a ship or station target; command 12 takes a sector; any other command takes a list of (type tag, value) pairs.

comments.text: scriptEntry[1] is passed to the script callback as extra info
Slot 7 of the script data holds the parameter list (type, name) pairs
The wing is inserted as the first script argument with tag 65559, so scripts get (wing, ...args)

StartExecuteCommandFromScript.doc: Runs the global command script of commandId with a flat (tag, value) argument list. Every argument is checked with CheckValidPardef first; nothing runs if one fails.

StartScriptName.doc: Starts the named MSCI script with two arguments on every member ship.

comments.text: Turret kinds 15 and 16 filter ships by class (2034, 2073)

StartTurretCommand.doc: Starts commandId on every ship of this wing that has it. Turret kind 15 applies only to class 2034 ships and kind 16 only to class 2073 ships.

StopCommand.doc: Stops the command of every ship in this wing (ships temporarily away are skipped), then stops the wing's own script.

StopThisScript.doc: Clears the command and its targets, and stops the wing's running global script (task id in m12) if there is one.

comments.text: signal the ship that it left the wing (it stays a member)

TempRemoveShip.doc: Detaches a member temporarily: it stays in ships but is marked in tempRemovedShips and the ship is signalled. Returns 1, or nothing if already detached.

__stopCommand.doc: Stops the wing's script unless keepScript is set. Always returns 1.

AdvanceFightRankingByPercent.doc: Returns the fight score points needed to advance by the given percent of a rank (recurses over several ranks when percent exceeds 100).

AdvanceNotorietyByPercent.doc: Returns the notoriety points needed to advance the given percent of a title level (recursing over several levels when percent exceeds 100).

AdvanceTradeRankingByPercent.doc: Returns the trade score points needed to advance by the given percent of a rank (recurses over several ranks when percent exceeds 100).

Arr2Int.doc: Identity function; used to reinterpret an array value as an integer.

CallInfiniteLoop.doc: Walks a table of class ids: calls CallInfiniteLoop on each class that has it (removing the entry first), and ends in InfiniteLoop.

CanRaceBuyWareTypeFromRace.doc: True if buyerRace may buy the ware type from sellerRace: same race, pirates and outlaws always, Teladi for non-ship/station goods, otherwise notoriety must reach the ware's minimum.

CheckString.doc: Truncates text with '...' so that it fits the pixel width in the small menu font (gSmallFont).

CheckStringLarge.doc: Truncates text with '...' so that it fits the pixel width in the large menu font (gLargeFont).

CheckWareTableForIllegalWares.doc: Returns 1 when the given ware table contains any ware illegal for the race index arg2.

CreateDecoupleMissile.doc: Wraps an engine object (a decouple missile / boarding pod) in a new class 2085 script object and returns it.

comments.text: low 16 bits = ship subtype
event 256: the parent is told about the decoupled ship (probably)

CreateDecoupleShip.doc: Creates a ship of the subtype in the low 16 bits of arg2 with the owner of arg1, sets it up as a decoupled part of arg1, and notifies arg1 with event 256. Returns the new ship or 0.

DoLoadGame.doc: Loads a save: leaves the current game, then starts the load of the given save slot via X2_SetNextLocation.

comments.text: g11 = DID state flag, checked again by _Restart
35:951 = Autosaving Game ..., shown for slots 10 and up; 35:950 = Saving Game ... otherwise
save info string: game name, player name, environment name, money, trade ranking, fight ranking

DoSaveGame.doc: Saves the game to a slot: shows the saving subtitle (autosave text for slots 10 and up), writes the save info string (name, player, money, rankings) and sector name, and stores the DID-state flag in g11.

DrawIcon.doc: Draws an icon from the icon data table for the given group and index, falling back to a fixed atlas cell when no icon data exists.

DrawMaximiseButton.doc: Draws the maximise/restore window button with icons chosen by arg4 (maximised) and arg5 (hover).

DrawMenuButton.doc: Draws a text menu button of width arg5 with label arg2. arg6 = selected, arg7 = highlighted.

DrawMenuLineButton.doc: Draws a horizontal menu line button. Style from flags arg5: 64 = pressed, 1 = active, else normal.

comments.text: GUI atlas Interface/interface_template_blackpearl_diff
flag 16: header bar with tiled gradient
background darkening texture director/images/dark.tga

DrawMenuWindow.doc: Draws a framed menu window of size arg4 x arg5 at arg2,arg3 from the GUI atlas: corners, tiled edges and body. Optional title (arg7), icon (arg6) and flags arg8 (16 = header bar, 1 = title colour); arg9 is an optional background texture.

DrawPanel.doc: Draws a nine-slice panel of size arg4 x arg5 from the GUI atlas.

comments.text: clipping against limit arg8 and limit - 415

DrawSelectionRect.doc: Draws a selection rectangle clipped to the visible range arg8: the part left of arg8, the part inside the 415-pixel band and the part left of that band.

DrawShieldHullBar.doc: Draws a shield or hull bar: value arg6 out of arg5 scaled to the bar width arg4, split into 5-unit blocks. Sub-row selected by arg7 (0 shield, 4 hull).

DrawTipWindow.doc: Draws a tooltip window of size arg4 x arg5 with fixed header (8 px) and footer (52 px) parts.

comments.text: colour row by ware class: 10 = base, 11/12/15 add 24/36/48 rows, other classes add 12

DrawWareBar.doc: Draws a ware quantity bar: value arg5 of maximum arg6 filling the width arg4. Bar colour depends on the ware-class code arg7 (dense switch).

comments.text: button style: 64 pressed, 1 active, else normal

DrawWindowButton.doc: Draws a window title button of type arg4 (0..8, 14, 15). Style from flags arg5: 64 pressed, 1 active. Other types are not drawn.

FindObjectSubTypeInContainer.doc: Iterates objects of a given type in a container and returns the first one with the wanted subtype (start is the iteration cursor), or nothing.

FindStringInArray.doc: Returns the index of the first array element equal to value, or -1.

FindStringInTable.doc: Returns the key of the first table entry whose value equals value, or 0.

comments.text: action 20 uses text id 360, not 370

GetActionString.doc: Returns the action name: page 14, id 350 + action. Action 20 has its own id 360.

GetAdvanceFromFightRanking.doc: Returns 0..100 percent progress of a fight score within its rank; 100 at the top rank 30.

GetAdvanceFromNotoriety.doc: Returns how far (0..100 percent, logarithmic) a notoriety value has progressed within its current title level toward the next one.

GetAdvanceFromTradeRanking.doc: Returns 0..100 percent progress of a trade score within its rank (linear between rank thresholds); 100 at the top rank 30.

comments.text: allowedTable, when given, lists the allowed packed ids
g46 bit 1 hides a ware type unless includeHidden is set

GetAllWaresOfMainType.doc: Returns a packed list (mainType<<16 | subType) of all ware subtypes of the given main types, filtered by an optional allowed table and by g46 hide flags (unless arg3 is set).

GetAvgRotSpeed.doc: Returns the average of the two largest of three rotation speeds.

comments.text: possible bug: passes mainType (7) instead of subType to SA_GetShipTypeClass, so the class checks below test the class of ship subtype 7

GetClassCodeFromType.doc: Returns the class code text (page 1263) shown in object ID codes for a main type and subtype, depending on station/ship class.

GetClassFromType.doc: Maps a ware/object main type (and subtype) to the game object class id: 3 sun 2008, 4 planet 2002, 5 docks, 6 factories, 7 ships, 8..16 flying ware 2084, 17 asteroid 2012, 18 gate 2014, 20 special 1001, 28 debris 1650, 29..31 debris 1652.

GetCommandShortString.doc: Returns the short command name (page 2011, id arg1), or 'Unkn.Cmd.' if there is none.

GetCommandString.doc: Returns the command name text (page 2010, id arg1), or 'Unknown Command!' if there is none.

GetCorporationDocks.doc: Returns the station subtypes (35..42) of the corporation docks.

GetDateString.doc: Formats a duration in seconds: d-hh:mm when at least one day, else hh:mm:ss.

GetDefaultGSubTypeFromShipClass.doc: Maps a ship object class id (M1..M5, etc.) to its ship class (GSubType) number; -1 if unknown.

comments.text: v2 = per-race subtype (food/ware) added to main type 14 in 917504|v2

GetDefaultPlayerResources.doc: Returns the table of resource wares (key = maintype << 16 | subtype) a player-built factory of the given type consumes by default, derived from the factory's race and product main type.

GetDefaultShipSSubTypeFromGType.doc: Picks a ship subtype of a race and ship class with a random variation (see GetDefaultShipSSubTypeFromGType2).

comments.text: up to 5 retries picking Argon (1) or Teladi (5) when the pirate table has no entry
the loop only searches; its result is not used afterwards (dead loop)

GetDefaultShipSSubTypeFromGType2.doc: Looks up a ship subtype for ship class and race in gShipTypeMap. Non-main races return 12, Khaa'k (9) 251. For pirates (race 8) the special-skin table is used with the given fallback race, retrying with Argon or Teladi if there is none. variation selects the variant (falls back to variant 0 if missing).

GetDialogRaceID.doc: Returns the race id if it is a main dialog race (mask 918526), else nothing.

GetDirectionName.doc: Returns the compass direction text (page 35, 701..704) for a gate direction 0..3.

GetDockClassFromSubType.doc: Maps a dock subtype to the station class id by its GSubType (default class 2007).

GetExtendedFactoryWareName.doc: Returns a factory name prefixed with the name of its default race.

GetFactoryClassFromSubType.doc: Maps a factory subtype to the station class id by GSubType (0: 2082, 7/8: 2044, else 2006).

GetFightRankingTitleName.doc: Returns the text of a fight rank title (page 21, 699100 + rank).

GetFormationName.doc: Returns the formation name (page 2012, 10 + formation id).

GetIDCode.doc: Builds the readable ID code of an object, e.g. 'ABC-12': race prefix text (page 1263, 19100 + owner id), class code and base-26 letters plus two digits derived from the object id.

GetIngameDateString.doc: Formats game time in seconds as ingame date and time (year-month-day hh:mm) using a 360-day year of 12 months of 30 days, offset by the game start day.

GetInstalledWares.doc: Returns the wares preinstalled on a ship subtype: ship subtypes 7, 49, 80, 112, 143 start with ware 1048615.

GetLargeMoneyBillions.doc: Money amounts above 32 bit are stored as (high, low) with high counting 2^31 units; returns the amount in billions (2 * high + low / 1e9).

comments.text: the units part is offset by 1e9 so that leading zeros are kept, then the leading digit is cut off

GetLargeMoneyString.doc: Formats a (high, low) large money amount as text; optionally with thousands separators and, for amounts of a million or more, abbreviated with ' M'.

GetLargeMoneyUnits.doc: Returns the remainder below one billion of a (high, low) large money amount.

GetMarineSkillNumStars.doc: Converts a marine skill value (0..100) to a number of stars (17 per star).

GetMarineVoiceFromRace.doc: Returns a marine voice sample id for the race (281 base, +2 steps per race, plus a random 0/1 variant). Argon (race 1) uses 283 for the second variant.

GetMaxUpgradeCost.doc: For upgrade wares (flag 8) returns a price cap: 3000 for subtype 17, 2000 for 18, 1000 for 16; else nothing.

comments.text: request 40: ship cargo, skipping g46 bit-1 hidden types
request 35: passenger list of a ship
requests 20..25: factory product/resource lists; 2044 also adds sresources
trade objects (2007): tradeable types of main types 8..16

GetMenuRequestWares.doc: Returns the ware list the trade menu needs for an object and a request kind: 40 = wares of a ship (hidden types skipped), 35 = passengers of a ship, 20..25 = products, resources and sresources of a factory, or the tradeables of a trade object (2007).

GetNextRouteSector.doc: Uses the route finder to get the next sector on the path from sector (x, y) toward the destination; returns the sector behind the first gate or 0.

GetNotorietyTitleName.doc: Returns the race-specific notoriety title text for a level (race texts on pages 23-28, 829, 830, base id 100 + level).

GetNumberString.doc: Formats an integer with the language's thousands separator (text 35:4257).

GetNumberStringSuffixed.doc: Abbreviates a number with K or M suffix and the language's decimal separator (text 4285), e.g. 12.3K, 4.5M.

comments.text: positive ids are singleton class objects; map class id to dobj-style name
classes 4000..4499 are quest classes, 5002..5501 upgrade classes

GetObjectName.doc: Returns a display or debug name for an object id. Dynamic objects (negative ids) return their own name/your name, QUEST/EVENT labels for quests and events; static class objects (positive ids) return the dobj style class label (SHIP, STATION, MENU_TRADE, ...). Unknown ids give CLASSn.

GetObjectNameAndIDCode.doc: Returns 'name (ID code)' for ship, station, sector and similar classes, otherwise just the object name.

GetOppositeDirection.doc: Returns the opposite gate direction: 0<->1, 2<->3, 4<->5; -1 if invalid.

GetPatchValue.doc: Reads slot index of the patch value array stored under key; returns 0 when absent.

GetPersonnelStatusString.doc: Returns the text describing a personnel status code (page 35, 1104080..1104111). Codes 20 and above use a numbered text with (code - 19).

GetPilotAggression.doc: Deterministic pilot aggression from the seed and race (fixed 25 or 29 for some races).

comments.text: female Argon faces
male Argon faces

GetPilotFace.doc: Chooses a face (head) id for a pilot from the seed, race and gender. Argon/Terran use 101.. and 1131..1140, Pirate 811.., Khaa'k 901+, other main races raceId*100+1..5.

GetPilotFightSkill.doc: Deterministic pilot combat skill (1..26) from the seed, depending on race; fixed values for some races (20 or 25).

GetPilotMorale.doc: Deterministic pilot morale from the seed and race (fixed 25 or 29 for some races).

comments.text: Teladi: three distinct name syllables plus a suffix; indexes are shifted to avoid repeats
subrace 10 = online/web player: uses the web user name
race 12 returns text 35:21

GetPilotName.doc: Builds a pilot name from the seed. Name parts come from game text pages 30..35 (691000.. for Argon/Terran style, 692000.. Boron, 693000.. Split, 694000.. Paranid, 695000.. Teladi); subrace 10 returns the web user name.

GetPilotSubraceID.doc: Maps a race id to the subrace (name/face group) used for generated pilots. Main races 1..5 map to themselves, race 9 and the Terran races 17/18 to 1, races 8, 10 and 19 pick a pseudo-random one of 1..5 from the seed.

GetPilotTradeSkill.doc: Deterministic pilot trade skill from the seed; 1..20 for some races, 1..26 for others, nothing for races 6, 7, 17, 18, 19.

GetPilotVoice.doc: Looks up a pilot voice (speaker id) for the pilot from the speaker table by race, gender and category flags. If no category is given in the low 4 bits, one is derived from the race (2 = Khaa'k, 8 = pirate/outlaw, 1 = default).

GetProductionTimeAndCount.doc: Computes cycle time and units produced per cycle for a factory product from relative values of the product and its resources (least common multiple). Returns {timeSeconds, amount}. Cycles shorter than 60 s are multiplied up; the factory scale factor is applied to the amount.

GetPubKey.doc: Returns the RSA public key blob (RSA1, 1024 bit) as a byte array, used to verify signed data files.

GetRaceBodyFromOwner.doc: Returns the body (character model) id for the race of an owner object; 10060 if there is no owner.

GetRaceLicenseSubtype.doc: Returns the license ware subtype (26..30) for a main race 1..5, -1 otherwise.

GetRandomFace.doc: Chooses a random face id for the race via GetPilotFace.

GetRandomFemale.doc: Random female flag, true in one case of four, only for races 1, 17 and 18.

GetRandomName.doc: Generates a random pilot name for a race with a random seed range matching the number of name combinations of its subrace.

GetRandomRace.doc: Picks a random race id from a bit mask of races (default mask 918526 = main races).

GetRandomRaceforShipObjType.doc: For a ship object race slot with a mix (0 any, 1 Argon, 2 Boron, 3 Split, 4 Paranid, 5 Teladi, 8 pirate, 19 outlaw) picks a random race by weighted table; other values are returned unchanged.

GetRandomVoice.doc: Chooses a random pilot voice for a race via GetPilotVoice.

GetRepairPriceModifierFromNotoriety.doc: Percent of the normal repair price the player pays, by notoriety title level: 130% at level 0 down to 90% at level 10, 200% when below level 0.

GetSalePriceModifierFromNotoriety.doc: Percent of the normal price the player gets when selling, by notoriety title level: 50% at level 0 up to 70% at level 10, 30% when below.

GetSectorDescriptionID.doc: Returns the text id of a sector's description (name id + 10000).

GetSectorDisplayedRace.doc: Returns the race object displayed for a sector: the override from the renamed-sector table if set, else the sector's owner.

GetSectorName.doc: Returns the name of the sector at the given coordinates.

GetSectorNameID.doc: Returns the text id of a sector's name: 1020101 + y*100 + x by default, or the renamed id if one is registered.

GetSectorXFromID.doc: Converts a sector name text id (original or renamed) back to the sector's X coordinate.

GetSectorYFromID.doc: Converts a sector name text id (original or renamed) back to the sector's Y coordinate.

GetShipBoardingTable.doc: Boarding table row for an object: walks up the class chain until a row exists, stops at class 2073 (Big Ship). Returns the row or 0.

GetShipBoardingTableValue.doc: One value (index arg2) of an object's boarding table row, or 0 if the object has no row.

GetShipDisplayFlags.doc: Builds the HUD display flag bitmask for a ship: 1 tracked, 2 enemy, 8 own ship, 128 active class-2066 ship, 256 own ship under attack, 1024 own ship with weak shields, 8192 controlled but not player ship, 32768 highlighted or guidance target, 65536 civilian.

GetShipTypeHueZeroPosition.doc: Returns the hue zero position from the global parameters of the ship type's default race.

GetShipTypeSpecialSaturationModifier.doc: Returns the colour saturation modifier (fixed point, 65536 = 1.0) from the global parameters of the ship type's race (special skin ships use pirate/outlaw ones).

GetSizeNameID.doc: Maps a factory scale factor (fixed point) to a size name text id: 501 (<=1), 502 (<=3), 503 (<=5), 504 (<=10), 505 (larger).

comments.text: default category by race: 1 normal pilot, 2 Khaa'k(9), 4 (race 10), 8 pirate/outlaw
gender: 2 = female, 1 = male in the table

GetSpeakerByProperties.doc: Selects a speaker (voice page id) from gSpeakerTable matching race, gender and category flags. Category low byte flags must all be present, the next byte flags must all be absent. Picks index (or a random one if -1) among the matches. Returns 0 if none.

GetSpeakerRaceID.doc: Returns the race id of a speaker from gSpeakerTable.

GetSpecialLaserMask.doc: Returns the bit mask of special laser subtypes for a race (none for race 7).

GetSpecialMissileMask.doc: Returns the bit mask of special missile subtypes for a race.

GetStandardLaserMask.doc: Returns the bit mask of laser subtypes standard for a race (race 7 only bit 31, Terran 17/18 their own set).

GetStandardMissileMask.doc: Returns the bit mask of standard missile subtypes for a race.

GetSubStringSize.doc: Binary search for the longest prefix of text whose rendered width in the given font fits maxWidth. Returns the number of characters.

comments.text: languages 81, 86, 88 (probably Asian languages) get 5x per character

GetTextDisplayDuration.doc: Returns how long text should be shown: per-character time times number of characters, multiplied by 5 for the CJK languages (ids 81, 86, 88).

GetTextLookup.doc: Reads text from page 35; id -1 yields 'text 967/text 998' joined with a slash.

GetTimeString.doc: Formats seconds as hh:mm:ss (hours wrap at 24).

GetTitleFromFightRanking.doc: Binary search in the ascending fight ranking thresholds; returns the fight rank level for a fight score.

GetTitleFromNotoriety.doc: Binary search in the descending notoriety thresholds; returns the notoriety title level (-5..10) for a notoriety value.

GetTitleFromTradeRanking.doc: Binary search in the ascending trade ranking thresholds; returns the trade rank level for a trade score.

GetTradeRankingTitleName.doc: Returns the text of a trade rank title (page 20, 699000 + rank).

GetTurretName.doc: Returns the turret name text (page 2021) for a ship subtype and turret index; index 0 gives text 2021:0.

GetVersionString.doc: Maps a build timestamp (seconds since 1970) to the game version name, e.g. 1.0, 2.5.2, 3.2. Builds within an hour of the 3.3 timestamp return '3.3', unknown ones '?'.

comments.text: description text id is always name id + 1

GetWareDescriptionID.doc: Description text id of a ware: the name text id plus 1.

GetWareName.doc: Returns the localized name of a ware. Ships get their variation suffix and a pirate prefix for special skins; large factories get a size name suffix.

comments.text: g43 overrides the name text id, keyed by (mainType<<16 | subType)

GetWareNameID.doc: Name text id of a ware type (main type, sub type). Uses the per-type override table g43 first, else the game's type text id.

GetWingCommandShortString.doc: Returns the short name of a wing command from texts page 2031 (Group Command Shorts), or 'Unkn.Cmd.'.

GetWingCommandString.doc: Returns the name of a wing command from texts page 2030 (Group Commands), or 'Unknown Command!'.

GetXMLTag.doc: Returns the trimmed text between the first <tag> and the last </tag> in the XML text, or 0 if not found.

InfiniteLoop.doc: Keeps a task alive forever (sleeps 4 hours per cycle).

InitBestMissileTable.doc: Fills gBestMissileTable: ship class id to the best missile category to fire at it.

InitDefaultFormations.doc: Fills the per-race default formation table (gDefaultFormations): 1 by default, with overrides for several races.

InitFixedValueFactors.doc: Fills gFixedValueFactors: per ware main type price factor (fixed point).

comments.text: Terran races 17 and 18 use the same table object as Argon

InitIllegalWares.doc: Builds gIllegalWares: per race, a set of ware keys that are illegal to carry there (races 17 and 18 share race 1's list).

InitPatchTable.doc: Resets the patch value table (gPatchTable) to empty.

InitRankingValues.doc: Fills the three ranking threshold tables: notoriety (gNotorietyThresholds), trade ranking (gTradeRankThresholds) and fight ranking (gFightRankThresholds).

comments.text: row order: deck, hull defence, defence level, hacking random, hacking base, shield threshold

InitShipBoardingTable.doc: Fills the global boarding table g51 by ship class id. Each row: deck number, hull defence, base defence level, hacking random range, hacking base, shield boarding threshold.

InitShipTypeMap.doc: Builds gShipTypeMap: per race, two tables (normal / special skin 1) indexed by ship class (GSubType) and by variation, holding the ship subtype id (-1 if absent).

InitSpeakerTable.doc: Builds gSpeakerTable from game texts: pages 101..598 whose text 0 is a {race, gender, categoryFlags[]} array describe a voice actor. The category list is folded into a bit mask.

InitStationFlags.doc: Builds gStationFlags for dock subtypes: 1 for 15-19 and 25-29 (probably military outposts), 2 for 35-42, 59, 60 (probably corporation or equipment docks).

InitUnknownTypes.doc: Clears gUnknownTypes (wares not yet known to the player).

InitWareFlags.doc: Builds gWareFlags (ware key to flag bits) for tech wares (type 16), type 12 wares and laser ammunition. Bit meanings used elsewhere: 1 hidden in request menus, 8 upgrade with max cost, 2048 laser ammunition.

comments.text: angle flag: shift one angle by a full turn (65536) when that gives a shorter arc
default mode falls through to case 0 after a call-stack dump (debug leftover, probably)

Interpolate.doc: Interpolates one number between two keyframe values with mode arg6: 1 linear, 2 smooth, 0 (and default, after a stack dump) returns the first value. With the angle flag arg7 & 1 it takes the shorter way round the 65536-based circle.

IsPilotFemale.doc: Deterministic female flag from a seed: only races 1, 17 and 18 have female pilots, one in four.

IsSpeakerFemale.doc: Returns whether the speaker is female (gender value 2).

MeterToString.doc: Formats a distance in metres as text with unit: metres below 1000, otherwise km (page 35 texts 967 and 966) with up to two decimals.

MeterToStringSplit.doc: Same as MeterToString but returns {value text, unit text} separately.

NormalizeAngleMeasure.doc: Brings an angle into the range 0..65536 (one full turn is 65536).

PreCacheTextures.doc: Loads the list of GUI and explosion textures into the texture cache so they are not loaded during play.

PriceForNextUnit.doc: Price of the next unit given a linear price change: base quarter of the average price, scaled by the linear function parameters.

PrintCmdArray.doc: Debug formatter: prints a command array as '{ a, b, ... }' with ints as 'dec(0xhex)', strings quoted and nested arrays recursed.

RemovePatchValues.doc: Deletes the patch value array stored under key.

SCRIPT_GET_CMDTEXT.doc: Returns the text template of a script command: empty for command 2 (NOP), a replacement from page 2004 if one exists, else the standard text from page 2003.

SetPatchValue.doc: Stores a value in the patch table: slot index of the array kept under key, growing the array when needed.

comments.text: race mask 918526 selects the races that get a relation entry
group 10 = player

SetRelations.doc: Sets the group relation (friend/neutral/foe as +1/0/-1) of a ship group toward each main race and the player, based on its owner's notoriety (threshold +-10000).

SetRenamedSector.doc: Registers a renamed sector with a new name text id and a displayed race id (default 14).

SortFromTableByWareTypeName.doc: Fills outWares with the ware keys of the table (maintype << 16 | subtype), sorted by ware name. If extendedFactoryNames is set, factory wares (maintype 6) use the extended factory name. Returns the count.

SortGalObjsFromTableByObjectName.doc: Fills outObjects with the existing objects of the table, sorted by GetObjectName. Returns the number of objects.

SortGalObjsFromTableByYourName.doc: Fills outObjects with the existing objects of the table, sorted by their player-given name (GetYourName). Returns the number of objects.

SortStringsFromTable.doc: Returns an array of the table's string values sorted by name, or 0 if the table is empty.

comments.text: class ids: 150 client, 620 cutscenes, 700, 605, 2200 menus, 5000 upgrades, 3001 quests

StartInfiniteLoop.doc: Starts a background task that keeps the listed game classes' CallInfiniteLoop loops running.

Str2Int.doc: Identity function; used to reinterpret a string value as an integer.

comments.text: text must be enclosed in { } (chars 123 and 125)
comma (44) ends a token; a trailing comma was appended

StringToArray.doc: Parses a text like {1,2,{3,abc}} into a nested array of integers and strings. Returns 0 on syntax errors or an empty array.

StringToScriptArray.doc: Like StringToArray but produces a typed script parameter array: (type, value) pairs. Type 4 = integer, 5 = string, 21 = nested array, 65542/65543/65544/65553 = object reference (ship, 2016 object, sector, other) given as $#id$.

TotalPriceForNextUnits.doc: Total price for count more units, summing the linear price change from the current amount.

TrimWhitespace.doc: Removes leading and trailing space, tab, CR and LF from a string.

comments.text: owner id 10 = player; if the player is the first party the margin sign flips
50% chance to add trade notoriety with the other owner

UpdateTradeRankingsFromDeal.doc: After a trade between two stations/ships, credits the player: profit above the ware's normal price times amount raises the trade rank, and with 50% chance trade notoriety with the partner's owner. Only deals where exactly one side is the player (owner id 10) count.

UpdateTradeRankingsFromProfit.doc: Adds trade ranking for a profit amount and, for positive profit, a 50% chance of trade notoriety with the given race/owner.

VerifyData.doc: Checks an RSA signature: data (string longer than 100 chars) against its signature string using the built-in public key. Returns 1 if it verifies.

VerifyDataXML.doc: Extracts the named tag from the XML and verifies its content against the given signature.

VerifyFile.doc: Verifies a single file against the signed list in addon/x3files.xml. Returns 1 only if the file is listed and its signature checks out.

comments.text: list must hold at least one (name, signature) pair, so an even number of entries
reads the file with an offset/mode argument 32 (probably a size or flag)

VerifyFiles.doc: Verifies addon/x3files.xml: checks its signature and then the signature of every listed file (pairs of file name and signature). Returns 1 if all match, else 0.

WareTypeBestStore.doc: Ideal stock amount of a ware: 10000 divided by the relative value, at least 1.

WareTypeBestStoreOfResource.doc: Ideal stock of a resource for a given amount arg3 (default 5000 units), with an optional percentage arg4 applied.

WareTypeIsIllegalForRace.doc: Returns the illegal flag of a ware for a race index: nonzero when the race treats the ware as illegal. Returns 0 for unknown races.

WareTypeMaxPrice.doc: Upper trade price limit: average plus the primary max-price percentage.

WareTypeMaxPriceSec.doc: Upper secondary price limit: average plus the secondary max-price percentage.

WareTypeMinPrice.doc: Lower trade price limit: average minus the primary max-price percentage.

WareTypeMinPriceSec.doc: Lower secondary price limit: average minus the secondary max-price percentage.

comments.text: SE_CubicPoly with derivative -slope and -slope*10/7

WareTypePrice.doc: Price on a cubic curve from the ware's price parameters: arg3 is the slope and arg4 the position.

comments.text: price base = 4 * relative value * g42[mainType] (SE_MulFix)

WareTypePriceAverage.doc: Average price of a ware: 4 times the relative value scaled by the per-type factor g42.

WareTypeVolume.doc: Cargo volume of a ware type; at least 1.

comments.text: Probably a bug: v2 (used as the width) is set from GetMenuMaxHeight, not GetMenuMaxWidth. Verify.
Text origin is moved to the centre of the map window, then the name is skipped when it falls outside the usable area.
Colour: current sector -35072, war sector -3014399, core sector -2960686, other sectors -6250336.

WriteGalaxyMapSectorName.doc: Draws one sector name on the galaxy map at the given offset. Current sector is shown in yellow, war sectors in red, core sectors in white, others in grey. The name is highlighted by the active galaxy map's filter text.

comments.text: C201 UiTextFonts.Set first, then audio (C200) and C202
order matters: patch table and ship types before the classes that use them

_Init.doc: Game start initialisation: sets up the UI text and audio classes, the patch, ship, ware and station tables, the speaker table, the infinite loop and precaches textures.

comments.text: if the DID state flag changed since the save, the client leaves the current game (SetLeave)
clears texture flag 128

_Restart.doc: Reinitialises the game after a reload or a restored save: reopens fonts and texts, reloads audio, the patch and game-state classes, updates quests and upgrades, and clears the save-leave flag.
